data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / UCC Article 2
✅ 正确答案：Choice C

本题考察的是《美国统一商法典》（UCC）中关于独家交易合同（Exclusive Dealing Contracts）的默示义务。

⚖️ 核心法律规则 (Legal Rule)
UCC § 2-306(2)
在独家交易（Exclusive Dealing）的协议中，除非另有约定，法律默示双方负有以下义务：
  • 卖方有义务尽最大努力（Best Efforts）供应货物；
  • 买方有义务尽最大努力（Best Efforts）促进货物的销售。
🔍 逻辑推演 (Analysis)

1. 识别合同类型：
题目中，零售商承诺“不销售任何其他供应商的烤面包”。这构成了独家交易（Exclusive Dealing）安排。

2. 默示义务的触发：
虽然零售商没有明确承诺购买特定数量的面包（这通常是选项A和B攻击的点），但根据 UCC § 2-306(2)，一旦承诺了“独家销售”，法律就自动填补了一个条款：零售商必须尽最大努力（use best efforts）去销售这些面包。

3. 违约认定：
零售商仅仅因为“顾客需求下降”就决定完全停止销售，这违反了“尽最大努力”的默示义务。因此，供应商胜诉的直接原因是零售商违反了这一具体义务。

⚠️ 高频陷阱：C vs. D
考生常错选 D，为什么？

选项 D 陈述了一个正确的法律原则：商业合同双方通常承担市场风险（Risk of market fluctuations）。但这只是解释了为什么零售商的抗辩（Defense）会失败。

解题关键：

  • 选项 C (The Sword)：提供了供应商胜诉的积极理由（Affirmative Basis）——即零售商违反了具体的“尽最大努力”义务。
  • 选项 D (The Shield)：只是反驳了零售商可能提出的借口（如履行不能）。

在 MBE 中，当问“为什么原告胜诉”时，指出原告的权利来源（C）永远优于指出被告为何不能免责（D）。

❌ 排除其他选项
  • 选项 A (Mutuality)：错误。虽然没有明确的数量承诺，但“独家销售”的承诺本身就是一种法律上的受损（Legal Detriment），构成了有效的对价（Consideration），因此存在对等义务。
  • 选项 B (Indefiniteness)：错误。产量合同（Output Contract）和需求合同（Requirements Contract）在 UCC 下是有效的。数量虽未定，但可以通过客观产出或需求确定，不视为模糊不清。
MBE 备考贴士：
看到 "Exclusive"（独家）字眼，立即联想 "Best Efforts"（尽最大努力）义务。这是 UCC 填补合同漏洞的常见方式。

questions.question:
A buyer agreed to purchase a seller's house for $250,000 "on condition that the buyer obtain mortgage financing within 30 days." Thirty days later, the buyer told the seller that he would not purchase the house because he had not obtained mortgage financing. The seller asked the buyer where he had tried to obtain mortgage financing, and the buyer responded, "I was busy and didn't have time to seek mortgage financing."
If the seller sues the buyer for breach of contract, is the court likely to find the buyer in breach?

choices.a: No, because the buyer's performance was subject to a condition that did not occur.
choices.b: No, because the promise was illusory since the buyer was not obligated to do anything.
choices.c: Yes, because a promise was implied that the buyer had to make reasonable efforts to obtain mortgage financing.
choices.d: Yes, because a reasonable interpretation of the agreement is that the buyer had an obligation to purchase the house for $250,000 in 30 days.

data.questionStem:
Q81148

A buyer agreed to purchase a seller's house for $250,000 "on condition that the buyer obtain mortgage financing within 30 days." Thirty days later, the buyer told the seller that he would not purchase the house because he had not obtained mortgage financing. The seller asked the buyer where he had tried to obtain mortgage financing, and the buyer responded, "I was busy and didn't have time to seek mortgage financing."

If the seller sues the buyer for breach of contract, is the court likely to find the buyer in breach?

一位买方同意以250,000美元的价格购买卖方的房屋，“条件是买方在30天内获得抵押贷款融资。”三十天后，买方告知卖方他将不购买该房屋，因为他没有获得抵押贷款融资。卖方询问买方曾在何处尝试获得抵押贷款融资，买方回答说：“我太忙了，没有时间去寻求抵押贷款融资。”

如果卖方以违约为由起诉买方，法院是否可能认定买方违约？
options:
A. No, because the buyer's performance was subject to a condition that did not occur.
否，因为买方的履行取决于一个未发生的条件。

B. No, because the promise was illusory since the buyer was not obligated to do anything.
否，因为该承诺是虚幻的，因为买方没有义务做任何事情。

C. Yes, because a promise was implied that the buyer had to make reasonable efforts to obtain mortgage financing.
是，因为存在一项默示承诺，即买方必须做出合理努力以获得抵押贷款融资。

D. Yes, because a reasonable interpretation of the agreement is that the buyer had an obligation to purchase the house for $250,000 in 30 days.
是，因为对协议的合理解释是，买方有义务在30天内以250,000美元购买该房屋。
data.explanation:
A binding contract is formed when one party makes an offer and the other party accepts. Performance is generally due once the contract is formed but performance can be contingent upon the occurrence of a condition. There are two types of conditions:
  • condition precedent - delays performance until a specified event occurs
  • condition subsequent - excuses performance once a specified event occurs
If a party whose duty to perform is subject to a condition precedent wrongfully prevents the condition from occurring - eg, by breaching the implied duty of good faith and fair dealing - then the condition will be excused. In other words, the condition no longer needs to occur for that party's performance to become due. Here, the agreement to purchase the house was conditioned on the buyer's ability to obtain financing within 30 days. The implied duty of good faith and fair dealing required the buyer to make reasonable efforts to secure financing. But since the buyer breached that duty by making no effort to obtain financing, the condition precedent was excused and his performance became due. Therefore, the court is likely to find the buyer is in breach (Choice A). A condition concurrent arises when each party's obligation to perform is a condition precedent to the other party's obligation to perform (ie, when performance is due simultaneously).

(Choice B) A promise is illusory, and therefore unenforceable, if the promisor can choose whether to honor it - eg, had the buyer promised to purchase the house "if I want to." Here, however, the buyer's promise was not illusory because it implicitly obligated him to make efforts to obtain financing within 30 days.

(Choice D) The duty of good faith and fair dealing did not require the buyer to purchase the house but rather to make a reasonable effort to obtain financing within 30 days.

Educational objective: If a party whose duty to perform is subject to a condition precedent wrongfully prevents that condition from occurring - eg, by violating the implied duty of good faith and fair dealing - the condition will be excused and that party must perform.



选项正确率统计：A选项 15%，B选项 2%，C选项 81%（正确选项），D选项 0%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当一方发出要约（offer）而另一方做出承诺时，一份有约束力的合同即告成立。合同成立后，通常即应履行，但履行可以取决于某个条件的发生。条件有两种类型：
  • 先决条件 - 在某一特定事件发生前延迟履行
  • 后决条件 - 一旦某一特定事件发生，则免除履行
如果其履行义务取决于先决条件的一方不正当地阻止该条件的发生——例如，通过违反诚信和公平交易的默示义务——那么该条件将被免除。换句话说，该条件无需再发生，该方的履行义务即到期。在本案中，购买房屋的协议是以买方在30天内获得融资的能力为条件的。诚信和公平交易的默示义务要求买方做出合理努力以获得融资。但由于买方完全没有努力去获得融资从而违反了该义务，该先决条件被免除，其履行义务也已到期。因此，法院很可能认定买方违约（选项A）。同时履行条件指每一方的履行义务都是另一方履行义务的先决条件时产生（即，当履行义务同时到期时）。

（选项B）如果承诺人可以选择是否履行承诺，那么该承诺就是虚幻的，因此不可强制执行——例如，如果买方承诺“如果我愿意的话”就购买房屋。然而，在本案中，买方的承诺并非虚幻，因为它默示地要求他在30天内努力获得融资。

（选项D）诚信和公平交易的义务并不要求买方必须购买房屋，而是要求他在30天内做出合理努力以获得融资。

教学目标：如果其履行义务取决于先决条件的一方不正当地阻止该条件的发生——例如，通过违反诚信和公平交易的默示义务——该条件将被免除，且该方必须履行其义务。

References

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Conditions
核心法律原则

诚信与公平交易的默示义务
(Implied Duty of Good Faith and Fair Dealing)

在任何合同中，双方都默示承诺不会做任何破坏对方获得合同利益权利的事情。当合同履行附带条件（如获得融资）时，受益方必须做出合理的努力 (Reasonable Efforts) 去促成该条件的发生。

案情逻辑分析

本案中，买卖合同包含一个先决条件 (Condition Precedent)：买方需在30天内获得抵押贷款融资。

  • 买方的行为： 买方声称“太忙了，没时间去申请”。这意味着他完全没有做出任何努力。
  • 法律后果： 买方的不作为违反了“诚信默示义务”。
  • 阻碍原则 (Prevention Doctrine)： 如果一方不正当地阻止了先决条件的发生（例如本案中故意不去申请贷款），法律将视为该条件已被免除 (Excused)。

结论： 条件被免除后，买方购买房屋的义务变为绝对义务。因其拒绝购买，构成违约。

✅ 正确答案：选项 C

法院会认定买方违约。因为合同中隐含了一个承诺，即买方必须做出合理的努力去获得抵押贷款融资。

买方不能利用自己未能履行诚信义务（不去申请贷款）这一事实，来主张合同条件未满足从而逃避责任。

为什么其他选项是错的？
❌ 选项 A (No breach due to condition failure)
虽然条件确实未发生（没拿到贷款），但这是买方自己的过错造成的。法律不允许当事人从自己的过错中获利 (One cannot benefit from one's own wrong)。
❌ 选项 B (Illusory Promise)
虚幻承诺 (Illusory Promise) 指的是一方可以随意选择是否履行（例如“如果我想买就买”）。这里并非虚幻，因为买方受“诚信义务”的约束，他必须去尝试申请贷款，这限制了他的自由，构成了有效的对价 (Consideration)。
❌ 选项 D (Obligation to purchase)
这个选项太绝对了。买方的义务是“努力去获得融资”，而不是绝对地保证“一定买下房子”。如果他努力了但银行拒绝放贷，他就不用买房且不构成违约。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧

看到 "Subject to financing"（以融资为条件）条款时，立刻联想两点：
  1. 这不是虚幻承诺 (Not Illusory)。
  2. 买方有义务去尝试 (Duty to try)。
如果题目说买方 "did nothing" 或 "changed his mind" 而不去申请贷款，他几乎总是输掉官司。
Reference: Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 225
NCBE / UWorld Educational Objective

questions.question:
A life coach entered into a contract with an introverted woman to provide a weeklong course that served as an introduction to the life coach's yearlong program. Under the terms of the contract, the life coach would work with the woman full-time for a week to start teaching her to interact with people with more confidence. The woman would then participate in a speed-dating event as her "graduation" from the course. The contract also provided that unless the woman received an offer for a second date at the speed-dating event, she had no obligation to pay for the introductory course. If she received an offer for a second date at the speed-dating event, she would be required to pay the life coach $1,000 within three days of the event.
After working with the life coach pursuant to the terms of the contract, the woman attended the speed-dating event. Four days after the event, when the woman still had not paid the life coach, the life coach brought a breach-of-contract action against the woman to recover $1,000 under the contract.
Which of the following best states the burden of proof that will apply in this case?

choices.a: Because the contract involved a condition precedent, the life coach must prove that the woman received an offer of a second date at the speed-dating event to recover.
choices.b: Because the contract involved a condition precedent, the woman must prove that she did not receive an offer of a second date at the speed-dating event to avoid liability.
choices.c: Because the contract involved a condition subsequent, the life coach must prove that the woman received an offer of a second date at the speed-dating event to recover.

A life coach entered into a contract with an introverted woman to provide a weeklong course that served as an introduction to the life coach's yearlong program. Under the terms of the contract, the life coach would work with the woman full-time for a week to start teaching her to interact with people with more confidence. The woman would then participate in a speed-dating event as her "graduation" from the course. The contract also provided that unless the woman received an offer for a second date at the speed-dating event, she had no obligation to pay for the introductory course. If she received an offer for a second date at the speed-dating event, she would be required to pay the life coach $1,000 within three days of the event.

After working with the life coach pursuant to the terms of the contract, the woman attended the speed-dating event. Four days after the event, when the woman still had not paid the life coach, the life coach brought a breach-of-contract action against the woman to recover $1,000 under the contract.

Which of the following best states the burden of proof that will apply in this case?

一位人生导师与一位内向的女士签订了一份合同，提供为期一周的课程，作为该人生导师为期一年项目的入门介绍。根据合同条款，该人生导师将与该女士进行为期一周的全职合作，教导她如何更自信地与人交往。之后，该女士将参加一个速配活动，作为其课程的“毕业典礼”。合同还规定，除非该女士在速配活动中收到第二次约会的要约，否则她没有义务支付入门课程的费用。如果她在速配活动中收到了第二次约会的要约，她必须在活动结束后的三天内向人生导师支付1000美元。

在依据合同条款与人生导师合作后，该女士参加了速配活动。活动结束四天后，由于该女士仍未向人生导师付款，人生导师对该女士提起了违约诉讼，要求根据合同追讨1000美元。

下列哪项最准确地陈述了适用于本案的举证责任？
options:
A. Because the contract involved a condition precedent, the life coach must prove that the woman received an offer of a second date at the speed-dating event to recover.
由于合同涉及先决条件，人生导师必须证明该女士在速配活动中收到了第二次约会的要约，方可胜诉。

B. Because the contract involved a condition precedent, the woman must prove that she did not receive an offer of a second date at the speed-dating event to avoid liability.
由于合同涉及先决条件，该女士必须证明她没有在速配活动中收到第二次约会的要约，方可免除责任。

C. Because the contract involved a condition subsequent, the life coach must prove that the woman received an offer of a second date at the speed-dating event to recover.
由于合同涉及后决条件，人生导师必须证明该女士在速配活动中收到了第二次约会的要约，方可胜诉。

D. Because the contract involved a condition subsequent, the woman must prove that she did not receive an offer of a second date at the speed-dating event to avoid liability.
由于合同涉及后决条件，该女士必须证明她没有在速配活动中收到第二次约会的要约，方可免除责任。
data.explanation:
Performance is generally due once a contract is formed - eg, when a mutual agreement is supported by valuable consideration. However, performance can be delayed or discharged by a condition - ie, an uncertain future event that must occur before performance becomes due or is discharged. There are two types of conditions:

Types of Conditions


Condition precedent †delaysperformance until a specified event occurs and requires the plaintiffto prove that the event occurred to prevail
Condition subsequentexcusesperformance once a specified event occurs and requires the defendantto prove that the event occurred to avoid liability
Here, the contract provided that the woman would be required to pay the life coach for the introductory course only if she received an offer for a second date at the speed-dating event. This created a condition precedent that delayed the woman's obligation to make that payment (Choices C & D). Therefore, the life coach must prove that the woman received an offer of a second date at the speed-dating event (ie, that the specified event occurred) to recover in his breach-of-contract action (Choice B).

† A condition concurrent arises when each party's obligation to perform is a condition precedent to the other party's obligation to perform (ie, when performance is due simultaneously).

Educational objective: A condition precedent delays performance until a specified event occurs and requires the plaintiff to prove that the event occurred to prevail. Conversely, a condition subsequent excuses performance once a specified event occurs and requires the defendant to prove that the event occurred to avoid liability.



选项正确率统计：A选项 57%（正确选项），B选项 12%，C选项 22%，D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

合同履行通常在合同成立时即到期——例如，当双方协议得到有价对价的支持时。然而，合同的履行可因某一条件而被延迟或免除——即，一个不确定的未来事件，该事件必须在履行到期或被免除之前发生。条件有两种类型：

条件的类型


先决条件 †延迟合同履行，直到特定事件发生，并要求原告证明该事件已发生才能胜诉
后决条件一旦特定事件发生，则免除合同履行，并要求被告证明该事件已发生以避免承担责任
在本案中，合同规定，该女士只有在速配活动中收到第二次约会的要约时，才需要向人生导师支付入门课程的费用。这创造了一个先决条件，延迟了该女士的付款义务（选项C和D）。因此，人生导师必须证明该女士在速配活动中收到了第二次约会的要约（即，特定事件已发生），才能在其违约诉讼中胜诉（选项B）。

† 当事双方的履行义务互为对方履行义务的先决条件时（即履行义务同时到期），便产生了并行条件。

教学目标：先决条件延迟合同履行，直到特定事件发生，并要求原告证明该事件已发生才能胜诉。相反，后决条件在特定事件发生后免除合同履行，并要求被告证明该事件已发生以避免承担责任。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 224 - 30 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (conditions related to performance).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析
合同法：条件与举证责任

正确答案：选项 A 由于合同涉及先决条件 (Condition Precedent)，人生导师（原告）必须证明该女士在速配活动中收到了第二次约会的要约，方可胜诉。

1. 核心法律规则解析

本题的核心考点在于区分先决条件与后决条件，以及它们对举证责任 (Burden of Proof) 的影响。

先决条件 (Condition Precedent)
是指在合同义务产生或变得可执行之前，必须发生的事件。如果该事件不发生，义务就不存在。

举证规则：由寻求执行合同的一方（通常是原告）承担举证责任，证明该条件已满足。

后决条件 (Condition Subsequent)
是指在合同义务已经产生后，如果发生该事件，则免除或终止该义务。

举证规则：由寻求免除责任的一方（通常是被告）承担举证责任，证明该条件已发生。

2. 案情具体分析

在本案中，我们需要分析付款义务是如何产生的：

  • 合同条款：“除非...收到第二次约会的要约，否则...没有义务支付。” / “如果...收到...要约，她必须...支付。”
  • 逻辑判断：女士的付款义务并不是一开始就存在的。只有当“收到第二次约会要约”这一事件发生时，付款义务才被触发 (Triggered)。
  • 结论：这是一个典型的先决条件。

因此，作为原告的人生导师（Life Coach）想要拿到钱，就必须证明触发付款义务的事件（收到要约）确实发生了。

3. 考点对比记忆表

类型 先决条件
(Precedent)		 后决条件
(Subsequent)
定义 事件发生前，义务未到期 事件发生后，义务被免除
关键词 "If", "Provided that", "On condition that" "Unless", "Until", "But if"
举证责任 原告 (Plaintiff)
需证明条件已发生		 被告 (Defendant)
需证明条件已发生

4. 排除错误选项

  • 选项 B 错误：虽然识别出了是先决条件，但搞反了举证责任。被告不需要证明条件未发生；原告必须证明条件已发生。
  • 选项 C 和 D 错误：这并非后决条件。后决条件通常表现为：“现在必须付款，但如果下周下雨，钱退还给你。”本案中，付款义务尚未形成，直到约会要约出现。
💡 MBE 实战技巧：
在做此类题目时，问自己一个问题：“现在的状态是‘欠债’还是‘不欠债’？”
  • 如果现在的状态是“不欠债”，必须发生某事才变成“欠债” → 先决条件（原告举证）。
  • 如果现在的状态是“欠债”，发生某事就变成“不欠债” → 后决条件（被告举证）。

questions.question:
On June 1, a seller and a buyer contracted in writing for the sale and purchase of the seller's cattle ranch (a large single tract), and to close the transaction on December 1. On October 1, the buyer told the seller, "I'm increasingly unhappy about our June 1 contract because of the current cattle market, and do not intend to buy your ranch unless I'm legally obligated to do so."
On October 15, the seller sued the buyer for breach of contract.
Is the seller likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the buyer's October 1 statement to the seller was neither a repudiation nor a present breach of the June 1 contract.
choices.b: No, because the parties contracted for the sale and conveyance of a single tract, and the seller cannot bring suit for breach of such a contract prior to the agreed closing date.
choices.c: Yes, because the buyer committed a total breach by anticipatory repudiation on October 1.
choices.d: Yes, because the buyer's October 1 statement created reasonable grounds for the seller's insecurity with respect to the buyer's performance.

6月1日，卖方和买方就卖方的养牛牧场（一大片单块土地）的买卖签订了书面合同，并约定于12月1日完成交易。10月1日，买方告诉卖方：“鉴于当前的牛市行情，我对我们6月1日的合同越来越不满意，并且不打算购买你的牧场，除非法律强制我这样做。”

10月15日，卖方以违约为由起诉买方。

卖方胜诉的可能性大吗？
options:
A. No, because the buyer's October 1 statement to the seller was neither a repudiation nor a present breach of the June 1 contract.
不大，因为买方10月1日的声明既不构成对6月1日合同的毁约，也不构成即时违约。

B. No, because the parties contracted for the sale and conveyance of a single tract, and the seller cannot bring suit for breach of such a contract prior to the agreed closing date.
不大，因为双方签订的是单块土地的出售和转让合同，卖方不能在约定的交割日之前就此类合同的违约提起诉讼。

C. Yes, because the buyer committed a total breach by anticipatory repudiation on October 1.
很大，因为买方在10月1日通过预期毁约构成了完全违约。

D. Yes, because the buyer's October 1 statement created reasonable grounds for the seller's insecurity with respect to the buyer's performance.
很大，因为买方10月1日的声明为卖方就买方履约的不安全感提供了合理的理由。
data.explanation:
Anticipatory repudiation


StandardParty's clear & unequivocal words or actions indicate unwillingness to perform
RetractionParty may retract repudiation unless nonrepudiating party:
  • cancels contract
  • materially changes position in reliance thereon or
  • indicates repudiation is final
EffectUpon repudiation, nonrepudiating party may:
  • treat repudiation as breach or
  • ignore repudiation & demand performance
Nonrepudiating party may also suspend own performance

A party's failure to perform his/her contractual duties at the time performance is due constitutes a breach. A breach can also occur before the time for performance arises or elapses under the doctrine of anticipatory repudiation. This doctrine applies when a party clearly and unequivocally, by words or acts, indicates an unwillingness to perform his/her contractual duties. The nonrepudiating party may treat the repudiation as a breach or ignore it and demand performance pursuant to the contract.

Here, the buyer's October 1 statement was not a present breach of the contract since performance is not due until December 1. And though the buyer stated that she did "not intend to buy" the seller's ranch, that statement was not an anticipatory repudiation. That is because the statement included the equivocal phrase "unless I'm legally obligated to do so" (Choice C). Therefore, the seller is unlikely to prevail.

(Choice B) The doctrine of anticipatory repudiation allows a party to sue for breach of any contract before the time for performance is due - including contracts for the sale of a single tract of property before the closing date.

(Choice D) The buyer's statement created reasonable grounds for the seller's insecurity with respect to the buyer's performance. However, the seller's recourse in this situation is to demand adequate assurances. If the buyer fails to provide such assurances, the buyer will be deemed to have anticipatorily repudiated the contract. The seller can then treat the repudiation as a breach.

Educational objective: The doctrine of anticipatory repudiation applies when a contracting party clearly and unequivocally indicates an unwillingness to perform. The nonrepudiating party may treat the repudiation as a breach or ignore it and demand performance pursuant to the contract.

选项正确率统计：A选项 68%（正确选项），B选项 13%，C选项 10%，D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

预期毁约 (Anticipatory repudiation)


标准一方当事人以明确无误的言词或行为表示其不愿履行合同
撤回一方当事人可以撤回其毁约，除非未毁约方已经：
  • 取消合同
  • 因信赖该毁约而使其处境发生重大改变 或
  • 表示该毁约是最终决定
效力一旦发生毁约，未毁约方可以：
  • 将毁约视为违约 或
  • 忽略毁约并要求履行
未毁约方也可以中止自己的履行

一方当事人在履约到期时未能履行其合同义务，即构成违约。根据预期毁约 (anticipatory repudiation) 原则，违约也可能在履约时间到来或经过之前发生。该原则适用于一方当事人以明确无误的言词或行为表示不愿履行其合同义务的情况。未毁约方可将该毁约视为违约，或予以忽略并要求对方根据合同履行。

在本案中，买方10月1日的声明不构成即时违约，因为履约日期是12月1日。尽管买方表示她“不打算购买”卖方的牧场，但该声明并不构成预期毁约。这是因为该声明包含了模棱两可的表述“除非法律强制我这样做”（选项C）。因此，卖方胜诉的可能性不大。

（选项B）预期毁约原则允许一方当事人在履约到期前就任何合同的违约提起诉讼——包括在交割日之前就单块土地的出售合同提起诉讼。

（选项D）买方的声明为卖方对买方履约的不安全感提供了合理的理由。然而，在这种情况下，卖方的补救措施是要求对方提供充分的保证。如果买方未能提供此类保证，则买方将被视为已预期毁约。届时，卖方可将该毁约视为违约。

教学目标：预期毁约原则适用于合同一方当事人明确无误地表示不愿履行合同的情况。未毁约方可将该毁约视为违约，或予以忽略并要求对方根据合同履行。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 250 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (repudiation).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 253 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (effect of an anticipatory repudiation).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Anticipatory Repudiation
⚖️ 核心法则：预期毁约 (Anticipatory Repudiation)

根据普通法和 UCC，预期毁约必须是明确且毫不含糊 (Clear and Unequivocal) 的声明或行为，表明当事人将不会履行合同义务。

仅仅是表达疑虑、抱怨困难或模棱两可的陈述，不构成预期毁约。

🔍 案情关键点分析

买方说了两句话，我们需要拆解分析：

  1. "I do not intend to buy your ranch..."
    （我不打算买你的牧场……）
    👉 听起来像毁约。
  2. "...unless I'm legally obligated to do so."
    （……除非法律强制我这样做。）
    👉 关键转折！

这句话加上了条件 (Condition)。买方实际上是在说：“虽然我不想买，但如果合同具有法律约束力，我还是会履行的。”

这表明买方承认了合同的约束力，并没有绝对地 (Absolutely) 拒绝履行。因此，这不符合“明确且毫不含糊”的标准。

💡 选项深度解析

正确答案 A 逻辑推导：

由于买方的声明是附带条件的（"unless..."），它不是明确的毁约。既然没有毁约，而合同约定的履行时间（12月1日）尚未到来，因此目前不存在违约 (Present Breach)。卖方在10月15日提起诉讼为时过早。

陷阱选项 D 为什么这是最强的干扰项？

选项 D 提到买方的声明引发了卖方的“不安全感” (Reasonable grounds for insecurity)。这是事实。

但是：根据法律（Restatement § 251），当一方产生合理的不安全感时，正确的救济手段是要求履约保证 (Demand Adequate Assurances)，而不是立即起诉违约。

只有当买方未能在合理时间内提供保证时，才会被视为预期毁约。卖方直接起诉是错误的程序。

🎓 MBE 抢分技巧

在处理 Anticipatory Repudiation 题目时，请寻找以下信号词：

  • 毁约 (Repudiation): "I will not perform," "The deal is off." (绝对语气)
  • 非毁约 (Mere Grumbling): "I'm not sure if I can," "It looks difficult," "Unless..." (犹豫或附带条件)

如果对方只是“犹豫”，你只能要求保证 (Demand Assurances)，不能立即起诉！

The owner of an apartment complex contracted in writing with a landscaper to install a sprinkler system for $20,000. The contract required the landscaper to install a specific brand of brass sprinkler heads. It also required the landscaper to install a $500 anti-backflow device, which was required by the city plumbing code but would not affect the sprinkler system's performance.
In order to speed up installation, the landscaper installed the sprinkler system using brass sprinkler heads left over from a previous job that, while not the brand specifically required by the contract, were equal in quality and performance. However, the landscaper did not install the anti-backflow device, even though the city plumbing code required it and the owner could be subject to a fine if the device were not installed.
The landscaper completed the installation work and then sought payment from the owner. The owner refused to pay the landscaper anything on the ground that the work did not comply with the contract.
If the landscaper sues the owner for breach of contract, what is the likely result?

choices.a: The landscaper will not recover, because he willfully and materially breached the contract.
choices.b: The landscaper will recover restitution for the cost spent on labor and materials.
choices.c: The landscaper will recover the contract price less the cost to remedy any defects in performance.
choices.d: The landscaper will recover the full contract price.

一个公寓小区的业主与一名景观设计师签订了一份书面合同，约定以20,000美元的价格安装一套喷淋系统。合同要求景观设计师安装特定品牌的黄铜喷头。合同还要求景观设计师安装一个价值500美元的防回流装置，该装置是城市管道法规所要求的，但不会影响喷淋系统的性能。

为了加快安装速度，景观设计师使用了上一个项目中剩余的黄铜喷头来安装该喷淋系统，这些喷头虽然不是合同明确要求的品牌，但在质量和性能上是相同的。然而，景观设计师没有安装防回流装置，尽管城市管道法规要求安装，且如果不安装该装置，业主可能会被处以罚款。

景观设计师完成了安装工作，然后向业主要求付款。业主以工程不符合合同为由，拒绝向景观设计师支付任何费用。

如果景观设计师以违约为由起诉业主，最可能的结果是什么？
options:
A. The landscaper will not recover, because he willfully and materially breached the contract.
景观设计师将无法获得赔偿，因为他故意且实质性地违反了合同。

B. The landscaper will recover restitution for the cost spent on labor and materials.
景观设计师将获得相当于其在劳工和材料上花费的成本的返还利益（restitution）。

C. The landscaper will recover the contract price less the cost to remedy any defects in performance.
景观设计师将获得合同价格减去弥补履约中任何瑕疵所需成本后的金额。

D. The landscaper will recover the full contract price.
景观设计师将获得全部合同价格。
data.explanation:
Substantial performance is less than full performance that, while imperfect, does not defeat the contract's main purpose. Under the common law - which governs contracts for services (eg, installing a sprinkler system) - a party that has substantially performed can recover damages based on the contract if the other party fails to perform.† Those damages are generally equal to the contract price minus the cost to remedy any defects in performance.

Here, the landscaper imperfectly performed by using the wrong brand of sprinkler heads and not installing the anti-backflow device. However, this did not defeat the contract's main purpose of providing the owner with a working sprinkler system. That is because the sprinkler heads were equal in quality and performance to the ones called for in the contract and the anti-backflow device did not affect performance. Therefore, the landscaper substantially performed and will likely recover the contract price less the cost to remedy any defects in performance (Choice D).

†In contrast, the Uniform Commercial Code requires "perfect tender," and substantial performance of a sale-of-goods contract does not allow a party to recover damages based on the contract except for installment contracts or when the parties agree otherwise.

(Choice A) The extent to which a party has acted in bad faith (eg, by committing a willful breach) is one of several factors that courts consider in deciding whether a breach is material. Here, although the landscaper's breach was willful, it was not material since he fulfilled the contract's main purpose.

(Choice B) A party's failure to substantially perform the contract is a material breach. A party in material breach cannot recover on the contract but may be entitled to restitution damages for the reasonable value of benefits conferred on the other party - eg, the cost spent on labor and materials. But here, the landscaper did substantially perform so there was no material breach.

Educational objective: At common law, a party that has substantially performed - ie, rendered imperfect performance without defeating the contract's main purpose - can recover the contract price less the cost to remedy any defects in performance.



选项正确率统计：A选项 32%，B选项 15%，C选项 51%（正确选项），D选项 0%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

实质性履行 (Substantial performance) 是一种低于完全履行的履约行为，虽然存在瑕疵，但并未挫败合同的主要目的。根据普通法 (common law)——该法管辖服务合同（例如，安装喷淋系统）——如果一方已实质性履约，而另一方未能履约，则已履约方可以根据合同获得损害赔偿。† 这些损害赔偿通常等于合同价格减去弥补履约中任何瑕疵所需的成本。

在本案中，景观设计师使用了错误品牌的喷头并且没有安装防回流装置，其履约存在瑕疵。然而，这并未挫败合同为业主提供一个可正常工作的喷淋系统的主要目的。这是因为所用喷头在质量和性能上与合同要求的喷头相同，且防回流装置不影响系统性能。因此，景观设计师构成了实质性履行，并且很可能获得合同价格减去弥补履约瑕疵成本后的金额（选项C）。

†相比之下，《统一商法典》(Uniform Commercial Code) 要求“完美交付 (perfect tender)”，在货物买卖合同中，实质性履行通常不允许一方根据合同获得损害赔偿，除非是分期付款合同或双方另有约定。

（选项A）一方当事人的恶意程度（例如，故意违约）是法院在判断违约行为是否构成实质性违约时所考虑的几个因素之一。在本案中，尽管景观设计师的违约是故意的，但由于他实现了合同的主要目的，因此该违约不构成实质性违约。

（选项B）一方未能实质性履行合同即构成实质性违约。实质性违约方不能根据合同获得赔偿，但可能有权就其赋予另一方的利益的合理价值获得返还利益赔偿（restitution damages）——例如，在劳工和材料上花费的成本。但在本案中，景观设计师确实构成了实质性履行，因此不存在实质性违约。

教学目标：在普通法下，一方如果已经实质性履行——即其履约虽有瑕疵但未挫败合同的主要目的——则可以获得合同价格减去弥补履约中任何瑕疵所需成本后的金额。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 237 cmt. d (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (effect of substantial performance).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 241 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (factors used to determine whether a breach of contract is material).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

合同法：实质性履行与违约救济
核心考点：实质性履行 (Substantial Performance) 在普通法（Common Law）管辖的服务或建筑合同中，如果一方完成了合同的主要义务，仅存在轻微瑕疵，未挫败合同主要目的，则视为实质性履行。
⚖️ 法律规则分析

本题适用普通法 (Common Law)，因为涉及的是服务/建筑合同（安装喷淋系统），而非货物买卖（UCC）。

1. 完美交付 vs. 实质性履行
UCC 要求“完美交付 (Perfect Tender)”，但普通法不要求完美。只要违约方没有发生实质性违约 (Material Breach)，另一方就必须履行付款义务，但可以扣除损害赔偿。
2. 本案事实认定
  • 喷头品牌：虽然品牌不对，但质量和性能相同。这属于轻微违约。
  • 防回流装置：虽然未安装，但仅值$500（合同总额$20,000），且不影响系统运作。这可以通过金钱赔偿轻松补救。
3. 结论
景观设计师的行为构成了实质性履行。业主得到了一个运作良好的喷淋系统（合同的主要利益）。
📚 经典判例联想

本题是著名的 Jacob & Youngs, Inc. v. Kent (1921) 案的翻版。在该案中，建筑商使用了错误的管道品牌（Cohoes而非Reading），但质量相同。卡多佐法官（Cardozo）裁定这属于实质性履行，业主必须付款，赔偿额为价值差额（本案中为零），而非重修成本。

🔍 选项深度解析
正确 选项 C

理由：由于构成了实质性履行，业主不能免除付款义务。但是，业主有权获得损害赔偿以弥补瑕疵。
计算公式：合同价格 ($20,000) - 补救缺陷的成本 (安装防回流装置的$500 + 任何因品牌变更导致的价值损失)。

错误 选项 A (故意违约)

虽然设计师是为了“加快进度”而故意使用旧喷头，但在判断是否构成“实质性违约”时，故意 (Willfulness) 只是考量因素之一，并非决定性因素。如果违约极其轻微且未影响合同核心价值，即使是故意的，通常仍被视为实质性履行。

错误 选项 B (返还利益)

Restitution (返还利益/不当得利) 通常适用于实质性违约方无法根据合同索赔，只能请求返还已提供劳务价值的情况。本案中设计师已实质性履行，应按合同索赔，而非按Restitution。

错误 选项 D (全额付款)

实质性履行不代表完美履行。业主有权从合同价格中扣除因未安装防回流装置而产生的损失（即找人安装该装置的成本）。

MBE 解题技巧：
看到建筑/服务合同 + 细微瑕疵 (Minor Defect)
👉 优先考虑 Substantial Performance。
赔偿金通常是 "Cost of Repair" (修复成本)。

questions.question:
In a single writing, a painter contracted with a farmer to paint three identical barns on her rural estate for $2,000 each. The contract provided for the farmer's payment of $6,000 upon the painter's completion of the work on all three barns. The painter did not ask for any payment when the first barn was completely painted, but she demanded $4,000 after painting the second barn.
Is the farmer obligated to make the $4,000 payment?

choices.a: No, because the farmer has no duty under the contract to pay anything to the painter until all three barns have been painted.
choices.b: No, because the painter waived her right, if any, to payment on a per-barn basis by failing to demand $2,000 upon completion of the first barn.
choices.c: Yes, because the contract is divisible.
choices.d: Yes, because the painter has substantially performed the entire contract.

data.questionStem:
Q81183

In a single writing, a painter contracted with a farmer to paint three identical barns on her rural estate for $2,000 each. The contract provided for the farmer's payment of $6,000 upon the painter's completion of the work on all three barns. The painter did not ask for any payment when the first barn was completely painted, but she demanded $4,000 after painting the second barn.

Is the farmer obligated to make the $4,000 payment?

在一份单一书面文件中，一名油漆工与一名农场主签订合同，为其乡村庄园的三个相同谷仓进行粉刷，每个谷仓收费2,000美元。合同规定，农场主应在油漆工完成所有三个谷仓的粉刷工作后支付6,000美元。在第一个谷仓完全粉刷完毕时，油漆工并未要求任何付款，但在粉刷完第二个谷仓后，她要求支付4,000美元。

农场主是否有义务支付这4,000美元？
options:
A. No, because the farmer has no duty under the contract to pay anything to the painter until all three barns have been painted.
否，因为根据合同，在所有三个谷仓都粉刷完毕之前，农场主没有义务向油漆工支付任何款项。

B. No, because the painter waived her right, if any, to payment on a per-barn basis by failing to demand $2,000 upon completion of the first barn.
否，因为油漆工在完成第一个谷仓后未能要求支付2,000美元，从而放弃了她可能拥有的按每个谷仓为基础获得付款的权利。

C. Yes, because the contract is divisible.
是，因为该合同是可分割的。

D. Yes, because the painter has substantially performed the entire contract.
是，因为油漆工已实质性履行了整个合同。
data.explanation:
Order of performances


Simultaneous performance possibleCondition concurrent implied (ie, performance due simultaneously)
One performance requires timeCondition precedent implied (ie, durational performance due before respective duty triggered)
†These rules apply unless express contractual language or circumstances indicate otherwise.

When a party performs one part of a divisible contract, the party is entitled to the agreed equivalent for that part - even if the party fails to perform the other parts of the contract. In other words, that party's performance of the entire contract is not a condition precedent to the other party's duty to perform. A contract is divisible if:
  • the parties' duties can be broken down into at least two corresponding pairs of performances and those pairs of performances can fairly be regarded as agreed (ie, bargained-for) equivalents.
Although courts prefer to interpret contracts as divisible for reasons having to do with fairness, they will not do so if the contract expressly states that it is indivisible.

Here, the parties' contract provided that the farmer had no duty to pay the painter anything until she had painted all three barns. As a result, the contract was expressly indivisible, and the painter's completion of the work on all three barns was a condition precedent to the farmer's duty to pay. Therefore, the farmer is not obligated to pay the painter $4,000 (ie, $2,000 per barn for two barns) (Choice C).

(Choice B) The painter did not have a right to expect payment for each barn, so she could not waive such a right.

(Choice D) The painter did not substantially perform the contract since she failed to paint one of the three barns - a significant part of the performance for which the farmer contracted.

Educational objective: Although courts prefer to interpret contracts as divisible for fairness reasons, they will not do so in contradiction of the express terms of the contract.

选项正确率统计：A选项 67%（正确选项），B选项 6%，C选项 22%，D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

履行顺序


可同时履行默示的同时履行条件（即，履行义务应同时到期）
一方的履行需要时间默示的先决条件（即，持续性履行义务在相应义务触发前到期）
†这些规则适用，除非合同的明确语言或具体情况另有规定。

当一方当事人履行了可分割合同的一部分时，该方有权获得该部分的约定对等给付——即使该方未能履行合同的其他部分。换言之，该方当事人对整个合同的履行并不是另一方当事人履行义务的先决条件。一份合同是可分割的，如果：
  • 双方的义务可以被分解为至少两对相应的履行，并且这些成对的履行可以被合理地视为约定的（即，协商议定的）对等给付。
尽管法院出于公平的考虑倾向于将合同解释为可分割的，但如果合同明确规定其不可分割，法院则不会这样做。

在此案中，双方的合同规定，在油漆工粉刷完所有三个谷仓之前，农场主没有义务向其支付任何款项。因此，该合同是明确不可分割的，油漆工完成所有三个谷仓的工作是农场主付款义务的先决条件。因此，农场主没有义务支付给油漆工4,000美元（即，两个谷仓每个2,000美元）(选项C)。

(选项B) 油漆工无权期望就每个谷仓获得付款，因此她不能放弃这样一项权利。

(选项D) 油漆工并未实质性履行合同，因为她未能粉刷三个谷仓中的一个——这是农场主签约要求履行的一个重要部分。

教学目标：尽管法院出于公平的考虑倾向于将合同解释为可分割的，但如果这样做与合同的明确条款相抵触，法院则不会如此解释。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 234 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (order of performances).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 240 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (part performances as agreed equivalents).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance & Breach
正确答案：A 否，因为根据合同，在所有三个谷仓都粉刷完毕之前，农场主没有义务向油漆工支付任何款项。
核心考点：合同的可分割性 vs. 明确条款

本题的核心在于判断合同是可分割的 (Divisible) 还是不可分割的 (Entire/Indivisible)。

虽然通常情况下，如果工作可以按单位划分（如3个谷仓，每个$2,000），法院倾向于认定合同是可分割的。但是，合同的明确语言 (Express Language) 具有最高效力。

法律推理分析

1. 默示条件 (Implied Conditions)：
根据《合同法重述（第二版）》(Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 234)，如果一方的履行需要时间（如刷漆），而另一方的履行是付款，那么完成工作通常是付款的先决条件 (Condition Precedent)。

2. 明确条款覆盖默认规则：
本案中，合同明确规定："payment of $6,000 upon the painter's completion of the work on all three barns"（在完成所有三个谷仓的工作后支付6,000美元）。

这一条款明确设立了一个先决条件：必须完成所有三个谷仓，付款义务才会被触发。因此，即使油漆工完成了两个，由于未满足合同约定的先决条件，农场主此时尚无付款义务。

为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 C (Divisible) 错误：

虽然这看起来像是一个可分割合同（每个谷仓对应$2,000），但法院不会在合同有明确相反规定的情况下强行将其解释为可分割合同。这里的付款条款明确将合同定性为不可分割。

选项 D (Substantial Performance) 错误：

实质性履行 (Substantial Performance) 通常适用于建筑合同中存在细微瑕疵的情况。这里油漆工只完成了2/3的工作，遗漏了整整一个谷仓，这属于重大违约 (Material Breach)，而非实质性履行。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

在处理合同题时，永远先看明确的合同条款 (Express Terms)。即使普通法有倾向于公平的默认规则（如倾向于认定合同可分割以避免不当得利），明确的合同语言（"upon completion of all..."）几乎总是会覆盖这些默认规则。

questions.question:
A fugitive was wanted for murder. The authorities offered the following reward: "$20,000 to anyone who provides information leading to the arrest and conviction of this fugitive." A private detective knew of the reward, located the fugitive, and brought him to the authorities, who arrested him. The authorities then determined that although the fugitive had, in fact, committed the crime, he had been directed to do so by his boss. The authorities and the fugitive then agreed that in exchange for the fugitive's testimony against his boss, all charges against the fugitive would be dropped. The fugitive testified and was released. The authorities refused to pay the reward to the private detective on the ground that the fugitive was never convicted.
Would the private detective be likely to prevail in a breach of contract action against the authorities?

choices.a: No, because the express conditions set out in the reward offer were not met.
choices.b: No, because the private detective failed to notify the authorities that he had accepted the reward offer.
choices.c: Yes, because the authorities' agreement with the fugitive was against public policy.
choices.d: Yes, because the authorities themselves prevented the conviction of the fugitive.

Q81178

A fugitive was wanted for murder. The authorities offered the following reward: "$20,000 to anyone who provides information leading to the arrest and conviction of this fugitive." A private detective knew of the reward, located the fugitive, and brought him to the authorities, who arrested him. The authorities then determined that although the fugitive had, in fact, committed the crime, he had been directed to do so by his boss. The authorities and the fugitive then agreed that in exchange for the fugitive's testimony against his boss, all charges against the fugitive would be dropped. The fugitive testified and was released. The authorities refused to pay the reward to the private detective on the ground that the fugitive was never convicted.

Would the private detective be likely to prevail in a breach of contract action against the authorities?

一名逃犯因谋杀罪被通缉。当局发布了以下悬赏：“向任何提供导致该逃犯被逮捕和定罪信息的人士提供20,000美元。”一名私家侦探知晓此悬赏，找到了该逃犯，并将其带至当局，当局随即将他逮捕。随后，当局确定，尽管该逃犯确实犯下了罪行，但他是在其老板的指使下所为。于是，当局与该逃犯达成协议，以换取该逃犯指证其老板的证词为条件，撤销对该逃犯的所有指控。该逃犯作证后被释放。当局以该逃犯从未被定罪为由，拒绝向私家侦探支付赏金。

在对当局提起的违约诉讼中，该私家侦探是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the express conditions set out in the reward offer were not met.
否，因为悬赏要约中列明的明示条件未被满足。

B. No, because the private detective failed to notify the authorities that he had accepted the reward offer.
否，因为私家侦探未能通知当局他已接受悬赏要约。

C. Yes, because the authorities' agreement with the fugitive was against public policy.
是，因为当局与逃犯达成的协议违反了公共政策。

D. Yes, because the authorities themselves prevented the conviction of the fugitive.
是，因为当局自己阻止了对该逃犯的定罪。
data.explanation:
When nonoccurrence of condition is excused


WaiverParty waives condition by words or conduct
WrongfulinterferenceParty wrongfully prevents or interferes with condition's occurrence
EstoppelParty indicates condition will not be enforced AND Other party reasonably & detrimentally relies on belief that condition has been waived
Disproportionateforfeiture
A party may generally avoid performance until a condition precedent - ie, an uncertain future event that must occur before either or both party's performance becomes due - has occurred. The nonoccurrence of a condition may be excused , however, if the party protected by the condition wrongfully prevents or interferes with its occurrence (eg, through a breach of the implied duty of good faith and fair dealing).

Here, the authorities' duty to pay the reward was subject to two conditions precedent - the arrest and conviction of the fugitive. The implied duty of good faith and fair dealing imposed a duty on the authorities to refrain from hindering either condition's occurrence. However, they breached that duty by agreeing to drop all charges against the fugitive despite their determination that he had committed the crime, thus excusing the condition of conviction. Therefore, the detective's suit will likely prevail (Choice A).

(Choice B) In a unilateral contract, an offeree who accepts by completing the requested performance must give notice if he/she has reason to know that the completed performance will not come to the offeror's attention within a reasonable time. Here, there was no need for the detective to notify the authorities that he had accepted their reward offer because they learned of his performance when he brought the fugitive to them.

(Choice C) Whether the authorities' agreement with the fugitive was against public policy goes to the enforceability of the agreement between the fugitive and the authorities; it has no bearing on the outcome of this dispute.

Educational objective: The nonoccurrence of a condition may be excused if the party protected by the condition wrongfully prevents or interferes with its occurrence (eg, through a breach of the implied duty of good faith and fair dealing).

选项正确率统计：A选项 17%，B选项 0%，C选项 1%，D选项 80%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

条件不发生可被豁免的情形


弃权 (Waiver)当事人以言语或行为放弃条件
不法干涉 (Wrongfulinterference)当事人不法阻止或干涉条件的发生
禁止反言 (Estoppel)当事人表示条件将不被强制执行，且另一方合理地、有损害地信赖该条件已被放弃的信念
不相称的权利丧失 (Disproportionateforfeiture)
一方当事人通常可以不履行义务，直到先决条件（condition precedent）——即在一方或双方当事人的履行义务到期前必须发生的不确定未来事件——已经发生。但是，如果受该条件保护的一方当事人不法地阻止或干涉其发生（例如，通过违反默示的善意与公平交易义务），条件的不发生可以被豁免 (excused)。

在本案中，当局支付赏金的义务受制于两个先决条件——逃犯的逮捕和定罪。默示的善意与公平交易义务 (implied duty of good faith and fair dealing) 要求当局有责任避免阻碍任一条件的发生。然而，他们违反了该义务，在确定逃犯已犯罪的情况下，仍同意撤销对其的所有指控，从而豁免了定罪这一条件。因此，该侦探的诉讼很可能胜诉（选项D）。

（选项B）在单方合同 (unilateral contract) 中，如果受要约人 (offeree) 有理由知道其完成的履行行为在合理时间内不会引起要约人 (offeror) 的注意，则以完成被请求的履行行为作为承诺的受要约人必须发出通知。在本案中，侦探无需通知当局他已接受其悬赏要约，因为当他将逃犯带到当局时，他们已经知晓了他的履行行为。

（选项C）当局与逃犯的协议是否违反公共政策，关系到该逃犯与当局之间协议的可执行性；它对本争议的结果没有影响。

教学目的：如果受条件保护的一方当事人不法地阻止或干涉条件的发生（例如，通过违反默示的善意与公平交易义务），则条件的不发生可被豁免。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 224 - 25 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (conditions and effect of non-occurrence).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 245 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (when a party's wrongful interference excuses a condition).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Conditions & Breach
核心法律规则
条件的不法干涉 (Wrongful Prevention of Condition)

如果一方当事人的义务取决于某个先决条件 (Condition Precedent)的发生，而该当事人不法地阻止或干扰了该条件的发生，那么该条件被视为已豁免 (Excused)。

依据：Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 245
本案逻辑推演
1. 合同类型：
这是一个单方合同 (Unilateral Contract)。当局发出悬赏要约 (Offer)，侦探通过履行行为 (Performance) 进行承诺。
2. 付款条件：
当局支付$20,000的义务受制于两个条件：
  • 逃犯被逮捕 (Arrest) ✅
  • 逃犯被定罪 (Conviction) ❌
3. 关键转折：
当局为了抓捕“大鱼”（老板），主动与逃犯达成协议撤销指控。这意味着当局主动阻止了“定罪”这一条件的发生。
4. 法律后果：
根据默示的善意与公平交易义务 (Implied Duty of Good Faith and Fair Dealing)，当局不能利用自己阻止条件发生的事实来逃避付款义务。因此，“定罪”这一条件被豁免，当局必须付款。
选项深度解析
✅ 选项 D (正确答案)
"Yes, because the authorities themselves prevented the conviction..."
这是对上述规则的直接应用。当义务人（当局）通过自己的行为使得条件无法达成时，他们不能以此为由拒绝履行合同。
❌ 选项 A (错误)
虽然表面上明示条件 (Express Conditions) 未满足，但法律不允许当事人通过“搞破坏”来利用这一规则。此选项忽略了“条件豁免”的例外情况。
❌ 选项 B (错误)
在悬赏这种单方合同中，通常不需要预先通知接受要约 (Notice of Acceptance)。只要完成了指定行为（带回逃犯），且要约人知晓该行为（当局接收了逃犯），合同即成立。
❌ 选项 C (错误)
当局与逃犯的协议是否违反公共政策 (Public Policy) 是另一个法律问题，它不影响侦探与当局之间的合同效力。
💡 MBE 考试技巧：
看到“悬赏 (Reward)”题目时，注意寻找当事人是否恶意阻碍了条件的达成。如果是因为一方的干涉导致条件失败，该方通常会败诉。

questions.question:
A sailor owns an exceptionally seaworthy boat that she charters for sport fishing at a $500 daily rate. The fee includes the use of the boat with the sailor as the captain, and one other crew member, as well as fishing tackle and bait. On May 1, a customer agreed with the sailor that the customer would have the full-day use of the boat on May 15 for himself and his family for $500. The customer paid an advance deposit of $200 and signed an agreement that the deposit could be retained by the sailor as liquidated damages in the event the customer canceled or failed to appear. On May 15 at 1:00 a.m., the Coast Guard issued offshore "heavy weather" warnings and prohibited all small vessels the size of the sailor's boat from leaving the harbor. This prohibition remained in effect throughout the day. The customer did not appear at all on May 15, because he had heard the weather warnings on his radio.
Which of the following is an accurate statement of the parties' legal relationship?

choices.a: The contract is discharged because of impossibility, and the customer is entitled to return of his deposit.
choices.b: The contract is discharged because of mutual mistake concerning an essential fact, and the customer is entitled to return of his deposit.
choices.c: The contract is not discharged, and the customer is not entitled to return of his deposit, because the liquidated-damage clause in effect allocated the risk of bad weather to the customer.
choices.d: The contract is not discharged, because its performance was possible in view of the exceptional seaworthiness of the sailor's boat, and the customer is not entitled to return of his deposit.

data.questionStem:
Q81152

A sailor owns an exceptionally seaworthy boat that she charters for sport fishing at a $500 daily rate. The fee includes the use of the boat with the sailor as the captain, and one other crew member, as well as fishing tackle and bait. On May 1, a customer agreed with the sailor that the customer would have the full-day use of the boat on May 15 for himself and his family for $500. The customer paid an advance deposit of $200 and signed an agreement that the deposit could be retained by the sailor as liquidated damages in the event the customer canceled or failed to appear. On May 15 at 1:00 a.m., the Coast Guard issued offshore "heavy weather" warnings and prohibited all small vessels the size of the sailor's boat from leaving the harbor. This prohibition remained in effect throughout the day. The customer did not appear at all on May 15, because he had heard the weather warnings on his radio.

Which of the following is an accurate statement of the parties' legal relationship?

一名水手拥有一艘异常适航的船，她以每日500美元的费率出租该船用于运动钓鱼。费用包括使用该船，由该水手担任船长，并配备另一名船员，以及渔具和鱼饵。5月1日，一名顾客与该水手达成协议，顾客将于5月15日以500美元的价格为自己和家人全天使用该船。顾客支付了200美元的预付定金，并签署了一份协议，规定如果顾客取消或未能出现，水手可以保留该定金作为违约金。5月15日凌晨1点，海岸警卫队发布了离岸“恶劣天气”警报，并禁止所有与该水手船只大小相当的小型船只离港。该禁令全天有效。顾客在5月15日完全没有出现，因为他从收音机里听到了天气警报。

以下哪项是对双方当事人法律关系的准确陈述？
options:
A. The contract is discharged because of impossibility, and the customer is entitled to return of his deposit.
合同因履行不能而解除，顾客有权要求退还其定金。

B. The contract is discharged because of mutual mistake concerning an essential fact, and the customer is entitled to return of his deposit.
合同因对关键事实存在共同错误而解除，顾客有权要求退还其定金。

C. The contract is not discharged, and the customer is not entitled to return of his deposit, because the liquidated-damage clause in effect allocated the risk of bad weather to the customer.
合同未解除，顾客无权要求退还其定金，因为违约金条款实际上已将恶劣天气的风险分配给了顾客。

D. The contract is not discharged, because its performance was possible in view of the exceptional seaworthiness of the sailor's boat, and the customer is not entitled to return of his deposit.
合同未解除，因为鉴于该水手船只异常的适航性，合同的履行是可能的，顾客无权要求退还其定金。
data.explanation:
Ways to discharge contractual obligations

  • Full performance of contractual obligations
  • Impossibility, impracticability, or frustration of purpose
  • Release (in writing only)
  • Mutual rescission
  • Substituted contract
  • Contract or covenant not to sue
  • Accord & satisfaction
  • Novation


Mnemonic: FIRM SCAN

A contract is canceled or rescinded due to the occurrence of an unexpected or extraordinary event if:
  • that event makes it impossible or impracticable for one or both parties to perform their duties†
  • the contract was formed under a basic assumption that the event would not occur and
  • neither party was at fault in causing the event to occur.


Rescission excuses both parties' nonperformance of the contract (ie, discharges their obligations). This means that damages for breach cannot be recovered and any deposit or other benefit conferred on the other party must be returned.

Here, the customer contracted to use the sailor's boat and paid a $200 deposit. But the Coast Guard issued a heavy-weather warning and prohibited all small vessels from leaving the harbor - making it objectively impossible to use the boat despite its exceptional seaworthiness (Choice D). The parties must have assumed that the Coast Guard would not prohibit the use of the boat, and neither party could control its decision to do so. Therefore, the contract is discharged because of impossibility, and the customer is entitled to return of his deposit.

†Impossibility will generally be found only in these specific situations:
  • the death or incapacity of someone necessary for performance,
  • the destruction of the contract's subject matter, and
  • the prevention of performance by governmental regulation or order (as seen here).


(Choice B) In contract law, a mistake is an erroneous belief regarding the facts and/or law as they exist at the time of contracting. This could not be a case of mutual mistake since the Coast Guard prohibition was not in effect when the contract was entered.

(Choice C) A liquidated-damages clause is unenforceable as a penalty if the amount is so unreasonably large that it punishes the breaching party (as opposed to merely compensating the nonbreaching party). But this would not be a reason to discharge a contract.

Educational objective: A contract is rescinded, and both parties' contractual obligations are discharged, when:
  • an unexpected or extraordinary event makes performance impossible or impracticable,
  • the contract was formed under a basic assumption that the event would not occur, and
  • neither party was at fault in causing the event to occur.


选项正确率统计：A选项 85%（正确选项），B选项 2%，C选项 9%，D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

解除合同义务的方式

  • Full performance of contractual obligations (完全履行合同义务)
  • Impossibility, impracticability, or frustration of purpose (履行不能、履行不切实际或目的落空)
  • Release (in writing only) (免除（仅限书面形式）)
  • Mutual rescission (双方合意解除)
  • Substituted contract (替代合同)
  • Contract or covenant not to sue (不起诉合同或契约)
  • Accord & satisfaction (和解与清偿)
  • Novation (债务更新)


助记词: FIRM SCAN

如果发生意外或异常事件，合同将被取消或解除，条件是：
  • 该事件导致一方或双方当事人履行其义务变得不可能或不切实际†
  • 合同是在该事件不会发生的基本假定下订立的并且
  • 任何一方对于事件的发生都没有过错。


合同解除可免除双方当事人的不履行合同之责（即解除其义务）。这意味着违约损害赔偿不可被追偿，并且任何已支付给另一方的定金或其他利益必须返还。

在本案中，顾客签约使用水手的船并支付了200美元的定金。但海岸警卫队发布了恶劣天气警报，并禁止所有小型船只离港——这使得尽管船只异常适航，客观上仍不可能使用该船（选项D）。双方当事人必然是假定海岸警卫队不会禁止船只的使用，且任何一方都无法控制其决定。因此，合同因履行不能而解除，顾客有权要求退还其定金。

†履行不能通常仅在以下特定情况下被认定：
  • 对履行至关重要的人员死亡或丧失行为能力，
  • 合同标的物被销毁，以及
  • 政府法规或命令阻止履行（如本案所示）。


（选项B）在合同法中，错误是指在订立合同时对存在的事实和/或法律的错误认知。这不可能是共同错误，因为在合同签订时，海岸警卫队的禁令尚未生效。

（选项C）如果违约金条款的金额过大，以至于惩罚违约方（而不仅仅是补偿非违约方），则该条款作为惩罚金而不可执行。但这不会成为解除合同的理由。

教学目标：当出现以下情况时，合同被解除，且双方当事人的合同义务均被免除：
  • 意外或异常事件导致履行变得不可能或不切实际，
  • 合同是在该事件不会发生的基本假定下订立的，并且
  • 任何一方对于事件的发生都没有过错。


References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 261 cmt. d (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining that an unexpected event can discharge a party's duty to perform due to impossibility or impracticability).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

本题的核心考点是合同法中的 履行不能 (Impossibility) 导致的合同解除。

⚖️ 正确答案：A
合同因履行不能而解除，顾客有权取回定金。

1. 履行不能 (Impossibility)

根据美国合同法（参考 Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 261），当以下情况发生时，合同义务被免除（Discharged）：

  • 发生了一个意外事件 (Unexpected Event)；
  • 该事件的发生使得履行变得客观上不可能 (Objectively Impossible)；
  • 合同是基于该事件不会发生的基本假设而订立的；
  • 任何一方均无过错。

本案关键点：
海岸警卫队发布的禁令属于政府行为 (Government Regulation/Order)。当法律或政府命令禁止履行合同时，这构成了典型的“履行不能”。

虽然船本身是“适航的”（物理上可能），但法律上禁止其离港，因此构成了法律上的履行不能。

2. 合同解除后的后果

当合同因履行不能而解除时，双方的义务均被免除：

  • 水手不再有义务提供船只；
  • 顾客不再有义务支付费用。

关于定金 (Restitution)：
为了防止不当得利 (Unjust Enrichment)，当合同因不可抗力或履行不能解除时，一方必须返还其收到的并未提供对价的利益。因此，顾客有权拿回 $200 定金。

3. 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 B (错误)：共同错误 (Mutual Mistake)
Mistake 必须涉及合同订立时 (at the time of contracting) 已经存在的事实。本案中，天气警报是在合同订立后发生的，属于嗣后事件，而非订立时的错误。

选项 C (错误)：违约金条款 (Liquidated Damages)
违约金条款通常针对的是一方违约 (Breach) 的情况（例如顾客无故改变主意）。但本案中，合同是因法律原因自动解除，顾客并未违约。因此，违约金条款不适用。

选项 D (错误)：物理上的可能性
虽然船只“适航”，但在法律禁止出海的情况下，法院看重的是合法性 (Legality)。如果履行合同会导致违法行为，合同即被视为履行不能。

🎓 MBE 答题技巧

在处理此类题目时，请遵循以下逻辑步骤：

  1. 时间线判断： 阻碍履行的事件发生在签约前还是签约后？
    签约前 → 可能是 Mistake；签约后 → 可能是 Impossibility/Impracticability。
  2. 性质判断： 是“我做不到”(Subjective) 还是“任何人都做不到/不能做”(Objective)？
    只有客观上的不可能（如标的物灭失、政府禁令、关键人物死亡）才能免除义务。
  3. 风险分配： 除非合同明确写明“即使政府禁止出海也不退款”（极少见），否则不可抗力通常导致合同解除并恢复原状。

questions.question:
A buyer agreed to purchase and took delivery of a telescope from a seller for a price of $100. She promised to pay him $100 "as soon as I am able."
What effect does the quoted language have on the enforceability of the buyer's promise?

choices.a: None.
choices.b: It makes the promise illusory.
choices.c: It requires the buyer to prove her inability to pay.
choices.d: It requires the seller to prove the buyer's ability to pay.

data.questionStem:
Q81175

A buyer agreed to purchase and took delivery of a telescope from a seller for a price of $100. She promised to pay him $100 "as soon as I am able."

What effect does the quoted language have on the enforceability of the buyer's promise?

一位买方同意从一位卖方处购买一台望远镜并已收货，价格为100美元。她承诺“待我有能力支付时”即支付卖方100美元。

上述引用的表述对买方承诺的可执行性有何影响？
options:
A. None.
没有影响。

B. It makes the promise illusory.
它使该承诺成为虚幻的承诺。

C. It requires the buyer to prove her inability to pay.
它要求买方证明其无力支付。

D. It requires the seller to prove the buyer's ability to pay.
它要求卖方证明买方有能力支付。
data.explanation:
Performance is generally due once a contract is formed (eg, when a mutual agreement is supported by valuable consideration). However, performance can be delayed or discharged by a condition - ie, an uncertain future event that must occur before performance becomes due or is discharged. There are two types of conditions:

  • Condition precedent † - delays performance until a specified event occurs (eg, buyer's promise to pay as soon as she is able) and requires the plaintiff to prove that the event occurred to prevail
  • Condition subsequent - excuses performance once a specified event occurs (eg, buyer's promise to pay conditioned on delivery of telescope) and requires the defendant to prove that the event occurred to avoid liability (Choice C)


†A condition concurrent arises when each party's obligation to perform is a condition precedent to the other party's obligation to perform (ie, when performance is due simultaneously).

Here, a contract was formed when the buyer agreed to purchase the telescope from the seller for $100. The buyer's promise to pay "as soon as I am able" created a condition precedent that delayed her obligation to make the promised payment. This language therefore requires the seller to prove the buyer's ability to pay (ie, that the specified event occurred) before he can prevail in his action for breach of contract (Choice A).

(Choice B) A promise is illusory, and therefore unenforceable, if it is so indefinite that only one party is required to perform - eg, had the buyer promised to pay $100 "if I want to." In contrast, the buyer's promise to pay $100 "as soon as I am able" defines when she must perform and can be enforced once the condition precedent occurs.

Educational objective: Performance is generally due when a contract is formed. However, the contract can contain a condition precedent that delays performance until - or a condition subsequent that will excuse performance when - a specified event occurs.



选项正确率统计：A选项 18%，B选项 59%，C选项 7%，D选项 14%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

合同一旦成立，通常即须履行（例如，当双方协议有有价对价（valuable consideration）支持时）。然而，履行可以因一个条件而被延迟或免除——即一个不确定的未来事件，该事件必须在履行到期或被免除之前发生。条件有两种类型：

  • 先决条件 (Condition precedent)† - 在特定事件发生前延迟履行（例如，买方承诺在其有能力时尽快支付），并要求原告证明该事件已经发生才能胜诉。
  • 后决条件 (Condition subsequent) - 在特定事件发生后免除履行（例如，买方的支付承诺以望远镜的交付为条件），并要求被告证明该事件已经发生以避免承担责任 （选项C）。


†当事人双方的履行义务互为对方履行义务的先决条件时（即，当履行应同时进行时），便产生同时履行条件 (Condition concurrent)。

在本案中，当买方同意以100美元的价格从卖方处购买望远镜时，合同即告成立。买方承诺“待我有能力支付时”即支付，这创造了一个先决条件 (condition precedent)，延迟了她作出承诺付款的义务。因此，该表述要求卖方证明买方有能力支付（即，证明特定事件已经发生），他才能在违约之诉中胜诉 （选项A）。

（选项B） 如果一个承诺过于不确定，以至于只有一方被要求履行，那么这个承诺就是虚幻的 (illusory)，因而是不可执行的——例如，如果买方承诺“如果我愿意的话”就支付100美元。相比之下，买方承诺“待我有能力支付时”支付100美元，这明确了她必须履行的时机，并且一旦先决条件发生，该承诺即可被执行。

教学目的：合同成立时，通常即须履行。然而，合同可以包含一个先决条件 (condition precedent)，将履行延迟到特定事件发生之时，或一个后决条件 (condition subsequent)，在特定事件发生时免除履行。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts §§ 224 - 230 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (conditions related to performance).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Conditions & Performance
正确答案：D

该条款构成“先决条件”，要求卖方（原告）证明买方有支付能力。

核心法律概念：先决条件

本题的关键在于识别合同语言 "as soon as I am able"（待我有能力时）的法律性质。

这是一个典型的 先决条件 (Condition Precedent)。在合同法中：

  • 定义： 一个必须在合同义务到期之前发生的事件。
  • 效力： 在该事件发生之前，履行义务（此处为付款）被延迟 (suspended/delayed)。
  • 举证责任 (Burden of Proof)： 如果卖方起诉买方违约，作为原告的卖方必须证明该先决条件已经满足（即买方确实有钱了），否则买方的付款义务尚未被触发。
易错辨析：为何不是虚幻承诺？

很多考生容易误选 Option B (Illusory Promise)。这是 MBE 的经典陷阱。

✅ 有效承诺 (本题情况)
"As soon as I am able"
支付能力是一个客观事实 (Objective Fact)。买方是否有钱是可以被证明的，并非完全取决于买方的主观意愿。
❌ 虚幻承诺 (Illusory Promise)
"If I want to" / "If I feel like it"
这种表述完全取决于一方的主观随意外 (Unfettered Discretion)，没有对价 (Consideration)，因此合同无效。
举证责任的分配

为什么是卖方证明（选项D），而不是买方证明（选项C）？

  • 先决条件 (Condition Precedent)： 由寻求执行合同的一方（通常是原告/卖方）证明条件已成就。
  • 后决条件 (Condition Subsequent)： 由试图免除责任的一方（通常是被告/买方）证明条件已发生从而免责。

本案中，“有能力支付”是触发付款义务的前提，属于先决条件，故由原告（卖方）举证。

💡 MBE 实战技巧

遇到 "pay when able" 或 "pay when paid" 这类条款时：
  1. 首先判断它是否让承诺变得“虚幻”（看是否有客观标准）。
  2. 如果不是虚幻的，它通常是先决条件。
  3. 记住口诀：原告证明先决条件 (Plaintiff proves Precedent)。

A homeowner and a planner signed a detailed writing in which the planner, a landscape architect, agreed to landscape and replant the owner's residential property in accordance with a design prepared by the planner and incorporated in the writing. The owner agreed to pay $10,000 for the work upon its completion. At the owner's insistence, the written agreement contained a provision that neither party would be bound unless the owner's law partner, an avid student of landscaping, should approve the planner's design. Before the planner commenced the work, the owner's law partner, in the presence of both the owner and the planner, expressly disapproved the landscaping design. Nevertheless, the owner ordered the planner to proceed with the work, and the planner reluctantly did so. When the planner's performance was 40% complete, the owner repudiated his duty, if any, to pay the contract price or any part thereof.
If the planner now sues the owner for damages for breach of contract, which of the following concepts best supports the planner's claim?

choices.a: Irrevocable waiver of condition.
choices.b: Promissory estoppel.
choices.c: Substantial performance.
choices.d: Unjust enrichment.

Q81180

A homeowner and a planner signed a detailed writing in which the planner, a landscape architect, agreed to landscape and replant the owner's residential property in accordance with a design prepared by the planner and incorporated in the writing. The owner agreed to pay $10,000 for the work upon its completion. At the owner's insistence, the written agreement contained a provision that neither party would be bound unless the owner's law partner, an avid student of landscaping, should approve the planner's design. Before the planner commenced the work, the owner's law partner, in the presence of both the owner and the planner, expressly disapproved the landscaping design. Nevertheless, the owner ordered the planner to proceed with the work, and the planner reluctantly did so. When the planner's performance was 40% complete, the owner repudiated his duty, if any, to pay the contract price or any part thereof.

If the planner now sues the owner for damages for breach of contract, which of the following concepts best supports the planner's claim?

一位房主和一位规划师签署了一份详细的书面文件，其中规划师（一位景观设计师）同意根据其本人编制并已纳入书面文件的设计，对房主的住宅物业进行景观美化和重新种植。房主同意在工作完成后支付10,000美元。在房主的坚持下，该书面协议包含一项条款，规定除非房主的法律合伙人（一位热衷于景观设计的爱好者）批准规划师的设计，否则任何一方均不受协议约束。在规划师开始工作之前，房主的法律合伙人在房主和规划师均在场的情况下，明确表示不批准该景观设计。尽管如此，房主仍命令规划师继续进行工作，规划师不情愿地照办了。当规划师完成40%的履约时，房主拒绝履行其支付合同价款或其任何部分的义务（如果存在此义务）。

如果规划师现在因违约向房主提起损害赔偿诉讼，以下哪个概念最能支持规划师的主张？
options:
A. Irrevocable waiver of condition.
不可撤销的条件放弃。

B. Promissory estoppel.
允诺禁反言（Promissory estoppel）。

C. Substantial performance.
实质性履行。

D. Unjust enrichment.
不当得利。
data.explanation:
When nonoccurrence of condition is excused


WaiverParty waives condition by words or conduct
WrongfulinterferenceParty wrongfully prevents or interferes with condition's occurrence
EstoppelParty indicates condition will not be enforced AND Other party reasonably & detrimentally relies on belief that condition has been waived
DisproportionateforfeitureParty substantially performed & will be significantly harmed if condition is enforced
A contracting party may generally avoid performance if a condition precedent - ie, an uncertain future event that must occur before either or both parties' performance becomes due - has not occurred. The nonoccurrence of a condition may be excused , however, if the party who benefits from the condition waives it by words or conduct. And the waiving party cannot retract the waiver if the other party has detrimentally relied on it.

Here, the agreement provided that it would be binding if the owner's law partner approved the planner's landscape design (condition precedent). The law partner disapproved the design (nonoccurrence), but the owner ordered the planner to proceed with the work anyway (waiver). And because the planner detrimentally relied on that waiver by completing 40% of the work, the owner could not retract it (ie, the waiver was irrevocable). Therefore, the concept of irrevocable waiver of condition best supports the planner's breach-of-contract claim.

(Choice B) Under the doctrine of promissory estoppel, a party can enforce a promise on which it reasonably and detrimentally relied when no valid contract was formed. But because a contract was formed here, this doctrine does not apply.

(Choice C) The planner did not substantially perform under the contract since his performance was only 40% complete.

(Choice D) The doctrine of unjust enrichment applies in the absence of a valid contract to prevent one party from receiving a benefit from another that was not rightfully earned and would be unfair to keep.

Educational objective: Nonoccurrence of a condition precedent may be excused if the party who benefits from the condition waives it by words or conduct. The waiving party cannot retract the waiver if the other party has detrimentally relied on it.

选项正确率统计：A选项 46%（正确选项），B选项 7%，C选项 15%，D选项 30%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

条件不发生可被豁免的情形


放弃 (Waiver)一方通过言语或行为放弃条件
不法干涉 (Wrongful interference)一方不法地阻止或干涉条件的发生
禁反言 (Estoppel)一方表示将不强制执行条件，且另一方合理地、有损害地信赖该条件已被放弃
不相称的权利丧失 (Disproportionate forfeiture)一方已实质性履行，并且如果强制执行条件将受到重大损害
合同一方通常可以在先决条件——即在一方或双方的履约义务到期前必须发生的不确定未来事件——未发生时，免于履行。然而，如果从条件中受益的一方通过言语或行为放弃该条件，则条件的不发生可被豁免。并且，如果另一方已对该放弃产生了有损害的信赖，则放弃方不能撤回该放弃。

在本案中，协议规定，如果房主的法律合伙人批准规划师的景观设计（先决条件），则协议具有约束力。该法律合伙人不批准该设计（条件不发生），但房主仍然命令规划师继续工作（放弃）。并且因为规划师通过完成40%的工作而对该放弃产生了有损害的信赖，房主不能撤回该放弃（即，该放弃是不可撤销的）。因此，“不可撤销的条件放弃”这一概念最能支持规划师的违约主张。

（选项B）根据允诺禁反言（promissory estoppel）原则，当没有有效合同成立时，一方可以强制执行其合理且有损害地信赖的允诺。但由于本案中已成立合同，该原则不适用。

（选项C）规划师并没有根据合同进行实质性履行，因为其履约程度仅为40%。

（选项D）不当得利原则适用于没有有效合同的情况，以防止一方从另一方获得并非合法赚取且保留下来会不公平的利益。

教学目的：如果从条件中受益的一方通过言语或行为放弃该条件，先决条件的不发生可被豁免。如果另一方已对该放弃产生了有损害的信赖，则放弃方不能撤回该放弃。

MBE 考点解析：条件的放弃与信赖

本题考查的核心法律概念是合同法中的“条件的放弃” (Waiver of Condition) 及其不可撤销性。

核心规则：
当合同义务受制于某个先决条件 (Condition Precedent) 时，受益方可以通过言语或行为放弃 (Waive) 该条件。

虽然一般的放弃是可以撤回的，但如果对方已经基于该放弃产生了合理的、有损害的信赖 (Detrimental Reliance)，则该放弃变为不可撤销 (Irrevocable)。

案情逻辑推演

1. 合同成立
包含先决条件：法律合伙人必须批准设计。
2. 条件未成就 (Non-occurrence)
合伙人明确表示“不批准”。此时，房主本可以免除付款义务。
3. 放弃 (Waiver)
房主（受益方）明知条件未成就，仍命令规划师“继续工作”。这是对条件的明确放弃。
4. 信赖 (Reliance)
规划师基于房主的命令，完成了40%的工作。
5. 结论
由于规划师已产生信赖，房主的放弃不可撤销。房主必须履行合同（付款），拒绝付款构成违约。

为什么选 A (Irrevocable waiver)？

房主的行为（命令开工）构成了对“合伙人批准”这一条件的放弃。一旦规划师开始工作（信赖行为），房主就不能再以“条件未成就”为由拒绝付款。因此，规划师起诉违约的最佳依据是房主已经不可撤销地放弃了该条件。

为什么其他选项是错误的？

B. Promissory Estoppel (允诺禁反言)
错误原因： 允诺禁反言通常用于没有有效合同（例如缺乏对价）的情况，作为对价的替代品来执行承诺。本案中双方有明确的有效书面合同，问题在于合同条款的执行，而非合同的成立。
C. Substantial Performance (实质性履行)
错误原因： 实质性履行通常要求完成绝大部分工作（例如90%以上）。本案中规划师只完成了 40%，远未达到实质性履行的标准。此外，该原则通常用于保护已完成大部分工作的违约方，而非本案这种被动停止的情况。
D. Unjust Enrichment (不当得利)
错误原因： 这是一个准合同 (Quasi-contract) 概念，适用于合同无效或不可执行时，为了防止一方不公平获利。既然本案可以通过“放弃”理论在合同法框架内解决，法院首选执行合同条款，而非诉诸衡平法上的不当得利。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 在处理Condition (条件) 题目时，请遵循以下三步分析法：
  1. 识别条件： 寻找 "unless", "provided that", "if" 等词汇。
  2. 判断结果： 条件是否发生？如果没有，义务通常被免除。
  3. 寻找豁免 (Excuse)： 受益方是否说了“没关系”或“继续做”？这就是 Waiver。如果对方因此行动了，Waiver 就锁死（Irrevocable）了。

questions.question:
A manufacturer contracted in a signed writing to provide a company with industrial ceiling tiles for its new production facility. The contract specified that the manufacturer would deliver the tiles by third-party carrier, "F.O.B. the company's production facility."
While in transit to the production facility, one-third of the tiles fell off the carrier's truck and were destroyed. The manufacturer subsequently emailed the company that it did not intend to replace the tiles. The company sent a letter to the manufacturer that read in relevant part: "You are not responsible for replacing the damaged tiles. We will sue the carrier." The company signed the letter. Shortly thereafter, the carrier filed for bankruptcy and the company decided to sue the manufacturer for breach of contract.
Will the company be likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the company's signed letter operated as a release and discharged the manufacturer from its remaining contractual duties.
choices.b: No, because the tiles were specifically identified goods that were destroyed through no fault of either party.
choices.c: Yes, because the manufacturer bore the risk of loss when the tiles were destroyed and breached the contract by refusing to replace the tiles.
choices.d: Yes, because there was no new consideration to support the release of the manufacturer's remaining contractual duties.

Will the company be likely to prevail?

一家制造商在一份签署的书面合同中承诺，为其新生产设施向一家公司提供工业天花板瓷砖。合同规定，制造商将通过第三方承运人交付瓷砖，条款为“F.O.B. 公司生产设施”。

在运往生产设施的途中，三分之一的瓷砖从承运人的卡车上掉落并被损毁。制造商随后通过电子邮件告知该公司，其不打算更换这些瓷砖。该公司向制造商发送了一封信函，其中相关部分写道：“贵方不负责更换损坏的瓷砖。我方将起诉承运人。”公司签署了该信函。此后不久，承运人申请破产，该公司决定以违约为由起诉制造商。

该公司是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the company's signed letter operated as a release and discharged the manufacturer from its remaining contractual duties.
不会，因为公司的署名信函起到了责任豁免的作用，免除了制造商剩余的合同义务。

B. No, because the tiles were specifically identified goods that were destroyed through no fault of either party.
不会，因为这些瓷砖是特定物，其损毁并非由于任何一方的过错。

C. Yes, because the manufacturer bore the risk of loss when the tiles were destroyed and breached the contract by refusing to replace the tiles.
会，因为在瓷砖被损毁时，制造商承担了灭失风险，并且其拒绝更换瓷砖的行为构成了违约。

D. Yes, because there was no new consideration to support the release of the manufacturer's remaining contractual duties.
会，因为没有新的对价来支持免除制造商剩余的合同义务。
data.explanation:
Under the UCC, which governs contracts for the sale of goods, the risk of loss generally passes to the buyer when the buyer receives the goods. But if the contract requires the seller to deliver the goods by third-party carrier, then the risk of loss passes to the buyer at different times depending on whether the contract is a:
  • shipment contract - does not require delivery at a particular location, so the risk of loss passes to the buyer when the goods are properly delivered to the carrier or
  • destination contract - requires delivery at a particular location, so the risk of loss passes to the buyer when goods are delivered at the named location.
Destination contracts are often identified by the letters "F.O.B." (free on board) followed by a location (as seen here). And since the ceiling tiles were in transit to the company's production facility when they were destroyed, the risk of loss was with the manufacturer at that time. Therefore, the manufacturer was in breach when it informed the company that it did not intend to replace the tiles (Choice C).

However, the company then sent the manufacturer a letter stating that the manufacturer was not responsible for replacing the damaged tiles. This operated as a release - ie, a writing that manifests an intent to discharge another party from an existing duty. The UCC requires that a release be signed by the releasing party (as the company did here), but no consideration is needed (Choice D).† Therefore, the company is unlikely to prevail in its suit against the manufacturer.

†For common-law contracts, the release must be supported by consideration or a consideration substitute (eg, detrimental reliance) to be effective.

(Choice B) A seller's performance is excused if specifically identified items of inventory are destroyed through no fault of either party before the risk of loss passes to the buyer. Since the tiles here were general inventory items, the manufacturer's performance was not excused on this basis.

Educational objective: A release is a writing that manifests an intent to discharge another party from an existing duty. The UCC requires the release to be signed by the releasing party, but new consideration is not required for the release to be effective.



选项正确率统计：A选项 42%（正确选项），B选项 8%，C选项 34%，D选项 15%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

根据管辖货物买卖合同的UCC，灭失风险通常在买方收到货物时转移给买方。但如果合同要求卖方通过第三方承运人交付货物，那么灭失风险转移给买方的时间点则根据合同是以下哪种类型而有所不同：
  • 装运合同 - 不要求在特定地点交货，因此灭失风险在货物被妥善交付给承运人时转移给买方，或
  • 目的地合同 - 要求在特定地点交货，因此灭失风险在货物在指定地点交付时转移给买方。
目的地合同通常以字母“F.O.B.”（船上交货价）后跟一个地点来标识（如本案所示）。由于天花板瓷砖在运往公司生产设施的途中被损毁，因此当时的灭失风险由制造商承担。因此，当制造商通知公司其不打算更换瓷砖时，制造商构成了违约（选项C）。

然而，该公司随后致函制造商，声明制造商不负责更换损坏的瓷砖。该信函起到了责任豁免（release）的作用——即，一种书面文件，表明意图免除另一方的现有义务。UCC要求责任豁免书必须由作出豁免的一方签署（如本案中的公司所为），但不需要对价（选项D）。† 因此，该公司在对制造商的诉讼中很可能不会胜诉。

†对于普通法合同，责任豁免必须有对价或对价的替代品（例如，不利信赖）支持方为有效。

（选项B） 如果特定的库存物品在灭失风险转移给买方之前，非因任何一方的过错而被损毁，则卖方的履行义务可被免除。由于本案中的瓷砖是一般库存物品，制造商的履行义务不能以此为由被免除。

教学目标： 责任豁免是一种书面文件，表明意图免除另一方的现有义务。UCC要求责任豁免书必须由作出豁免的一方签署，但该豁免的生效无需新的对价。

References

U.C.C. § 1-306 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (waiver or renunciation of claim or right after breach).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 284 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (release).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Sales (UCC)
✅ 正确答案：A
公司签署的信函构成了有效的责任豁免（Release），免除了制造商的违约责任。
逻辑推演 (Logic Flow)
合同条款：F.O.B. 目的地
(Risk of Loss 在卖方)
↓
货物损毁 + 卖方拒绝补货
(卖方违约 Breach)
↓
买方签署信函："你不必负责"
(书面豁免 Release)
↓
法律后果：卖方责任解除
(无需新对价 No Consideration Needed)
核心考点解析
UCC § 1-306

违约后的权利放弃 (Waiver/Renunciation)

这是本题最关键的考点，也是与普通法（Common Law）最大的区别：

  • 普通法： 豁免或修改合同通常需要对价 (Consideration) 才能生效。
  • UCC： 对于违约后的索赔权或权利，只要受害方（买方）签署并交付了书面豁免 (Signed Writing)，即使没有对价，该豁免也是有效的。

在本案中，公司签署了信函明确表示 "You are not responsible"（你无需负责），这满足了 UCC 关于书面形式和签署的要求，因此有效免除了制造商的责任。

UCC § 2-319

F.O.B. Destination (目的地交货)

虽然这导致了制造商最初的违约，但不是最终胜败的关键。因为合同是 "F.O.B. company's production facility"，属于目的地合同。货物在运输途中灭失的风险（Risk of Loss）由卖方（制造商）承担。制造商拒绝补货确实构成了违约，但随后的豁免信函消除了这一责任。

为什么不选 D？(陷阱)

选项 D： "Yes, because there was no new consideration..."

这是最强的干扰项。许多考生习惯了普通法的思维，认为“没有新对价，豁免无效”。

驳斥： 这是一个货物买卖合同，适用 UCC。UCC 特别规定，针对违约的索赔放弃（Waiver of claim after breach）不需要对价，只要有签署的书面文件即可。

关于选项 B (特定物损毁)：
只有当货物在订立合同时已被“特定化” (Specifically Identified，例如“编号123的那台机器”)，且损毁无过错时，卖方才能免责。本案中的瓷砖是通用库存 (General Inventory)，制造商有义务用其他瓷砖替代，不能因这批货损毁而免责。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
看到 UCC (货物买卖) + 修改合同 (Modification) 或 豁免违约 (Waiver) 时，立即警惕“对价”陷阱。
记住口诀：UCC Modification/Waiver = Needs Good Faith + Writing (sometimes), but NO Consideration.

questions.question:
A homeowner contracted in writing with a kitchen contractor to renovate her kitchen for $25,000, "subject to the homeowner's complete personal satisfaction." The contractor replaced the cabinets, flooring, and countertops and then sought payment from the homeowner. The homeowner paid the contractor only $20,000, truthfully saying that she did not like the finish on the cabinets and was therefore not satisfied.
If the contractor sues the homeowner for the balance of the contract price, will the contractor be likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because a condition to the homeowner's obligation to pay was not satisfied.
choices.b: No, because the contractor breached his duty of good faith and fair dealing by supplying unsatisfactory materials.
choices.c: Yes, because the homeowner breached the covenant of good faith and fair dealing by rejecting the cabinets without justification.
choices.d: Yes, because the homeowner was the first party to breach the contract.

Q81825 A homeowner contracted in writing with a kitchen contractor to renovate her kitchen for $25,000, "subject to the homeowner's complete personal satisfaction." The contractor replaced the cabinets, flooring, and countertops and then sought payment from the homeowner. The homeowner paid the contractor only $20,000, truthfully saying that she did not like the finish on the cabinets and was therefore not satisfied.

If the contractor sues the homeowner for the balance of the contract price, will the contractor be likely to prevail? 一位房主与一名厨房承包商签订了书面合同，以25,000美元的价格翻新她的厨房，“前提是房主完全个人满意”。承包商更换了橱柜、地板和台面，然后向房主索要付款。房主只支付了承包商20,000美元，并如实说她不喜欢橱柜的饰面，因此不满意。 如果承包商就合同价款的余款起诉房主，承包商是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because a condition to the homeowner's obligation to pay was not satisfied.
不会，因为房主付款义务的一个条件未获满足。

B. No, because the contractor breached his duty of good faith and fair dealing by supplying unsatisfactory materials.
不会，因为承包商提供了不合格的材料，违反了其诚信与公平交易的义务。

C. Yes, because the homeowner breached the covenant of good faith and fair dealing by rejecting the cabinets without justification.
会，因为房主无理拒绝橱柜，违反了诚信与公平交易的契约。

D. Yes, because the homeowner was the first party to breach the contract.
会，因为房主是首先违约的一方。
data.explanation:
Meeting condition of satisfaction


Objective standard
(default)		Whether reasonable person would be satisfied with performance
Subjective standard
(aesthetics)		Whether promisor is personally satisfied with performance (provided that dissatisfaction is honest & in good faith)
Many contracts include a condition precedent that a party's duty to pay will not become due unless the party is satisfied with the other party's performance (ie, condition of satisfaction). Satisfaction is typically measured objectively, meaning that the condition is met if a reasonable person would be satisfied. But if aesthetic taste is involved, satisfaction is measured subjectively. In that case, the condition is met only if the promisor is personally satisfied, provided that any dissatisfaction is honest and in good faith.

Here, the homeowner's duty to pay for the kitchen renovation was subject to her "complete personal satisfaction." This condition of satisfaction was not met because the homeowner was honestly dissatisfied with the cabinets' finish. As a result, the homeowner was not obligated to make the promised payment, and the contractor likely will not prevail in a suit to recover the balance of the contract price (Choices C & D).

(Choice B) There is no indication that the materials supplied by the contractor were unsatisfactory. And even if they were, using unsatisfactory materials is not a breach of the covenant of good faith and fair dealing.

Educational objective: When a contract conditions a duty to pay on satisfaction with another party's performance, satisfaction is measured objectively. But when the condition involves a party's aesthetic taste, the condition is only met if that party is personally satisfied with the other party's performance, provided that any dissatisfaction is honest and in good faith.

满足满意条件


客观标准
（默认）		通情达理之人是否会对履约感到满意
主观标准
（美学）		许诺人是否个人对履约感到满意（前提是其不满是诚实且善意的）
许多合同包含一个先决条件，即一方的付款义务只有在该方对另一方的履约感到满意时才到期（即满意条件）。满意度通常是客观地衡量的，即如果一个通情达理之人会感到满意，则该条件即获满足。但如果涉及审美趣味，则满意度是主观地衡量的。在这种情况下，只有当许诺人个人感到满意时，该条件才获满足，前提是任何不满都必须是诚实且善意的。

在本案中，房主支付厨房翻新费用的义务取决于她的“完全个人满意”。这一满意条件未获满足，因为房主对橱柜的饰面确实不满意。因此，房主没有义务支付承诺的款项，承包商在追讨合同价款余款的诉讼中很可能不会胜诉（选项C和D）。

（选项B）没有迹象表明承包商提供的材料不合格。即使材料不合格，使用不合格的材料也不构成对诚信与公平交易契约的违反。

教学目的： 当合同将付款义务的条件设定为对另一方履约的满意度时，满意度是客观地衡量的。但当条件涉及一方的审美趣味时，只有在该方个人对另一方的履约感到满意时，该条件才获满足，前提是任何不满都必须是诚实且善意的。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 228 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (party's satisfaction as a condition).
