data.htmlContent:
MBE Contracts

满意度条款与付款条件

Conditions of Satisfaction
📚 核心考点：满意度条件 (Condition of Satisfaction)

在合同法中，当一方的付款义务取决于其对另一方履行的“满意”时，这是一个先决条件 (Condition Precedent)。如果条件未满足，付款义务就不会产生。

MBE 考试中，判断标准分为两类：

客观标准
(Objective)		 主观标准
(Subjective)
适用场景：
商业价值、机械效用、功能性合同。
(Commercial value, utility)		 适用场景：
个人品味、审美、艺术性合同。
(Personal taste, aesthetics)
判断依据：
通情达理的人是否会满意？
(Reasonable Person Standard)		 判断依据：
当事人个人是否真的满意？
(Personal Satisfaction)
限制：
即使当事人说不满意，如果合理人满意，则条件满足。		 限制：
必须是诚实且善意的不满意 (Honest and in Good Faith)。

本题案情分析

1
合同性质：厨房翻新，特别是涉及“橱柜饰面”(finish on the cabinets)。这属于审美与个人品味 (Aesthetics) 的范畴，而非单纯的结构功能。
2
合同条款：明确约定 "subject to the homeowner's complete personal satisfaction"（取决于房主完全的个人满意）。这加强了适用主观标准的理由。
3
关键事实：题目指出房主是 "truthfully saying"（如实地说）她不喜欢。这证明她的不满意是善意的 (Good Faith)，并非为了赖账而撒谎。
✅ 正确答案：A

"No, because a condition to the homeowner's obligation to pay was not satisfied."

由于适用主观标准，且房主的不满意是诚实的（Good Faith），因此付款的先决条件未满足。条件未满足意味着付款义务未到期，房主拒绝付款不构成违约。

❌ 选项 B 错误： 承包商没有违反诚信义务。提供房主主观不喜欢的材料并不等同于材料本身有质量缺陷或恶意行为。

❌ 选项 C 错误： 房主没有违约。在主观标准下，她不需要“合理理由” (Justification)，只需要“诚实” (Honest)。只有在客观标准下才需要看理由是否合理。

💡 MBE 快速解题技巧：
看到 "Satisfaction" 条款时，立即进行两步判断：
  1. 看对象：是修水管/造机器（客观标准），还是画肖像/装修风格（主观标准）？
  2. 看心态：如果是主观标准，题目中是否出现了 "Honestly", "Truthfully", "Good faith" 等词？如果有，房主这就赢了。

questions.question:
A seller and a buyer entered into a contract obligating the seller to convey title to a parcel of land to the buyer in exchange for $100,000. The agreement provided that the buyer's obligation to purchase the parcel was expressly conditioned upon the buyer's obtaining a loan at an interest rate no higher than 10%. The buyer was unable to do so but did obtain a loan at an interest rate of 10.5% and timely tendered the purchase price. Because the value of the land had increased since the time of contracting, the seller refused to perform. The buyer sued the seller.
Is the buyer likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because an express condition will be excused only to avoid forfeiture.
choices.b: No, because the contract called for a loan at an interest rate not to exceed 10% and it could not be modified without the consent of the seller.
choices.c: Yes, because the buyer detrimentally changed position in reliance on the seller's promise to convey.
choices.d: Yes, because the buyer's obtaining a loan at an interest rate no higher than 10% was not a condition to the seller's duty to perform.

data.questionStem:
Q81182

A seller and a buyer entered into a contract obligating the seller to convey title to a parcel of land to the buyer in exchange for $100,000. The agreement provided that the buyer's obligation to purchase the parcel was expressly conditioned upon the buyer's obtaining a loan at an interest rate no higher than 10%. The buyer was unable to do so but did obtain a loan at an interest rate of 10.5% and timely tendered the purchase price. Because the value of the land had increased since the time of contracting, the seller refused to perform. The buyer sued the seller.

Is the buyer likely to prevail?

卖方和买方签订了一份合同，约定卖方有义务将一块土地的所有权转让给买方，以换取100,000美元。协议规定，买方购买该土地的义务明确以买方获得年利率不高于10%的贷款为条件。买方未能获得该贷款，但确实以10.5%的利率获得了贷款，并及时支付了购买价款。由于自签约时起土地价值已经上涨，卖方拒绝履行合同。买方对卖方提起了诉讼。

买方胜诉的可能性大吗？
options:
A. No, because an express condition will be excused only to avoid forfeiture.
不大，因为只有在为了避免权利丧失的情况下，明示条件才会被豁免。

B. No, because the contract called for a loan at an interest rate not to exceed 10% and it could not be modified without the consent of the seller.
不大，因为合同要求贷款利率不超过10%，且未经卖方同意，该条款不得修改。

C. Yes, because the buyer detrimentally changed position in reliance on the seller's promise to convey.
很大，因为买方因信赖卖方的转让承诺而使其处境发生了不利的改变。

D. Yes, because the buyer's obtaining a loan at an interest rate no higher than 10% was not a condition to the seller's duty to perform.
很大，因为买方获得不高于10%利率的贷款并非卖方履行义务的条件。
data.explanation:
When nonoccurrence of condition is excused


WaiverParty waives condition by words or conduct
Wrongful interferenceParty wrongfully prevents or interferes with condition's occurrence
EstoppelParty indicates condition will not be enforced AND Other party reasonably & detrimentally relies on belief that condition has been waived
Disproportionate forfeitureParty substantially performed & will be significantly harmed if condition is enforced
Performance is generally due once a contract is formed. However, a party may avoid performance if a condition precedent - ie, an uncertain future event that must occur before either or both parties' performance becomes due - has not occurred, and the nonoccurrence is not excused. Nonoccurrence of a condition may be excused by waiver if the party who benefits from the condition chooses to perform despite the nonoccurrence.

Here, the buyer's duty to perform under the contract by purchasing the land was expressly conditioned on obtaining a loan at an interest rate no higher than 10% (condition precedent). The buyer was unable to do so (nonoccurrence) but tendered the purchase price anyway (waiver). Since the buyer waived the condition, the seller was also required to perform by conveying title to the buyer. Therefore, the buyer will likely prevail.

(Choice A) It is untrue that an express condition (ie, one that appears in the contract) will be excused only to avoid disproportionate forfeiture. There are other excuses, such as waiver.

(Choice B) The buyer's waiver of the condition was not a contract modification requiring the seller's consent since it did not alter the material terms of the contract (eg, purchase price).

(Choice C) Under the doctrine of promissory estoppel, a party can enforce a promise on which it reasonably and detrimentally relied when no valid contract was formed. But here, a valid contract was formed, so the buyer's reliance is irrelevant.

Educational objective: Nonoccurrence of a condition may be excused by waiver if the party that benefits from the condition chooses to perform despite the nonoccurrence.

选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 18%，C选项 5%，D选项 74%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

条件不发生可被豁免的情形


弃权 (Waiver)当事人通过言语或行为放弃条件
不当干预 (Wrongful interference)当事人不当地阻止或干预条件的发生
禁止反言 (Estoppel)一方当事人表示将不强制执行该条件，且另一方当事人合理地、有损害地信赖该条件已被放弃
不相称的权利丧失 (Disproportionate forfeiture)一方当事人已实质性履行，且若强制执行该条件将遭受重大损害
合同一旦成立，通常即应履行。然而，如果一个先决条件——即在一方或双方当事人的履行义务到期前必须发生的不确定未来事件——没有发生，且其不发生不可被豁免，则一方当事人可以避免履行。如果从该条件中受益的一方当事人选择在条件不发生的情况下仍然履行，则条件的不发生可因弃权而被豁免。

在本案中，买方根据合同购买土地的履行义务，明确地以获得不超过10%利率的贷款为条件（先决条件）。买方未能做到这一点（条件不发生），但仍然支付了购买价款（弃权）。由于买方放弃了该条件，卖方也必须履行义务，将所有权转让给买方。因此，买方很可能会胜诉。

(选项A) 明示条件（即出现在合同中的条件）仅为了避免不相称的权利丧失才会被豁免，这种说法是不正确的。还存在其他豁免情形，例如弃权。

(选项B) 买方对条件的放弃并非需要卖方同意的合同变更，因为它没有改变合同的实质性条款（例如，购买价格）。

(选项C) 根据“允诺禁反言”(promissory estoppel)原则，当没有成立有效合同时，一方当事人可以强制执行其合理且有损害地信赖的承诺。但在本案中，一个有效的合同已经成立，因此买方的信赖是无关紧要的。

教育目标：如果从条件中受益的一方当事人在条件不发生的情况下选择履行，则条件的不发生可因弃权而被豁免。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 224 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (definition of condition).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 225 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (effect of non-occurrence of condition).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Conditions & Waiver
核心原则：条件的弃权 (Waiver of Condition) 如果合同中的某个条件完全是为了一方当事人的利益 (for the benefit of one party) 而设立的，该当事人有权放弃 (waive) 该条件，并要求对方履行合同。

本题逻辑链条

1
识别条件 (Identify the Condition):
买方的购买义务取决于能否获得利率≤10%的贷款。这是一个先决条件 (Condition Precedent)。
2
确定受益人 (Determine the Beneficiary):
这个“融资保护条款”是为了保护买方，防止买方被迫接受高昂的贷款利率。它对卖方没有利益（卖方只关心拿到10万美元，不关心买方的利息是多少）。
3
弃权行为 (The Waiver):
虽然条件未满足（利率10.5% > 10%），但买方选择仍然支付价款。这意味着买方放弃了该条件的保护。
4
法律后果 (Legal Consequence):
既然受益方（买方）已经放弃了条件，卖方就不能以“条件未满足”为借口拒绝履行。卖方的履行义务（转让地契）现在是绝对的。

选项深度解析

正确答案 D 分析： 选项D指出了问题的本质。获得≤10%利率的贷款是买方履行义务的条件，而非卖方。既然买方愿意在条件未满足时继续履行（即放弃条件），卖方就必须配合。卖方不能利用一个旨在保护买方的条款来逃避因土地升值而变得“不划算”的交易。
选项 A 错误点： 过于绝对。虽然避免“不相称的权利丧失” (Disproportionate Forfeiture) 是豁免条件的一种理由，但它不是唯一理由。本题适用的是弃权 (Waiver) 原则。
选项 B 错误点： 混淆了“修改”与“弃权”。买方放弃一个单方受益的条件不需要卖方同意，也不构成对合同实质条款（如价格、标的物）的修改 (Modification)。
选项 C 错误点： 适用法律错误。选项C描述的是允诺禁反言 (Promissory Estoppel)。当存在有效的书面合同时，我们优先分析合同条款和条件豁免，而不是求助于衡平法上的救济。买方胜诉是因为合同有效且条件被放弃，而非仅仅因为信赖利益。
💡 MBE 提分技巧
在处理“条件” (Conditions) 类题目时，永远先问自己：
1. 这个条件是为了谁的利益设立的？
2. 受益方是否通过言行放弃了这个条件？

如果是单方受益条件且受益方已放弃，另一方通常不能以此为由毁约。

questions.question:
A manufacturer of computer chipsets for smartphones contracted to sell to a tech company 1 million chipsets each month for three years, payment for each installment to be made upon delivery. Before delivering the first installment, the manufacturer told the tech company, "Our manufacturing plant is undergoing renovations. This will likely have a temporary impact on the quantity, but not the quality, of chipsets in future installments." The manufacturer delivered the first three installments to the tech company in compliance with the contract. However, the fourth installment contained only 500,000 chipsets. The tech company accepted the installment on the manufacturer's assurance that the remaining 500,000 chipsets would be delivered in two weeks, which they were. Then the manufacturer communicated that the fifth installment likely would contain only 500,000 chipsets.
Which of the following statements best describes the tech company's rights after receiving the manufacturer's most recent communication regarding the fifth installment?

choices.a: It can demand adequate assurance that the fifth installment will conform to the contract and treat a failure to give immediate assurance as a repudiation.
choices.b: It can treat the manufacturer's communication as a repudiation and sue for breach of contract.
choices.c: It cannot demand adequate assurance that the fifth installment will comply with the contract because it accepted a nonconforming installment.
choices.d: It cannot sue for breach of contract if it demands, and the manufacturer gives, adequate assurance that the fifth installment will comply with the contract.

一家智能手机电脑芯片组制造商与一家科技公司签订合同，在三年内每月向其出售100万个芯片组，每批次货款在交货时支付。在交付第一批货物之前，该制造商告知科技公司：“我们的制造工厂正在进行翻新。这可能会对未来批次的芯片组数量产生暂时性影响，但不会影响其质量。” 制造商按照合同规定向科技公司交付了前三批货物。然而，第四批货物仅包含50万个芯片组。在制造商保证剩余的50万个芯片组将在两周内交付后，该科技公司接受了这批货物，而制造商也确实做到了。随后，制造商告知，第五批货物可能也只包含50万个芯片组。

在收到制造商关于第五批货物的最新通知后，以下哪项陈述最准确地描述了该科技公司的权利？
options:
A. It can demand adequate assurance that the fifth installment will conform to the contract and treat a failure to give immediate assurance as a repudiation.
它可以要求对方提供第五批货物将符合合同规定的充分保证，并将未能立即提供保证的行为视为毁约。

B. It can treat the manufacturer's communication as a repudiation and sue for breach of contract.
它可以将制造商的通知视为毁约，并以违约为由提起诉讼。

C. It cannot demand adequate assurance that the fifth installment will comply with the contract because it accepted a nonconforming installment.
它不能要求对方提供第五批货物将符合合同规定的充分保证，因为它曾接受过不符合同规定的批次。

D. It cannot sue for breach of contract if it demands, and the manufacturer gives, adequate assurance that the fifth installment will comply with the contract.
如果它要求，且制造商就第五批货物将符合合同规定提供了充分保证，则它不能以违约为由提起诉讼。
data.explanation:
A party's statements or conduct may cast doubt on its ability or willingness to perform under the contract. This prospective inability to perform is not a breach of contract because - unlike anticipatory repudiation - the party has not clearly and unequivocally refused to perform. However, it gives the other party the right to demand assurance of performance and suspend its own performance until assurance is provided. Failure to provide such assurance within a reasonable time (not to exceed 30 days under the UCC) constitutes a breach.

Here, the manufacturer communicated that the fifth installment likely would contain only 500,000 chipsets. Although this cast doubt on the manufacturer's ability to deliver 1 million chipsets as promised (prospective inability to perform), it was not a clear and unequivocal refusal to do so (no anticipatory repudiation). Therefore, the tech company cannot sue for breach of contract if it demands, and the manufacturer gives, adequate assurance that the fifth installment will comply with the contract (Choice B).

(Choice A) A party that receives a proper demand for assurance has a reasonable time to provide assurance (not to exceed 30 days under the UCC) before the other party can treat the failure to do so as a repudiation and sue for breach. As a result, the tech company cannot treat a failure to give immediate assurance as a repudiation.

(Choice C) In an installment contract, a party that accepts a nonconforming payment or delivery (eg, the fourth installment of 500,000 chipsets) does not forfeit the right to demand adequate assurance that future installments will comply with the contract.

Educational objective: One party's prospective inability to perform under the contract gives the other party the right to demand assurance of performance and suspend its own performance until assurance is provided. Failure to provide assurance within a reasonable time (not to exceed 30 days under the UCC) constitutes a breach.



选项正确率统计：A选项 29%，B选项 5%，C选项 10%，D选项 54%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

一方当事人的声明或行为可能会使其履行合同的能力或意愿受到质疑。这种预期不能履行并非违约，因为——与预期毁约不同——该方当事人并未明确、毫不含糊地拒绝履行。然而，这赋予了另一方当事人要求提供履约保证并中止自身履行的权利，直到获得保证为止。在合理时间内（根据UCC，不得超过30天）未能提供此类保证即构成违约。

在本案中，制造商告知第五批货物可能只包含50万个芯片组。尽管这使得制造商按承诺交付100万个芯片组的能力受到质疑（预期不能履行），但这并非明确、毫不含糊的拒绝履行（非预期毁约）。因此，如果科技公司要求，且制造商就第五批货物将符合合同规定提供了充分保证，则科技公司不能以违约为由提起诉讼（选项B）。

(选项A) 收到合理的履约保证要求的一方当事人，有合理的时间提供保证（根据UCC，不得超过30天），然后另一方当事人才能将其未能提供保证的行为视为毁约并以违约为由提起诉讼。因此，该科技公司不能将未能立即提供保证的行为视为毁约。

(选项C) 在分期合同中，一方当事人接受了不符合同规定的付款或交付（例如，第四批50万个芯片组），并不丧失要求对未来批次货物符合合同规定提供充分保证的权利。

教学目标：合同一方当事人的预期不能履行，赋予另一方当事人要求提供履约保证并中止自身履行直至获得保证的权利。在合理时间内（根据UCC，不得超过30天）未能提供保证即构成违约。

References

U.C.C. § 2-609 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (right to adequate assurance of performance).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 251 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (explaining when a party's failure to give adequate assurance may be treated as repudiation).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance & Breach

UCC Article 2 Adequate Assurance
核心法律规则 (The Rule)
UCC § 2-609: Right to Adequate Assurance of Performance
当一方有“合理的理由担心”(reasonable grounds for insecurity) 对方无法履约时，该方可以：
  1. 书面要求对方提供充分的履约保证 (Adequate Assurance)；
  2. 在等待保证期间，可以中止自己的履行（如果商业上合理）；
  3. 如果对方在合理时间（不超过30天）内未能提供保证，则视为毁约 (Repudiation)。
案情关键点分析
1
模糊的表述 (Equivocal Statement):
制造商说第五批货物“可能”(likely) 只有50万个。这表示了预期不能履行 (Prospective Inability)，但并没有明确、绝对地拒绝履行。
2
非预期毁约 (Not Anticipatory Repudiation):
预期毁约必须是明确且毫不含糊 (Clear and Unequivocal) 的拒绝。既然只是“可能”，买方就不能立即起诉违约。
3
买方的权利:
买方虽然不能立即起诉，但有权感到“不安”，因此有权要求履约保证。
选项深度解析
✅ 选项 D (正确答案)
"It cannot sue for breach... if it demands, and the manufacturer gives, adequate assurance..."

逻辑：如果买方行使了要求保证的权利，而卖方成功提供了“充分保证”（例如：展示了新的库存来源或加班计划），那么卖方就没有违约。既然没有违约，买方自然不能起诉。保证的提供消除了“不安”的状态，合同继续有效。
❌ 选项 A (错误)
错在 "Immediate Assurance"：
法律给予被要求方一个合理的时间 (Reasonable Time) 来提供保证，UCC规定最长不超过30天。买方不能要求“立即”回应，否则视为剥夺了卖方的法定权利。
❌ 选项 B (错误)
错在 "Treat as Repudiation"：
如前所述，"Likely" (可能) 不等于 "Will not" (将不)。只有明确的拒绝才能直接视为预期毁约并立即起诉。
❌ 选项 C (错误)
错在 "Waiver"：
在分期交付合同 (Installment Contract) 中，接受一次不合规的交付（特别是已经补救的），并不意味着买方放弃了要求未来批次必须合规的权利。买方依然有权对新的风险要求保证。
考试通关秘籍 (Exam Tip)
在 MBE 合同法题目中，仔细区分对方的陈述是 "I doubt I can" (我怀疑我能不能) 还是 "I will not" (我不会)。
  • I will not: 预期毁约 (Anticipatory Repudiation) → 可立即起诉。
  • I doubt I can: 预期不能履行 (Prospective Inability) → 只能要求保证 (Demand Assurance)。

questions.question:
A buyer agreed in writing to purchase a car from a seller for $15,000, with the price to be paid on a specified date at the seller's home. The contract provided, and both parties intended, that time was of the essence. Before the specified date, however, the seller sold the car to a third party for $18,000. On the specified date, the buyer arrived at the seller's home prepared to tender payment. The seller was not there, so the buyer called the seller to ask where he was. The seller then told the buyer that he had sold the car to the third party.
If the buyer sues the seller for breach of contract, will the buyer be likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the buyer did not tender her performance on the specified date.
choices.b: No, because the contractual obligations were discharged on the ground of impossibility.
choices.c: Yes, because the seller anticipatorily repudiated the contract when he sold the car to the third party.
choices.d: Yes, because the seller did not inform the buyer of his repudiation.

Q81139

A buyer agreed in writing to purchase a car from a seller for $15,000, with the price to be paid on a specified date at the seller's home. The contract provided, and both parties intended, that time was of the essence. Before the specified date, however, the seller sold the car to a third party for $18,000. On the specified date, the buyer arrived at the seller's home prepared to tender payment. The seller was not there, so the buyer called the seller to ask where he was. The seller then told the buyer that he had sold the car to the third party.

If the buyer sues the seller for breach of contract, will the buyer be likely to prevail?

一位买方书面同意以15,000美元的价格从一位卖方处购买一辆汽车，价款将于指定日期在卖方家中支付。合同规定且双方均意图，时间是合同的要项。然而，在指定日期之前，卖方将该车以18,000美元的价格卖给了第三方。在指定日期，买方到达卖方家中，准备支付价款。卖方不在，于是买方致电卖方询问其下落。卖方随后告知买方，他已将车卖给了第三方。

如果买方以违约为由起诉卖方，买方是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the buyer did not tender her performance on the specified date.
否，因为买方未在指定日期提交其履行。

B. No, because the contractual obligations were discharged on the ground of impossibility.
否，因为合同义务以履行不能为由被解除。

C. Yes, because the seller anticipatorily repudiated the contract when he sold the car to the third party.
是，因为卖方在将车卖给第三方时，已构成预期毁约。

D. Yes, because the seller did not inform the buyer of his repudiation.
是，因为卖方未将其毁约一事通知买方。
data.explanation:
A contract is breached when a party fails to perform contractual duties at the time performance is due. A breach can also occur before the time for performance arises or elapses under the doctrine of anticipatory repudiation. This doctrine applies when a party clearly and unequivocally, by words or actions, indicates an unwillingness to perform.† Upon repudiation, the nonrepudiating party can suspend his/her own performance and either:
  • treat the repudiation as a breach and sue immediately or
  • ignore the repudiation and demand performance pursuant to the contract.
Here, the seller clearly and unequivocally repudiated the contract with the buyer by selling the car to a third party. Since the buyer has the right to treat this anticipatory repudiation as a breach of contract, she will likely prevail in a suit against the seller.

†If a party's words or actions provide reasonable grounds for insecurity about the party's performance, the other party may demand adequate assurances.

(Choice A) The buyer arrived at the seller's home on the specified date to tender payment. However, since the seller had anticipatorily repudiated the contract, the buyer's duty to tender performance was discharged.

(Choice B) Performance is discharged due to impossibility when an unexpected and extraordinary event beyond the parties' control makes performance impossible. But since the seller's own actions made it impossible to sell the car, his contractual obligations were not discharged.

(Choice D) The seller did not need to inform the buyer of his repudiation because an anticipatory repudiation can be express or implied. It is express if the repudiating party informs the other of his/her intention not to perform and is implied if the repudiating party's actions prevent him/her from being able to perform (as seen here).

Educational objective: Anticipatory repudiation occurs when a contracting party clearly and unequivocally, by words or actions, indicates that he/she will not perform. Upon repudiation, the nonrepudiating party can suspend his/her own performance and either
  • treat the repudiation as a breach and sue or
  • ignore it and demand performance.




选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 3%，C选项 61%（正确选项），D选项 33%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当一方未在履行到期时履行合同义务，即构成违约。根据doctrine of anticipatory repudiation（预期毁约原则），违约也可能在履行时间到来或经过之前发生。该原则适用于一方通过言语或行为，清晰且明确地表示不愿意履行合同义务的情况。† 发生毁约时，非毁约方可以中止其自身的履行，并可选择：
  • 将该毁约视为违约并立即起诉或
  • 忽略该毁约并根据合同要求履行。
在本案中，卖方通过将车卖给第三方，已清晰且明确地对与买方的合同进行了毁约。由于买方有权将此预期毁约视为违约，她在对卖方的诉讼中很可能胜诉。

†如果一方的言语或行为导致另一方对其履约能力产生合理的不安全感，另一方可以要求获得充分的保证。

(选项A) 买方在指定日期到达卖方家中以提交付款。然而，由于卖方已预期毁约，买方提交履行的义务已被解除。

(选项B) 当超出双方控制范围的意外和特殊事件导致履行不能时，履行义务因履行不能而被解除。但由于是卖方自身的行为导致其无法出售该车，其合同义务并未被解除。

(选项D) 卖方无需将其毁约一事通知买方，因为预期毁约可以是明示的或默示的。如果毁约方向另一方表明其不履行的意图，则为明示毁约；如果毁约方的行为使其无法履行（如本案所示），则为默示毁约。

教学目标：当合同一方通过言语或行为，清晰且明确地表示其将不履行合同时，即构成预期毁约。发生毁约时，非毁约方可以中止其自身的履行，并可选择
  • 将该毁约视为违约并提起诉讼，或
  • 忽略该毁约并要求对方履行。


References

U.C.C. § 2-610 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (anticipatory repudiation).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance & Breach
正确答案：C

是的，因为卖方在将车卖给第三方时，已构成预期毁约 (Anticipatory Repudiation)。

⚖️ 核心法律原则

预期毁约 (Anticipatory Repudiation)

根据美国合同法（包括普通法和 UCC § 2-610），预期毁约发生在履行期限届满之前。它要求一方通过以下两种方式之一，清晰且明确 (Clearly and Unequivocally) 地表明其将不履行合同：

  1. 言语 (Words)： 直接告知对方“我不打算履行了”。
  2. 行为 (Conduct/Action)： 自愿采取某种行动，使得履行变得不可能 (Voluntary affirmative act that renders performance impossible)。
🔍 案情逻辑分析

本题是通过行为构成预期毁约的教科书式案例：

  • 合同标的： 一辆特定的汽车（特定物）。
  • 关键事实： 在履行日期到来之前，卖方将这辆特定的车卖给了第三方。
  • 法律后果： 卖方的这一自愿行为使得他无法再将车卖给原买方。这构成了默示的预期毁约 (Implied Anticipatory Repudiation)。
  • 买方权利： 一旦卖方毁约，买方有权：
    1. 中止自己的履行（无需再付款）；
    2. 立即起诉违约（无需等到合同规定的履行日期）。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A 错误 (关于 Tender)：

虽然通常买方需要提出履行 (Tender of performance) 才能让对方承担违约责任，但预期毁约免除了非毁约方的履行义务。因为卖方已经把车卖了，买方再拿钱去也是徒劳 (Futile)，法律不强求徒劳之举。

选项 B 错误 (关于 Impossibility)：

履行不能 (Impossibility) 是一种抗辩理由，通常指不可预见且超出双方控制的客观事件（如车被雷劈了）。如果是当事人自己造成的无法履行（如本案卖方主动卖车），不能作为免责理由，而直接构成违约。

选项 D 错误 (关于 Notice)：

预期毁约并不要求毁约方必须通知对方。毁约既可以是明示的（通知），也可以是默示的（行为）。卖方把车卖给别人的那一刻，违约就已经发生了，是否通知只影响买方何时知道，不影响违约的定性。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

看到涉及特定商品 (Unique Goods) 或土地的买卖合同题时，如果卖方在交割日前将标的物转让给了第三方，请立即联想：

  1. 这是预期毁约 (Anticipatory Repudiation)。
  2. 买方的履行义务（付款）被解除 (Discharged)。
  3. 买方可以立即起诉。

不要被“买方是否带了钱”或“卖方是否打电话”这些细节迷惑。

questions.question:
On June 1, a woman telegraphed a vendor, "At what price will you sell 100 of your basic garbage-disposal units for delivery around June 10?" On June 2, the vendor telegraphed the woman, "You're in luck. We have only 100 basic garbage-disposal units, all on clearance at 50% off usual wholesale of $120 per unit, for delivery at our shipping platform on June 12." On June 5, the vendor received a letter from the woman that stated, "I accept. Would prefer to pay in full 30 days after invoice."
On June 6, the woman received a telegram from the vendor that stated, "You must pick up at our platform and pay upon delivery." On June 9, the vendor received a letter from the woman that stated, "I don't deal with people who can't accommodate my simple requests." On June 10, the vendor received a telegram from the woman that stated, "Okay. I'm over a barrel and will pick up the goods on your terms on June 12." The vendor had sold all 100 of the units to another buyer earlier that day.
The woman sued the vendor for breach of contract.
Which of the following arguments will best serve the vendor's defense?

choices.a: The vendor's telegraph on June 2 was merely a price quotation, not an offer.
choices.b: The woman's letter on June 5 was not an acceptance because it varied from the terms of the vendor's initial telegraph.
choices.c: The woman's letter on June 9 was an unequivocal refusal to perform that excused the vendor even if the parties had previously formed a contract.
choices.d: The woman's use of the mail in response to the vendor's initial telegraph was an ineffective method of acceptance.

On June 2, the vendor telegraphed the woman, "You're in luck. We have only 100 basic garbage-disposal units, all on clearance at 50% off usual wholesale of $120 per unit, for delivery at our shipping platform on June 12." On June 5, the vendor received a letter from the woman that stated, "I accept. Would prefer to pay in full 30 days after invoice."

On June 6, the woman received a telegram from the vendor that stated, "You must pick up at our platform and pay upon delivery." On June 9, the vendor received a letter from the woman that stated, "I don't deal with people who can't accommodate my simple requests." On June 10, the vendor received a telegram from the woman that stated, "Okay. I'm over a barrel and will pick up the goods on your terms on June 12." The vendor had sold all 100 of the units to another buyer earlier that day.

The woman sued the vendor for breach of contract.

Which of the following arguments will best serve the vendor's defense?

6月1日，一名女士向一名供应商发电报询问：“你们以什么价格出售100台基本款垃圾处理器，并于6月10日左右交货？”6月2日，该供应商向该女士发电报称：“您很幸运。我们正好还有100台基本款垃圾处理器，全部清仓处理，按正常批发价每台120美元的五折出售，于6月12日在我们的发货平台交货。”6月5日，供应商收到该女士的一封信，信中说：“我接受。希望在发票开具后30天内全额付款。”

6月6日，该女士收到供应商的电报，称：“您必须在我们的平台提货并于交货时付款。”6月9日，供应商收到该女士的一封信，信中说：“我从不与无法满足我简单要求的人做生意。”6月10日，供应商收到该女士的电报，称：“好吧。我别无选择，将于6月12日按你们的条件提货。”当天早些时候，该供应商已将全部100台垃圾处理器卖给了另一位买家。

该女士以违约为由起诉了该供应商。

以下哪项论点最能支持供应商的抗辩？
options:
A. The vendor's telegraph on June 2 was merely a price quotation, not an offer.
供应商6月2日的电报仅仅是报价，而非要约。

B. The woman's letter on June 5 was not an acceptance because it varied from the terms of the vendor's initial telegraph.
该女士6月5日的信函并非一项承诺，因为它变更了供应商最初电报中的条款。

C. The woman's letter on June 9 was an unequivocal refusal to perform that excused the vendor even if the parties had previously formed a contract.
该女士6月9日的信函是明确的拒绝履行表示，即使双方先前已订立合同，该表示也免除了供应商的履行义务。

D. The woman's use of the mail in response to the vendor's initial telegraph was an ineffective method of acceptance.
该女士使用邮寄方式回应供应商的初始电报，是一种无效的承诺方式。
data.explanation:
Anticipatory repudiation


StandardParty's clear & unequivocal words or actions indicate unwillingness to perform
RetractionParty may retract repudiation unless nonrepudiating party:
  • cancels contract
  • materially changes position in reliance thereon or
  • indicates repudiation is final
EffectUpon repudiation, nonrepudiating party may:
  • treat repudiation as breach or
  • ignore repudiation & demand performance

Nonrepudiating party may also suspend own performance



The doctrine of anticipatory repudiation applies when a party clearly and unequivocally indicates an unwillingness to perform a promise before the time for performance is due. The nonrepudiating party may treat the repudiation as a breach or ignore it and demand performance pursuant to the contract. Additionally, any performance owed by the nonrepudiating party is excused.

Here, the parties likely formed a contract for the sale of the garbage-disposal units, which the vendor then sold to another buyer on June 10. However, the vendor's performance may be excused by the woman's anticipatory repudiation on June 9. That is because her June 9 letter could be interpreted as an unequivocal refusal to perform since it stated, "I don't deal with people who can't accommodate my simple requests." Therefore, this argument will best serve the vendor's defense.†

†The woman will not be able to argue that she retracted her repudiation because her attempted retraction occurred after the vendor had materially changed position in reliance on the repudiation by selling the units to another buyer.

(Choice A) An offer must express definite terms and an intent to be bound, thereby justifying acceptance by the offeree. Here, the vendor's June 2 telegraph would probably be interpreted as an offer (not a price quotation) because its terms were definite (100 units at 50% off) and it gave the woman the power to accept.

(Choice B) Contracts for the sale of goods (eg, garbage-disposal units) are governed by the UCC, which follows the battle-of-the-forms rule for contract formation. Under this rule, an enforceable contract is created once there has been an offer and acceptance - even if the acceptance varies the terms of the offer (as seen here).

(Choice D) The woman's use of the mail was an effective method of acceptance since the vendor did not specify how acceptance was to be rendered.

Educational objective: When a party anticipatorily repudiates a contract, the nonrepudiating party may treat the repudiation as a breach or ignore it and demand performance. Additionally, any performance owed by the nonrepudiating party is excused.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code



选项正确率统计：A选项 18%，B选项 16%，C选项 64%（正确选项），D选项 0%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

预期拒绝履行


标准一方当事人通过清晰明确的言词或行为，表明其不愿履行合同义务
撤回当事人可以撤回其拒绝履行的表示，除非未拒绝履行方已经：
  • 取消合同
  • 因信赖该表示而使其处境发生重大改变或
  • 表示已将对方的拒绝履行视为最终决定
效果一旦发生拒绝履行，未拒绝履行方可以：
  • 将该拒绝履行视为违约或
  • 忽略该拒绝履行并要求对方履行合同

未拒绝履行方也可以中止自己的履行



当一方当事人在履行期限到来之前，清晰明确地表示其不愿履行合同义务时，适用预期拒绝履行（anticipatory repudiation）原则。未拒绝履行方可将此拒绝履行视为违约，或忽略之并要求对方根据合同履行义务。此外，未拒绝履行方应负的任何履行义务也得以免除。

在本案中，双方很可能就垃圾处理器的销售成立了合同，而供应商随后在6月10日将这些产品卖给了另一位买家。然而，供应商的履行义务可能因该女士在6月9日的预期拒绝履行而得以免除。这是因为她6月9日的信函可被解释为明确拒绝履行，因其声称：“我从不与无法满足我简单要求的人做生意。”因此，这一论点最能支持供应商的抗辩。†

†该女士将无法主张她撤回了其拒绝履行的表示，因为她尝试撤回时，供应商已因信赖其拒绝履行的表示，将产品出售给另一买家，从而使其处境发生了重大改变。

(选项A) 一项要约必须表达明确的条款和受其约束的意图，从而使受要约人有理由作出承诺。在本案中，供应商6月2日的电报很可能被解释为一项要约（而非报价），因为其条款是明确的（100台，五折），并赋予了该女士承诺的权力。

(选项B) 货物买卖合同（例如垃圾处理器）受UCC管辖，UCC在合同成立上遵循“格式之战”规则。根据该规则，一旦存在要约和承诺，即使承诺变更了要约的条款（如本案所示），一项可执行的合同即告成立。

(选项D) 该女士使用邮寄的方式是一种有效的承诺方式，因为供应商并未指明应如何作出承诺。

教学目标：当一方当事人预期拒绝履行合同时，未拒绝履行方可将该拒绝履行视为违约，或忽略之并要求对方履行。此外，未拒绝履行方应负的任何履行义务也得以免除。

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code (美国统一商法典)

References

U.C.C.§ 2-610 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (anticipatory repudiation).

MBE 考点解析：预期违约

本题考察的核心法律原则是美国统一商法典（UCC）下的 预期拒绝履行 (Anticipatory Repudiation) 及其撤回限制。

正确答案：C
该女士6月9日的信函构成了明确的拒绝履行，且供应商已产生信赖利益（将货物转卖），因此该女士无法再撤回其拒绝表示。

1. 案件时间线梳理

6月2日 (Vendor)
发出明确要约 (Offer)。
6月5日 (Woman)
发出接受信函。合同成立 (Contract Formed)。
注：付款条件的变更建议不影响合同成立。
6月9日 (Woman)
信函送达："我从不与无法满足我要求的人做生意。"
➔ 预期拒绝履行 (Repudiation)
6月10日早些时候 (Vendor)
将货物卖给第三方。
➔ 实质性改变处境 (Material Change of Position)
6月10日晚些时候 (Woman)
试图撤回拒绝并履约。
➔ 撤回无效 (Ineffective Retraction)

2. 核心法理解析

什么是预期拒绝履行？
根据 UCC § 2-610，当一方在履行期到来前，明确且毫不含糊地 (unequivocally) 表示其将不履行合同时，即构成预期拒绝履行。

在本案中，女士在6月9日的信中称“我从不与无法满足我简单要求的人做生意”，这被视为明确拒绝履行合同义务。

拒绝履行后的撤回 (Retraction)
根据 UCC § 2-611，违约方通常可以在履行期届满前撤回其拒绝履行的表示。但是，如果受害方（供应商）在收到撤回通知之前已经：

  • 取消了合同；或者
  • 实质性地改变了处境 (Materially changed position)；或者
  • 表示认为该拒绝履行是最终的。

那么，违约方就不能再撤回了。

本案关键点：供应商在收到女士6月10日的“妥协”电报之前，已经将货物卖给了别人。这种转卖行为属于基于信赖而发生的“实质性处境改变”。因此，女士的撤回无效，供应商的抗辩成立。

3. 为什么其他选项是错的？

  • 选项 A (报价 vs 要约)：错误。供应商6月2日的电报包含具体的数量（100台）、价格（$60/台）、交货时间和地点，且用语（"You're in luck"）表明了受约束的意图，因此是有效的 要约 (Offer)，而非简单的报价邀请。
  • 选项 B (格式之战)：错误。本案涉及货物买卖，适用 UCC。UCC 废除了普通法下的“镜像规则” (Mirror Image Rule)。根据 UCC § 2-207，除非接受明确以同意新条款为条件，否则包含不同条款的接受仍然构成有效的承诺。女士的信中只是表达“希望 (Would prefer)”，这只是建议，不阻碍合同成立。
  • 选项 D (承诺方式)：错误。除非要约明确规定了必须使用的承诺方式，否则使用合理的商业媒介（如邮件）进行承诺是有效的。
💡 考试技巧：
在处理 UCC 合同题时，务必画出时间线。特别注意“拒绝履行 (Repudiation)”发生后，非违约方是否采取了行动（如转卖货物）。一旦非违约方采取了行动，违约方就失去了“反悔”的机会。

questions.question:
A young lawyer asked her neighbor to lend her $1,000. On September 15, the neighbor lent $1,000 to the lawyer, which she agreed to repay in installments of $100 plus accrued interest on the last day of each month beginning October 31. The lawyer did not pay the installments due on October 31, November 30, or December 31 and has informed the neighbor that she will be unable to make repayments in the foreseeable future.
On January 15, the neighbor is entitled to a judgment against the lawyer for which of the following amounts?

choices.a: Nothing, because if the neighbor sues before the entire amount is due, he will be splitting his cause of action.
choices.b: $300 plus the accrued interest, because the lawyer's breach is only a partial breach.
choices.c: $1,000 plus the accrued interest, because the failure to pay her debts as they come due indicates that the lawyer is insolvent and the neighbor is thereby entitled to accelerate payment of the debt.
choices.d: $1,000 plus the accrued interest, because the lawyer's unexcused failure to pay three installments is a material breach.

data.questionStem:
Q81154

A young lawyer asked her neighbor to lend her $1,000. On September 15, the neighbor lent $1,000 to the lawyer, which she agreed to repay in installments of $100 plus accrued interest on the last day of each month beginning October 31. The lawyer did not pay the installments due on October 31, November 30, or December 31 and has informed the neighbor that she will be unable to make repayments in the foreseeable future.

On January 15, the neighbor is entitled to a judgment against the lawyer for which of the following amounts?

一名年轻律师请求其邻居借给她1000美元。9月15日，邻居借给该律师1000美元，她同意从10月31日开始，在每个月的最后一天分期偿还100美元及应计利息。该律师未能支付10月31日、11月30日和12月31日到期的分期款项，并已告知邻居她在可预见的未来将无法偿还。

在1月15日，邻居有权就以下哪项金额获得对该律师的判决？
options:
A. Nothing, because if the neighbor sues before the entire amount is due, he will be splitting his cause of action.
无权获得任何赔偿，因为如果邻居在全部款项到期前起诉，他将分割其诉因。

B. $300 plus the accrued interest, because the lawyer's breach is only a partial breach.
300美元及应计利息，因为该律师的违约仅构成部分违约。

C. $1,000 plus the accrued interest, because the failure to pay her debts as they come due indicates that the lawyer is insolvent and the neighbor is thereby entitled to accelerate payment of the debt.
1000美元及应计利息，因为未能按期偿还债务表明该律师已无力偿债，因此邻居有权要求加速偿还该债务。

D. $1,000 plus the accrued interest, because the lawyer's unexcused failure to pay three installments is a material breach.
1000美元及应计利息，因为该律师无故未能支付三期分期款项构成重大违约。
data.explanation:
Installment contracts


DeliveriesPrice for each installment generally due at time & place of each delivery Seller's damages for breach amount to missed payments Buyer's damages for breach amount to fair market value minus contract price for missed deliveries
PaymentsCreditor's damages for breach amount to missed payments
Breach by nonperformance coupled with repudiation of the contract typically gives rise to a claim for damages for total breach. This is true unless , at the time of the breach, the only contractual obligation that remains is for the breaching party to make installment payments of money. In that circumstance, the breaching party's failure to pay - whether or not coupled with a repudiation - gives rise to a claim for damages for partial breach only. This means that the nonbreaching party can recover the missed payments.

Here, the lawyer failed to pay the first three installments of $100 plus accrued interest (breach by nonperformance) and informed the neighbor that she would be unable to make repayments in the foreseeable future (repudiation). However, the only contractual obligation remaining on either side was for the lawyer to make the rest of the installment payments. Therefore, the neighbor has a claim for damages for partial breach only, and he is entitled to a judgment against the lawyer for $300 plus the accrued interest (missed payments).

(Choice A) After breach of an installment contract, the nonbreaching party can (1) wait until the end of the contract and sue for the total damages or (2) split the cause of action - ie, sue for partial breach immediately and reserve the right to sue again for later breaches.

(Choice C) Under the UCC, each party to a sale-of-goods contract gains certain rights when the other party becomes insolvent. However, this does not apply to loan contracts, which are governed by common law.

(Choice D) A material breach occurs when the nonbreaching party fails to receive the substantial benefit of the contract. But failing to make a few payments of an installment loan is only a partial breach.

Educational objective: Breach by nonperformance coupled with repudiation typically gives rise to a claim for total breach. But where the only duty that remains at the time of breach is for the breaching party to pay installments, the failure to do so - whether or not coupled with a repudiation - gives rise to a claim for partial breach only.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code.

选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 58%（正确选项），C选项 13%，D选项 25%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

分期付款合同


交付每期分期付款的价格通常在每次交付的时间和地点到期支付。卖方因违约所获的损害赔偿额为未支付的款项。买方因违约所获的损害赔偿额为未交付部分的公平市场价值减去合同价格。
付款债权人因违约所获的损害赔偿额为未支付的款项。
不履行导致的违约与合同的预期违约（repudiation）相结合，通常会引起完全违约的损害赔偿请求。除非在违约时，仅存的合同义务是违约方分期支付款项，否则上述规则成立。在这种情况下，违约方未能付款——无论是否伴有预期违约——仅能引起部分违约的损害赔偿请求。这意味着非违约方可以追讨未支付的款项。

在本案中，该律师未能支付前三期每期100美元及应计利息的款项（不履行导致的违约），并告知邻居她在可预见的未来将无法偿还（预期违约）。然而，双方仅存的合同义务是该律师支付剩余的分期款项。因此，邻居仅能就部分违约提出损害赔偿请求，并且他有权获得对该律师300美元及应计利息（未支付的款项）的判决。

（选项A）在分期付款合同违约后，非违约方可以（1）等到合同期满后就全部损害提起诉讼，或（2）分割诉因——即，立即就部分违约提起诉讼，并保留对后续违约再次起诉的权利。

（选项C）根据UCC，在货物买卖合同中，当一方无力偿债时，另一方会获得某些权利。然而，这不适用于受普通法管辖的借贷合同。

（选项D）当非违约方未能获得合同的实质性利益时，即构成重大违约。但未能支付分期贷款中的几期款项仅构成部分违约。

教学目的：不履行导致的违约与预期违约相结合通常会引起完全违约的索赔。但是，如果在违约时仅存的义务是违约方支付分期款项，那么其未能付款的行为——无论是否伴有预期违约——仅能引起部分违约的索赔。

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code（《统一商法典》）。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 243 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (effect of breach by nonperformance).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Installment Breach

正确答案：B

本题考查的是普通法下分期付款合同（Installment Contracts）中关于金钱债务违约的特殊规则。

核心考点：单方金钱债务例外 当合同一方已经完全履行了其义务（如借出款项），而另一方仅剩下的义务是分期支付金钱时，即使违约方明确表示将来不付款（Repudiation），非违约方也不能立即就未来的所有款项起诉，只能就已到期未付的款项起诉。
法律逻辑分析

通常情况下，如果一方预期违约（Anticipatory Repudiation），另一方可以立即起诉要求赔偿全部损失（Total Breach）。

但是，根据《合同法重述（第二次）》§ 243(3)，存在一个重要的例外：

  • 事实认定：邻居已经借出了1000美元，意味着邻居已经完成了合同下的所有义务。
  • 剩余义务：律师唯一的义务就是分期还钱。
  • 违约状态：律师未付3期款项（10月、11月、12月），并表示将来也不付。
  • 结论：由于这是单方面的金钱债务（Unilateral obligation to pay money），邻居不能适用“预期违约”规则来加速整个债务的到期。

因此，邻居只能起诉已经到期的款项：
$100 × 3个月 = $300（加上利息）。

为什么不能拿回全部 $1000？

除非合同中明确写有加速到期条款（Acceleration Clause），否则法院不会替当事人重写合同。如果允许邻居现在拿回全部$1000，实际上是剥夺了律师原本享有的“分期付款”的时间利益。

易错项辨析
  • 选项 A (Splitting cause of action)：错误。在分期付款合同中，起诉已到期的款项并不视为分割诉因。债权人可以起诉现在的欠款，以后再起诉未来的欠款。
  • 选项 C (Insolvency)：错误。无力偿债（Insolvency）本身并不自动导致债务加速到期（Acceleration）。除非合同里有专门针对无力偿债的加速条款，否则普通法不予自动加速。
  • 选项 D (Material Breach)：错误。虽然不付款是重大违约，但在纯金钱债务的单务合同中，重大违约也不能触发对“未来”款项的索赔权。
Exam Tip: 看到“借款合同”且一方已放款，另一方分期还款时，警惕“预期违约”规则的例外。没有加速条款，只能讨要已过期的钱。

questions.question:
On March 1, an excavator entered into a contract with a contractor to perform excavation work on a large project. The contract expressly required that the excavator begin work on June 1 to enable other subcontractors to install utilities. On May 15, the excavator requested a 30-day delay in the start date for the excavation work because he was seriously behind schedule on another project. When the contractor refused to grant the delay, the excavator stated that he would try to begin the work for the contractor on June 1.
Does the contractor have valid legal grounds to cancel the contract with the excavator and hire a replacement?

choices.a: No, because the excavator did not state unequivocally that he would delay the beginning of his work.
choices.b: No, because the excavator would be entitled to specific performance of the contract if he could begin by June 1.
choices.c: Yes, because the excavator breached the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing.
choices.d: Yes, because the excavator committed an anticipatory repudiation of the contract by causing the contractor to feel insecure about the performance.

data.questionStem:
Q81144

On March 1, an excavator entered into a contract with a contractor to perform excavation work on a large project. The contract expressly required that the excavator begin work on June 1 to enable other subcontractors to install utilities. On May 15, the excavator requested a 30-day delay in the start date for the excavation work because he was seriously behind schedule on another project. When the contractor refused to grant the delay, the excavator stated that he would try to begin the work for the contractor on June 1.

Does the contractor have valid legal grounds to cancel the contract with the excavator and hire a replacement?

3月1日，一家挖掘商与一个承包商签订合同，为一个大型项目进行挖掘工作。合同明确要求挖掘商于6月1日开工，以便其他分包商能够安装公用设施。5月15日，该挖掘商因在另一个项目上进度严重落后，请求将开工日期延迟30天。当承包商拒绝批准此延迟请求后，挖掘商表示他会“尽力”在6月1日为承包商开工。

该承包商是否有充分的法律依据来解除与挖掘商的合同并雇佣替代者？
options:
A. No, because the excavator did not state unequivocally that he would delay the beginning of his work.
没有，因为挖掘商并未明确表示他将延迟开工。

B. No, because the excavator would be entitled to specific performance of the contract if he could begin by June 1.
没有，因为如果挖掘商能在6月1日开工，他将有权要求对合同进行特定履行。

C. Yes, because the excavator breached the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing.
有，因为挖掘商违反了默示的诚信与公平交易契约 (implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing)。

D. Yes, because the excavator committed an anticipatory repudiation of the contract by causing the contractor to feel insecure about the performance.
有，因为挖掘商的行为使承包商对合同的履行感到不安，构成了预期违约。
data.explanation:
Anticipatory repudiation


StandardParty's clear & unequivocal words or actions indicate unwillingness to perform
RetractionParty may retract repudiation unless nonrepudiating party:
  • cancels contract
  • materially changes position in reliance thereon or
  • indicates repudiation is final
EffectUpon repudiation, nonrepudiating party may:
  • treat repudiation as breach or
  • ignore repudiation & demand performance
Nonrepudiating party may also suspend own performance
Under the doctrine of anticipatory repudiation, a contracting party may treat another party's repudiation as a breach and cancel the contract. A repudiation occurs when a party clearly and unequivocally, by words or acts, expresses an unwillingness to perform. But a party's mere expression of doubt as to its ability to perform or request that the contract be modified does not constitute a repudiation.

Here, the excavator requested a 30-day delay in the start date of his work. After the contractor denied this request, the excavator stated that he would try to begin work on the start date. Neither of these statements is an unequivocal assertion that the excavator would delay the beginning of his work. Therefore, the excavator did not anticipatorily repudiate the contract, and the contractor has no valid legal ground to cancel it.

(Choice B) Specific performance is an available remedy when monetary damages would be inadequate. Here, monetary damages would be adequate to compensate the excavator if the contractor unjustifiably canceled the contract.

(Choice C) All contracts contain an implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing, which prohibits the parties from engaging in improper behavior (eg, deceit). But the excavator did not breach this covenant since his request for a delay was reasonable considering his circumstances.

(Choice D) A party with reasonable grounds for insecurity about the other's performance may demand adequate assurances that the other party will perform. If the other party fails to provide those assurances within a reasonable time, the contract is anticipatorily repudiated. Although the excavator's statements were reasonable grounds for insecurity, the contractor did not demand assurances.

Educational objective: An anticipatory repudiation occurs when a party clearly and unequivocally, by words or acts, indicates an intention not to perform pursuant to the contract. Mere expressions of doubt regarding one's ability to perform or a request to modify the contract does not suffice.

选项正确率统计：A选项 87%（正确选项），B选项 2%，C选项 0%，D选项 8%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

预期违约 (Anticipatory repudiation)


标准一方当事人通过清晰明确的言语或行为表示不愿履行合同
撤回当事人可以撤回其预期违约，除非未违约方：
  • 解除了合同
  • 基于对该违约的信赖而实质性地改变了其地位 或
  • 表示该违约是最终的
效力在一方预期违约后，未违约方可以：
  • 将预期违约视作实际违约 或
  • 忽略该预期违约并要求履行
未违约方也可以中止自己的履行
根据预期违约 (anticipatory repudiation)原则，合同一方可以将另一方的预期违约行为视为违约并解除合同。当一方当事人通过言语或行为清晰明确地表示不愿履行合同时，即构成预期违约。但是，一方当事人仅仅对其履行能力表示怀疑，或请求修改合同，并不构成预期违约。

在本案中，挖掘商请求将开工日期延迟30天。在承包商拒绝该请求后，挖掘商表示他会尽力在原定开工日开工。这些陈述均未明确断言挖掘商将会延迟开工。因此，挖掘商并未构成预期违约，承包商没有充分的法律依据解除合同。

（选项B）特定履行是在金钱赔偿不足以弥补损失时的一种可用救济方式。在本案中，如果承包商无理地解除合同，金钱赔偿足以补偿挖掘商的损失。

（选项C）所有合同都包含默示的诚信与公平交易契约 (implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing)，该契约禁止双方从事不正当行为（例如，欺诈）。但挖掘商并未违反此契约，因为考虑到他的情况，其延迟请求是合理的。

（选项D）对于另一方的履行有合理理由感到不安的一方，可以要求对方提供其将履约的充分保证。如果另一方未能在合理时间内提供这些保证，则合同构成预期违约。尽管挖掘商的言论构成了使人不安的合理理由，但承包商并未要求对方提供保证。

教学目标：预期违约 (anticipatory repudiation) 是指一方当事人通过言语或行为清晰明确地表示其不打算根据合同进行履行的意图。仅仅对自己的履约能力表示怀疑或请求修改合同，尚不足以构成预期违约。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 250 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (repudiation).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 253 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (effect of an anticipatory repudiation).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Anticipatory Repudiation
合同法：预期违约

核心考点：预期违约的标准

本题考察的核心是：什么样的言行才构成预期违约 (Anticipatory Repudiation)？

法律规则 (The Rule):
预期违约必须是当事人通过言语或行为，清晰且明确 (Clear and Unequivocal) 地表示其将不会履行合同义务。

仅仅是以下行为不构成预期违约：

  • 表达对履行能力的怀疑 (Expressions of doubt)
  • 请求修改合同条款 (Request for modification)
  • 表示履行将会很困难
案情分析与逻辑推理

为什么承包商 (Contractor) 没有权利取消合同？让我们拆解挖掘商 (Excavator) 的行为：

1
请求延迟 (Request for Delay):
挖掘商请求推迟30天。这只是一个修改合同的提议 (Proposal)，而非拒绝履行。
2
"我会尽力" (I will try):
当请求被拒后，挖掘商说他会“尽力”按时开工。虽然这句话听起来不自信，但它不是“我绝不开工”的明确声明。
3
结论:
因为挖掘商没有做出“绝对不履行”的明确表示，所以不构成预期违约。承包商直接取消合同，反而构成了承包商自己的违约。

因此，正确答案是 A。

常见陷阱：不安抗辩权

很多考生会误选 选项 D。这是一个非常经典的 MBE 干扰项。

考点辨析：

如果一方的言行让另一方感到“不安” (Insecure)，另一方该怎么办？

正确做法 (Right Way):
根据 Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 251，感到不安的一方应当书面要求对方提供履约保证 (Demand for Adequate Assurances)。

本案错误 (Wrong Way):
承包商虽然有理由感到不安，但他没有要求保证，而是直接取消了合同。只有在要求了保证而对方未能在合理时间内提供时，才转化为预期违约。

MBE 实战技巧
  • 看到 "Anticipatory Repudiation"，立刻寻找是否有 "Unequivocal" (毫不含糊) 的拒绝。
  • 如果只是 "I might not be able to..." 或 "I'm having trouble..."，通常不是预期违约。
  • 注意区分 "Breach" (违约) 和 "Grounds for Insecurity" (不安的理由)。前者可以直接解约，后者必须先要求保证 (Demand Assurances)。

questions.question:
An engineer entered into a written contract with an owner to serve in the essential position of on-site supervisor for construction of an office building. The day after signing the contract, the engineer was injured while bicycling and was rendered physically incapable of performing as the on-site supervisor. The engineer offered to serve as an off-site consultant for the same pay as originally agreed to by the parties.
Is the owner likely to prevail in an action against the engineer for damages resulting from his failure to perform under the contract?

choices.a: No, because the engineer offered a reasonable substitute by offering to serve as an off-site consultant.
choices.b: No, because the engineer's physical ability to perform as on-site supervisor was a basic assumption of the contract.
choices.c: Yes, because the engineer breached the contract by disappointing the owner's expectations.
choices.d: Yes, because the engineer's duty to perform was personal and absolute.

data.questionStem:
Q81176

An engineer entered into a written contract with an owner to serve in the essential position of on-site supervisor for construction of an office building. The day after signing the contract, the engineer was injured while bicycling and was rendered physically incapable of performing as the on-site supervisor. The engineer offered to serve as an off-site consultant for the same pay as originally agreed to by the parties.

Is the owner likely to prevail in an action against the engineer for damages resulting from his failure to perform under the contract?

一名工程师与一名业主签订了一份书面合同，担任办公楼建设中现场主管这一关键职位。签订合同的第二天，该工程师在骑行时受伤，导致其身体上无法履行现场主管的职责。该工程师提出以双方最初约定的相同薪酬，担任非现场顾问。

业主因工程师未能履行合同而对其提起的损害赔偿诉讼，是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the engineer offered a reasonable substitute by offering to serve as an off-site consultant.
不会，因为该工程师提出担任非现场顾问，从而提供了合理的替代方案。

B. No, because the engineer's physical ability to perform as on-site supervisor was a basic assumption of the contract.
不会，因为该工程师履行现场主管职责的身体能力是合同的一项基本假设。

C. Yes, because the engineer breached the contract by disappointing the owner's expectations.
会，因为该工程师未能满足业主的期望，从而违反了合同。

D. Yes, because the engineer's duty to perform was personal and absolute.
会，因为该工程师的履行义务是属人且绝对的。
data.explanation:
A contracting party's duty to perform can be discharged by impracticability. The defense of impracticability is available when:

an unanticipated or extraordinary event makes it impracticable for the party to perform, the contract was formed under a basic assumption that the event would not occur and the party seeking discharge was not at fault in causing the event to occur.

Here, the engineer entered into a contract to serve in the essential position of on-site supervisor for construction of an office building. The next day, the engineer suffered a bicycle injury that rendered him physically incapable of performing. Because the engineer's physical ability to perform as on-site supervisor was a basic assumption of the contract and there is no indication that the injury was his fault, his duty to perform was discharged. Therefore, the engineer did not breach the contract by failing to perform, and the owner is unlikely to prevail (Choice C).

(Choice A) An offer by a party to perform less than what was contracted for (eg, the engineer's offer to serve as an off-site consultant) will not excuse a breach. This is true even if the offered performance is a reasonable substitute.

(Choice D) Although the engineer's duty to perform was personal and absolute, he is not in breach - and the owner will not prevail - because the doctrine of impracticability excused the engineer's nonperformance under the contract.

Educational objective: The defense of impracticability is available when
  • an unanticipated or extraordinary event makes it impracticable for a party to perform,
  • the contract was formed under a basic assumption that the event would not occur, and
  • the party seeking discharge was not at fault in causing the event to occur.




选项正确率统计：A选项 8%，B选项 79%（正确选项），C选项 2%，D选项 9%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

合同当事人的履行义务可因履行不能 (impracticability)而被免除。当出现以下情况时，可以适用履行不能的抗辩：

某个不可预见或异常的事件导致当事人履行合同变得不切实际，合同的订立基于该事件不会发生的基本假设，并且寻求免除义务的当事人对该事件的发生没有过错。

在本案中，该工程师签订合同，担任办公楼建设中现场主管这一关键职位。第二天，工程师因骑行受伤而身体上无法履行职责。由于工程师履行现场主管职责的身体能力是合同的一项基本假设，且没有迹象表明该伤害是其过错所致，因此其履行义务被免除。所以，该工程师并未因未能履行而违约，业主不大可能胜诉（选项C）。

（选项A）一方当事人提出履行低于合同约定的义务（例如，工程师提出担任非现场顾问），并不能成为其违约的免责理由。即使提出的履行方案是合理的替代方案，情况依然如此。

（选项D）尽管工程师的履行义务是属人且绝对的，但他并未违约——业主也不会胜诉——因为履行不能原则 (doctrine of impracticability) 免除了该工程师在合同下的不履行责任。

教学目标：当出现以下情况时，可以适用履行不能的抗辩：
  • 某个不可预见或异常的事件导致当事人履行不能，
  • 合同的订立基于该事件不会发生的一项基本假设，且
  • 寻求免除义务的当事人对该事件的发生没有过错。


References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 261 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (discharge by supervening impracticability).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Discharge by Impracticability

核心考点：履行不能

本题考察的是合同法中的履行不能 (Impracticability) 抗辩，特别是因当事人丧失能力而导致的合同解除。

规则 (Rule)：
根据《合同法重述（第二次）》§ 262，如果合同的履行依赖于某个特定的人 (Specific Person) 的存在，而该人不幸死亡或丧失能力 (Incapacity)，则其履行义务被免除。

这通常被称为“基于基本假设的抗辩” (Defense based on Basic Assumption)。

本案分析逻辑

1
合同性质：
工程师担任“现场主管”这一关键职位 (Essential Position)。这意味着这是一份个人服务合同 (Personal Services Contract)，即必须由该工程师本人履行，不能随意转包。
2
突发事件：
工程师受伤导致身体上无法履行 (Physically Incapable)。这是一个不可预见且非当事人过错的事件。
3
法律后果：
工程师的身体健康是合同订立的基本假设 (Basic Assumption)。既然假设破灭，履行义务即被免除 (Discharged)。
4
结论：
义务已免除 = 没有违约 (No Breach)。
没有违约 = 业主无法胜诉。

为什么选 B？

选项 B 准确地指出了法律依据："Basic Assumption" (基本假设)。

在涉及特定人身依附性的合同中，当事人的存活及健康状况是合同成立的基石。一旦这一基石因不可抗力（如严重受伤）崩塌，法律允许当事人免责。

易错项辨析

选项 A (提供替代方案)：错误
虽然工程师提供了“非现场顾问”作为替代，但这是对原合同的修改要约 (Offer to Modify)。业主没有义务接受“次等”的履行。但这并不意味着工程师违约，他只是因为受伤而免责了。
选项 D (绝对义务)：错误
虽然合同义务通常是严格的，但并非“绝对” (Absolute)。法律承认履行不能 (Impracticability)、目的落空 (Frustration of Purpose) 等抗辩理由。认为义务是绝对且不可免除的观点在现代合同法中是错误的。
💡 MBE 答题技巧：
看到“Essential Position”（关键职位）、“Unique Skill”（独特技能）或“Personal Service”（个人服务）+ “Death/Illness”（死亡/疾病），首先反应应当是：义务免除 (Discharge)，无违约责任。

questions.question:
A dealer needed a certain rare baseball card to complete a set that he had contracted to assemble and sell to a collector. On March 1, the dealer obtained such a card from a woman in exchange for $1,000 and a written promise to redeliver to the woman "no later than December 31 of this year" a comparable specimen of the same kind of card. On March 2, the dealer consummated the sale of the complete set to the collector.
On September 1, the market price of rare baseball cards suddenly began a rapid, sustained rise. On September 10, the woman wrote the dealer for assurance that the dealer would timely meet his card-replacement commitment to her. On September 15, the dealer telephoned the woman and said, "I absolutely will not replace your card until the market drops far below its present level."
The woman sued the dealer on October 15 for the market value of a comparable replacement-card.
If the dealer moves to dismiss the woman's complaint, which of the following is the woman's best argument in opposing the motion?

choices.a: The dealer breached an implied warranty by failing to supply the baseball card.
choices.b: The woman complied with her duty to mitigate her losses by promptly suing when the market rose.
choices.c: The woman may resort to any appropriate remedy for breach of contract because the dealer repudiated his performance.
choices.d: The woman may treat the dealer's anticipatory repudiation as an immediately actionable tort.

Q81153

A dealer needed a certain rare baseball card to complete a set that he had contracted to assemble and sell to a collector. On March 1, the dealer obtained such a card from a woman in exchange for $1,000 and a written promise to redeliver to the woman "no later than December 31 of this year" a comparable specimen of the same kind of card. On March 2, the dealer consummated the sale of the complete set to the collector.

On September 1, the market price of rare baseball cards suddenly began a rapid, sustained rise. On September 10, the woman wrote the dealer for assurance that the dealer would timely meet his card-replacement commitment to her. On September 15, the dealer telephoned the woman and said, "I absolutely will not replace your card until the market drops far below its present level."

The woman sued the dealer on October 15 for the market value of a comparable replacement-card.

If the dealer moves to dismiss the woman's complaint, which of the following is the woman's best argument in opposing the motion?

一名经销商需要一张特定的稀有棒球卡，以完成他根据合同为一名收藏家组装和出售的一套卡片。3月1日，该经销商从一名女士处获得了这张卡片，作为交换，他支付了1000美元，并书面承诺“不迟于今年12月31日”向该女士返还一张同类型的可比卡片。3月2日，该经销商完成了向收藏家出售整套卡片的交易。

9月1日，稀有棒球卡的市价突然开始快速、持续上涨。9月10日，该女士致信经销商，要求其保证将及时履行其更换卡片的承诺。9月15日，经销商致电该女士说：“我绝对不会更换你的卡片，除非市场价格远低于目前水平。”

10月15日，该女士起诉经销商，要求赔偿一张可比替换卡片的市价。

如果经销商动议驳回该女士的起诉，以下哪项是该女士反对该动议的最佳论点？
options:
A. The dealer breached an implied warranty by failing to supply the baseball card.
经销商因未能提供棒球卡而违反了默示担保。

B. The woman complied with her duty to mitigate her losses by promptly suing when the market rose.
该女士在市价上涨时及时提起诉讼，履行了其减轻损失的义务。

C. The woman may resort to any appropriate remedy for breach of contract because the dealer repudiated his performance.
由于经销商拒绝履行其义务，该女士可以就违约行为采取任何适当的救济措施。

D. The woman may treat the dealer's anticipatory repudiation as an immediately actionable tort.
该女士可将经销商的预期拒绝履行视为可立即起诉的侵权行为。
data.explanation:
A contract for the sale of goods (eg, a baseball card) is governed by the Uniform Commercial Code ( UCC ). Under the UCC, a party with reasonable grounds for insecurity about the other party's performance has the right to make a written demand for assurances that the other party will perform the contract. A failure to provide those assurances within 30 days after a valid demand constitutes an anticipatory repudiation. The nonrepudiating party may then treat the repudiation as a breach or ignore it and demand performance pursuant to the contract.

Here, the woman had reasonable grounds for insecurity about the dealer's promise to replace the rare baseball card since the market price of rare cards had begun a rapid, sustained rise. The dealer then failed to provide adequate assurance and explicitly repudiated his performance by stating, "I absolutely will not replace your card until the market drops far below its present level." As a result, the woman's best argument in opposing the dealer's motion to dismiss is that the woman may resort to any appropriate remedy for breach of contract.

(Choice A) The dealer did not breach any implied warranty by failing to supply the card. However, the dealer anticipatorily repudiated the contract by failing to provide adequate assurance that he would perform.

(Choice B) Although the woman had the right to bring an immediate suit once the dealer repudiated, she was not required to mitigate her losses by promptly suing when the market rose.

(Choice D) The woman may treat the dealer's anticipatory repudiation as an immediately actionable breach of contract, not a tort - ie, a wrongful or injurious act, other than breach of contract, subjecting the actor to civil liability.

Educational objective: Under the UCC, a party with reasonable grounds for insecurity about the other's performance may make a written demand for assurances that the other party will perform. Failure to provide assurance within 30 days after a valid demand constitutes an anticipatory repudiation, which the nonrepudiating party may treat as a breach or ignore.



选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 2%，C选项 63%（正确选项），D选项 33%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

货物买卖合同（例如棒球卡）受《美国统一商法典》(UCC)管辖。根据UCC，一方若对另一方的履约能力有合理的不安理由(reasonable grounds for insecurity)，则有权提出书面要求，要求对方提供其将履行合同的保证(written demand for assurances)。在收到有效要求后30天内未能提供该等保证，即构成预期拒绝履行(anticipatory repudiation)。未拒绝履行方（nonrepudiating party）可将此拒绝履行视作违约，或不予理会并要求对方根据合同履行义务。

在本案中，由于稀有卡片的市价开始快速、持续上涨，该女士对经销商更换稀有棒球卡的承诺有合理的不安理由。随后，经销商未能提供充分的保证，并明确表示拒绝履行，称：“我绝对不会更换你的卡片，除非市场价格远低于目前水平。”因此，该女士反对经销商驳回动议的最佳论点是，她可以就违约行为采取任何适当的救济措施。

(选项A) 经销商并未因未能提供卡片而违反任何默示担保。然而，经销商因未能提供其将履约的充分保证而构成了预期拒绝履行。

(选项B) 尽管一旦经销商拒绝履行，该女士有权立即提起诉讼，但她并无义务在市价上涨时通过及时起诉来减轻其损失。

(选项D) 该女士可将经销商的预期拒绝履行视为可立即起诉的违约行为，而非侵权行为——即除违约之外的、使行为人承担民事责任的不法或伤害行为。

教学目的：根据UCC，一方若对另一方的履约能力有合理的不安理由，可书面要求对方提供履约保证。在收到有效要求后30天内未能提供保证，即构成预期拒绝履行，未拒绝履行方可将其视作违约或不予理会。

References

U.C.C. § 2-609 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (right to adequate assurance of performance).

U.C.C. § 2-610 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (anticipatory repudiation).

Contracts & Sales (UCC Article 2)

预期违约 Anticipatory Repudiation UCC § 2-610
核心法律规则

在《统一商法典》(UCC) 下，如果一方在履约日期到来之前，明确且毫不含糊地(unequivocally) 表示其将不履行合同义务，这构成预期违约 (Anticipatory Repudiation)。

非违约方有权选择：

  1. 等待履约日期；或
  2. 立即起诉违约 (Sue immediately for breach)。
案情逻辑分析
1
适用法律：本案涉及棒球卡（货物），因此适用 UCC Article 2。
2
不安抗辩权 (Right to Assurance)： 9月1日市场价格飙升，女士有“合理理由”担心经销商违约，因此她根据 UCC § 2-609 发出了书面保证要求。
3
明确拒绝 (Repudiation)： 9月15日，经销商电话回复：“我绝对不会更换你的卡片 (I absolutely will not replace...)”。这是一个明确的、无条件的拒绝履行声明。
4
法律后果： 尽管合同约定的截止日期是12月31日，但经销商在9月15日的声明构成了预期违约。女士无需等到年底，可以在10月15日立即提起诉讼。
正确答案：C

“由于经销商拒绝履行其义务，该女士可以就违约行为采取任何适当的救济措施。”

干扰项辨析
选项 A (默示担保 Implied Warranty)： 错误。经销商的问题不是“产品质量”或“所有权”问题（担保），而是根本性的“拒绝交付”（不履行）。这是违约，而非违反担保。
选项 B (减轻损失 Mitigation)： 错误。虽然女士可以通过购买替代品来减轻损失，但她并没有义务必须通过“立即起诉”来作为减轻损失的手段。起诉是权利，不是减轻损失的动作本身。
选项 D (侵权 Tort)： 错误。这是一个常见的 MBE 陷阱。单纯的违约（即使是恶意的、故意的）通常不构成侵权行为 (Tort)。侵权需要独立的致害行为。因此，她不能将其视为侵权起诉，只能按违约起诉。
考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

看到卖方在交货期前说“我绝对不交货”时，立即联想 Anticipatory Repudiation。

记住关键词：Immediate Right to Sue（立即起诉权）。即使合同履行期未到，原告的起诉也不会因为“未到期” (premature) 而被驳回。

questions.question:
On June 1, a seller agreed to sell an antique car to a buyer for $20,000, in a writing signed by both the seller and the buyer. At the time, the car was on display in a museum in a different city and was to be delivered to the buyer on August 1. On July 15, before the risk of loss had passed to the buyer, the car was destroyed by fire without fault of either party. Subsequent to the contract but before the fire, the car had increased in value to $30,000. The seller sued the buyer for the contract price of $20,000, and the buyer counterclaimed for $30,000.
What is the likely outcome of this suit?

choices.a: Both claims will fail.
choices.b: Both claims will succeed, and the buyer will recover $10,000.
choices.c: Only the buyer's claim will prevail.
choices.d: Only the seller's claim will succeed.

data.questionStem:
Q81161

On June 1, a seller agreed to sell an antique car to a buyer for $20,000, in a writing signed by both the seller and the buyer. At the time, the car was on display in a museum in a different city and was to be delivered to the buyer on August 1. On July 15, before the risk of loss had passed to the buyer, the car was destroyed by fire without fault of either party. Subsequent to the contract but before the fire, the car had increased in value to $30,000. The seller sued the buyer for the contract price of $20,000, and the buyer counterclaimed for $30,000.

What is the likely outcome of this suit?

6月1日，卖方与买方签订书面协议，同意以20,000美元的价格向买方出售一辆古董车。当时，该车在另一城市的博物馆展出，并定于8月1日交付给买方。7月15日，在损失风险转移给买方之前，该车因火灾被焚毁，双方均无过错。在合同签订后、火灾发生前，该车的价值已增至30,000美元。卖方起诉买方，要求支付20,000美元的合同价款，而买方则反诉，要求赔偿30,000美元。

本案的可能结果是什么？
options:
A. Both claims will fail.
双方的诉求都将不被支持。

B. Both claims will succeed, and the buyer will recover $10,000.
双方的诉求都将成功，买方将获赔10,000美元。

C. Only the buyer's claim will prevail.
只有买方的诉求将获胜。

D. Only the seller's claim will succeed.
只有卖方的诉求将成功。
data.explanation:
Effect of destruction or damage to identified goods


(UCC § 2-613) CompletedestructionContract avoided (ie, neither party is required to perform)
Partial destructionBuyer may demand inspection & (1) treat contract as avoided or (2) accept goods at reduced price but with no further right against seller
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

Contracts for the sale of goods are governed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC). Under the UCC, the risk of loss generally remains with the seller until the buyer receives the goods. However, if the contract deals with specifically identified goods (eg, the antique car on display), then complete destruction of the goods excuses each party's duty to perform so long as the destruction occurred:

  • without fault of either party and
  • before the risk of loss passed to the buyer.


Here, the buyer and seller formed a contract for the sale of an antique car. That car was destroyed by fire without fault of either party and before the risk of loss passed to the buyer. Therefore, the contract was avoided and neither the buyer nor the seller was required to perform. This means that both their claims will fail (Choices B, C & D).

Educational objective: When a contract deals with specifically identified goods, complete destruction of the goods excuses each party's duty to perform if the destruction occurred (1) without fault of either party and (2) before the risk of loss passed to the buyer.

选项正确率统计：A选项 79%（正确选项），B选项 3%，C选项 10%，D选项 5%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

特定物灭失或损坏的效力


(UCC § 2-613) 完全灭失合同解除（即，任何一方均无需履行）
部分灭失买方可要求检验并（1）视作合同解除或（2）以折扣价格接受货物，但对卖方无进一步权利
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

货物买卖合同受《美国统一商法典》(UCC) 第二条管辖。根据UCC，损失风险通常由卖方承担，直至买方收到货物为止。但是，如果合同涉及特定物（例如，展出的古董车），那么只要货物的完全灭失发生在以下情况，各方当事人的履行义务即可免除：

  • 任何一方均无过错，且
  • 损失风险转移给买方之前。


在本案中，买方和卖方就一辆古董车的买卖订立了合同。该车在双方均无过错且损失风险转移给买方之前因火灾被焚毁。因此，合同被解除，买方和卖方均无需履行合同。这意味着双方的诉求都将不被支持（选项 B、C 和 D）。

教学目的：当合同涉及特定物时，如果货物的完全灭失发生在（1）任何一方均无过错且（2）损失风险转移给买方之前，则各方当事人的履行义务均被免除。

References



  • U.C.C. § 2-509 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (risk of loss in the absence of breach).


  • UCC § 2-613 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (casualty to identified goods).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Sales (UCC Art. 2)

本题考察的是合同法中关于特定物灭失的法律后果。正确答案是 A (Both claims will fail)。

核心法则：UCC § 2-613 当合同涉及特定物(Identified Goods)时，如果在损失风险(Risk of Loss)转移给买方之前，该货物在双方均无过错的情况下发生完全灭失(Total Destruction)，则合同自动解除(Avoided)。

📝 案情逻辑分析

1
特定物 (Identified Goods)：
合同标的是一辆特定的“古董车”(Antique Car)，且在合同订立时已经确定。这属于 UCC § 2-613 适用的特定物范畴。
2
无过错灭失 (Casualty without Fault)：
车辆因火灾被毁，且题目明确指出“双方均无过错”(without fault of either party)。
3
时间点 (Timing)：
灭失发生在“损失风险转移给买方之前”(before the risk of loss had passed)。根据 UCC，未交付前风险通常在卖方。
4
法律后果 (Consequence)：
满足上述条件后，合同被解除/撤销(Avoided)。这意味着双方的履行义务都被免除(Excused)。

⚖️ 为什么其他选项错误？

由于合同已经解除（Avoided）：

  • 卖方无需交付车辆，因此不构成违约，买方无权索赔（即使车价涨了）。
  • 买方无需支付价款，因此卖方无权索赔合同价金。

这就是为什么买方不能主张 $30,000 的价值（或 $10,000 的利润损失），卖方也不能主张 $20,000 的车款。

UCC § 2-613 灭失程度对比
完全灭失
Total Destruction		 合同解除，双方免责。
（本题情况）
部分灭失
Partial Destruction		 买方有选择权：
1. 解除合同；或
2. 接受货物（价格需根据受损情况折让），但不得再向卖方索赔。
结论：双方均无权向对方索赔。
Both claims will fail.
MBE 考试技巧

在做此类题目时，请寻找以下关键词组合：
"Specific/Identified Goods"（特定物）
+ "Destruction/Fire"（灭失）
+ "No Fault"（无过错）

一旦看到这个组合，首先考虑 Impossibility/Impracticability（履行不能）或 UCC § 2-613。通常结果是双方“各回各家”，互不亏欠。

questions.question:
The owner of a fleet of taxis contracted with a dealer in petroleum products for the purchase and sale of the fleet owner's total requirements of gasoline and oil for one year. As part of that agreement, the petroleum dealer also agreed with the fleet owner that for one year the petroleum dealer would place all his advertising with the fleet owner's wife, who owned her own small advertising agency. When the wife was informed of the contract, she declined to accept an advertising account from another company because she could not handle both accounts during the same year. During the first month of the contract, the fleet owner purchased substantial amounts of his gasoline from a supplier other than the petroleum dealer, and the petroleum dealer thereupon notified the wife that he would no longer place his advertising with her agency.
In an action by the wife against the petroleum dealer for breach of contract, will the wife succeed?

choices.a: No, because the failure of a constructive condition precedent excused the petroleum dealer's duty to place his advertising with the wife.
choices.b: No, because the wife did not provide any consideration to support the petroleum dealer's promise to place his advertising with her.
choices.c: Yes, because she is a third-party beneficiary of the contract.
choices.d: Yes, because the fleet owner was acting as the wife's agent when he contracted with the petroleum dealer.

data.questionStem:
Q81171

The owner of a fleet of taxis contracted with a dealer in petroleum products for the purchase and sale of the fleet owner's total requirements of gasoline and oil for one year. As part of that agreement, the petroleum dealer also agreed with the fleet owner that for one year the petroleum dealer would place all his advertising with the fleet owner's wife, who owned her own small advertising agency. When the wife was informed of the contract, she declined to accept an advertising account from another company because she could not handle both accounts during the same year. During the first month of the contract, the fleet owner purchased substantial amounts of his gasoline from a supplier other than the petroleum dealer, and the petroleum dealer thereupon notified the wife that he would no longer place his advertising with her agency.

In an action by the wife against the petroleum dealer for breach of contract, will the wife succeed?

一位出租车队的所有人与一名石油产品经销商签订合同，约定在一年内购买该车队所需的全部汽油和机油。作为该协议的一部分，石油经销商也同意车队所有人，在一年内，他会将其所有广告业务交由车队所有人的妻子处理，该妻子拥有一家自己的小型广告代理公司。当妻子得知该合同后，她拒绝了另一家公司的广告业务，因为她无法在同一年内同时处理两项业务。在合同的第一个月，车队所有人从石油经销商以外的供应商处购买了大量的汽油，石油经销商随即通知妻子，他将不再把广告业务交由她的代理公司。

在妻子对石油经销商提起的违约诉讼中，妻子能否胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the failure of a constructive condition precedent excused the petroleum dealer's duty to place his advertising with the wife.
不会，因为一项推定先决条件的未能满足，免除了石油经销商将广告业务交给妻子的义务。

B. No, because the wife did not provide any consideration to support the petroleum dealer's promise to place his advertising with her.
不会，因为妻子没有提供任何对价来支持石油经销商将其广告业务交给她的承诺。

C. Yes, because she is a third-party beneficiary of the contract.
会，因为她是该合同的第三方受益人。

D. Yes, because the fleet owner was acting as the wife's agent when he contracted with the petroleum dealer.
会，因为车队所有人在与石油经销商签订合同时是作为妻子的代理人行事。
data.explanation:
Common examples of constructive (ie, implied) conditions


Condition of performanceEach party's performance is conditioned on other party's performance
Condition of cooperationEach party's performance is conditioned on other party's cooperation with that performance
Order of performance
  • Simultaneous performance possible - each party's performance is condition concurrent to other party's duty to perform (ie, performance due simultaneously)
  • One party's performance takes time - party's completion of longer performance is condition precedent to other party's duty to perform
The wife is an intended beneficiary - ie, a nonparty to a contract whom the contracting parties intended to benefit directly - of the contract between the fleet owner and the petroleum dealer. As a result, she has contractual rights and may sue to enforce them (Choice C). However, when the original contracting parties each make a promise to the other, each party's performance of its own promise is a constructive condition precedent to the other party's duty to perform. If either party fails to substantially perform, the other party's duty is excused.†

Here, the fleet owner promised to purchase its total gasoline and oil requirements from the petroleum dealer, and the petroleum dealer promised to use the wife's advertising agency in return. It is implied that each party's performance is a constructive condition precedent to the other party's duty to perform. And since the fleet owner failed to substantially perform his end of the bargain by purchasing substantial amounts of gasoline from another supplier, the petroleum dealer's duty to use the wife's agency was excused. Therefore, she will not succeed.

†In contrast, express conditions (ie, ones that appear in the contract) require strict compliance.

(Choice B) Although the petroleum dealer received no consideration from the wife, his agreement with the fleet owner was supported by consideration. That is because the petroleum dealer's promise was induced by the fleet owner's promise to purchase gasoline and oil (and vice versa). And the wife, as an intended beneficiary, could sue to enforce her rights. But she will not succeed, because the petroleum dealer's duty was excused.

(Choice D) The fleet owner was not acting as an agent for the wife because she did not direct him to enter into the contract on her behalf. Instead, she was an intended third-party beneficiary of the contract.

Educational objective: Each party's performance of its own promise is a constructive (ie, implied) condition precedent to the other party's duty to perform. If either party fails to substantially perform, the other party's duty is excused.

选项正确率统计：A选项 36%（正确选项），B选项 6%，C选项 55%，D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

推定（即默示）条件的常见示例


履行条件每一方的履行都以另一方的履行为条件
协作条件每一方的履行都以另一方对该履行的协作为条件
履行顺序
  • 可同时履行 - 每一方的履行是另一方履行义务的并行条件（即应同时履行）
  • 一方的履行需要时间 - 该方完成较长履行是另一方履行义务的先决条件
妻子是车队所有人和石油经销商之间合同的意定受益人——即合同双方意图直接使其受益的合同非当事人。因此，她拥有合同权利，并可以提起诉讼来执行这些权利（选项C）。然而，当原始合同双方各自向对方作出承诺时，每一方对自己承诺的履行是另一方履行义务的推定先决条件。如果任何一方未能实质性履行，另一方的义务即被免除。†

在本案中，车队所有人承诺从石油经销商处购买其所需的全部汽油和机油，而石油经销商则承诺使用妻子的广告代理公司作为回报。这意味着每一方的履行是另一方履行义务的推定先决条件。由于车队所有人从另一供应商处购买了大量汽油，未能实质性履行其协议中的义务，因此石油经销商使用妻子代理公司的义务被免除了。因此，她不会胜诉。

†相比之下，明示条件（即合同中明确列出的条件）要求严格遵守。

（选项B）虽然石油经销商没有从妻子那里获得对价，但他与车队所有人的协议有对价支持。这是因为石油经销商的承诺是由车队所有人购买汽油和机油的承诺所引致的（反之亦然）。而妻子作为意定受益人，可以起诉以执行其权利。但她不会胜诉，因为石油经销商的义务已被免除。

（选项D）车队所有人并非作为妻子的代理人行事，因为妻子没有指示他代表自己签订合同。相反，她是合同的意定第三方受益人。

教学目标：每一方对自己承诺的履行是另一方履行义务的推定（即默示）先决条件。如果任何一方未能实质性履行，另一方的义务即被免除。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 234 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (order of performances).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 302 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (intended and incidental beneficiaries).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Third-Party Beneficiaries & Defenses
核心考点：推定先决条件 (Constructive Condition Precedent) 在双务合同中，一方的实质性履行 (Substantial Performance) 是另一方履行义务的推定先决条件。如果一方发生实质性违约 (Material Breach)，另一方的履行义务即被免除 (Excused)。
车队老板
(Promisee)
↔️ 合同 ↔️
石油商
(Promisor)
⚠️ 违约事件 (Breach)
老板从别处买油 = 实质性违约
⬇️
妻子 (Beneficiary)
起诉石油商违约
❌ 失败：因为老板先违约，石油商义务已免除
深度解析

本题考察的是第三方受益人 (Third-Party Beneficiary) 的权利限制与合同履行顺序 (Order of Performance) 的结合。

1. 妻子的身份：
妻子是意定受益人 (Intended Beneficiary)。虽然她没有提供对价，但合同双方意图让她直接受益，因此她有权起诉执行合同。

2. 防御原则 (Defenses)：
这是解题的关键。针对第三方受益人的诉讼，承诺人（石油商）可以提出任何他在被受诺人（车队老板）起诉时可以提出的抗辩。
"The promisor can assert against the beneficiary any defense that he could assert against the promisee."

3. 实质性违约 (Material Breach)：
这是一个需求合同 (Requirements Contract)。车队老板承诺购买“全部需求”，却从别处购买了“大量”汽油。这构成了实质性违约。

4. 推定先决条件 (Constructive Condition)：
根据普通法，车队老板履行其购买义务是石油商履行其广告义务的推定先决条件。因为老板先违约（条件未满足），石油商的义务被免除 (Discharged/Excused)。

选项分析
✅ 选项 A (正确答案)
"No, because the failure of a constructive condition precedent excused..."
车队老板未能实质性履行合同（实质性违约），导致石油商履行义务的先决条件未满足。因此，石油商不再有义务向妻子提供广告业务。
❌ 选项 B (错误)
关于对价 (Consideration)
第三方受益人不需要自己提供对价。只要原始合同双方之间存在有效对价（老板买油 vs 石油商给广告），受益人的权利就已确立。
❌ 选项 C (错误)
关于受益人身份
虽然她是第三方受益人，但这只是给了她起诉的资格 (Standing)。这并不意味着她能免受“原始合同已被违约”这一事实的影响。受益人的权利不能大于合同本身的效力。
❌ 选项 D (错误)
关于代理 (Agency)
车队老板是为了自己的业务利益并顺带惠及妻子而签约，并非受妻子委托作为代理人。即使是代理关系，老板的违约依然会波及到合同的执行。
© MBE 备考助手 | 知识点：Contracts / Conditions

questions.question:
Before the season began, a professional hockey player entered into a signed, written agreement with the owner of the team. Among the provisions in the agreement was one that provided that, if the player scored 20 or more goals during the season, he would receive additional compensation. The player tried his best during the season but only managed to score 19 goals. The owner refused to pay the player any additional compensation.
Is the owner excused from paying the additional compensation?

choices.a: No, because the player substantially complied with the condition regarding goals scored.
choices.b: No, because the player's failure to satisfy the condition was not willful.
choices.c: Yes, because the additional compensation was conditioned on the player scoring at least 20 goals during the season.
choices.d: Yes, because the player promised to score 20 goals.

On August 1, a nursing home for the elderly admitted an 84-year-old man for a trial period of two months. On September 25, the man and the nursing home entered into a written lifetime-care contract with an effective commencement date of October 1. The full contract price was $20,000, which, as required by the terms of the contract, the man prepaid to the nursing home on September 25. The nursing home rejected a woman's application for lifetime care on September 26 due to its commitment to the man.
On October 2, the man died of a heart attack.
In a restitutionary action, will the administrator of the man's estate likely recover on behalf of the estate either all or part of the $20,000 paid to the nursing home on September 25?

choices.a: No, because the man's life span and the duration of the nursing home's commitment to him were risks assumed by both parties.
choices.b: No, because the nursing home rejected the woman's application due to its commitment to the man.
choices.c: Yes, because the doctrine of frustration of purpose applies.
choices.d: Yes, because the nursing home would otherwise be unjustly enriched at the man's expense.

8月1日，一家养老院接收了一位84岁的男性，进行为期两个月的试住。9月25日，该男性与养老院签订了一份书面终身照护合同，生效起始日为10月1日。合同总价为20,000美元，按照合同条款的要求，该男性于9月25日将此款项预付给了养老院。由于对该男性的承诺，养老院在9月26日拒绝了一位女性的终身照护申请。

10月2日，该男性因心脏病发作去世。

在一项返还诉讼中，该男性的遗产管理人是否可能代表遗产，追回在9月25日支付给养老院的20,000美元的全部或部分？
options:
A. No, because the man's life span and the duration of the nursing home's commitment to him were risks assumed by both parties.
不会，因为该男性的寿命以及养老院对其承诺的照护期限是双方共同承担的风险。

B. No, because the nursing home rejected the woman's application due to its commitment to the man.
不会，因为养老院因对该男性的承诺而拒绝了该女性的申请。

C. Yes, because the doctrine of frustration of purpose applies.
会，因为“目的落空”原则在此适用。

D. Yes, because the nursing home would otherwise be unjustly enriched at the man's expense.
会，因为否则养老院将因该男性的损失而构成不当得利。
data.explanation:
Ways to discharge contractual obligations

  • F ull performance of contractual obligations
  • I mpossibility, impracticability, or frustration of purpose
  • R elease (in writing only)
  • M utual rescission
  • S ubstituted contract
  • C ontract or covenant not to sue
  • A ccord & satisfaction
  • N ovation


Mnemonic: FIRM SCAN

A contract can be rescinded after an unexpected event if (1) the event frustrates the purpose of the contract, (2) the contract was formed under a basic assumption that the event would not occur, and (3) neither party was at fault in causing the event to occur. The frustrating event must be so severe that it cannot fairly be regarded as within the risks that the parties assumed under the contract. Additionally, a party who conferred a benefit before the contract was rescinded can recover restitutionary damages to prevent unjust enrichment.

Here, the 84-year-old man and the nursing home entered into a written contract in which he prepaid $20,000 for lifetime care that began on October 1. Although the man unexpectedly died one day later, his life span and the duration of the nursing home's commitment to him were risks assumed by both parties. That is because:
  • the man assumed the risk that he would die before receiving the full value of his payment and
  • the nursing home assumed the risk that the man would live so long that his payment would be insufficient.


Therefore, the doctrine of frustration of purpose does not apply, and the administrator of the man's estate is unlikely to recover restitutionary damages for all or part of the $20,000 paid to the nursing home (Choice C).

(Choice B) The fact that the nursing home rejected the woman's application has no effect on the outcome of this dispute.

(Choice D) Unjust enrichment occurs when a party receives a benefit from another that was not rightfully earned and would be unfair to keep.

But here, it would not be unfair for the nursing home to retain the $20,000, and the nursing home rightfully earned it, because the nursing home assumed the risk that the man would live so long that his payment would be inadequate.

Educational objective: The doctrine of frustration of purpose applies only where the frustrating event is so severe that it cannot fairly be regarded as within the risks that the parties assumed under the contract.

选项正确率统计：A选项 71%（正确选项），B选项 3%，C选项 6%，D选项 18%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

解除合同义务的方式

  • Full performance of contractual obligations (完全履行合同义务)
  • Impossibility, impracticability, or frustration of purpose (履行不能、不现实或目的落空)
  • Release (in writing only) (（仅书面）免除)
  • Mutual rescission (双方合意解除)
  • Substituted contract (替代合同)
  • Contract or covenant not to sue (不起诉合同或契约)
  • Accord & satisfaction (和解与清偿)
  • Novation (债务更新)


助记词：FIRM SCAN

如果一个意外事件(1)使合同目的落空，(2)合同是在该事件不会发生的基本假定下订立的，且(3)任何一方对事件的发生均无过错，则该合同可以在事件发生后被解除。该目的落空事件必须极其严重，以至于不能被合理地视为双方在合同下承担的风险范围之内。此外，在合同解除前已授予利益的一方可以追回返还性损害赔偿，以防止不当得利。

在本案中，这位84岁的男性与养老院签订了一份书面合同，他预付了20,000美元用于从10月1日开始的终身照护。尽管该男性在一天后意外去世，但他的寿命以及养老院对其承诺的照护期限是双方共同承担的风险。这是因为：
  • 该男性承担了他可能在获得其付款的全部价值前去世的风险，并且
  • 养老院承担了该男性可能活得太久以至于其付款不足的风险。


因此，“目的落空”原则不适用，该男性遗产的管理人不太可能为支付给养老院的20,000美元的全部或部分追回返还性损害赔偿（选项 C）。

（选项 B）养老院拒绝该女性申请的事实对本争议的结果没有影响。

（选项 D）当一方从另一方获得了非正当赚取的、保留下来会有失公平的利益时，即构成不当得利。

但在本案中，养老院保留这20,000美元并非不公，且养老院是正当赚取该款项的，因为养老院承担了该男性可能活得太久以至于其付款不足的风险。

教学目标：“目的落空”原则仅在目的落空事件极其严重，以至于不能被合理地视为双方在合同下承担的风险范围之内时才适用。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 265 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (frustration-of-purpose doctrine).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 377 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (restitution for frustration of purpose).
