MBE Contracts 解析

Conditions & Waiver (条件与弃权)
核心考点：条件的弃权 (Waiver of Condition)

在合同法中，如果一方的履行义务取决于某个先决条件 (Condition Precedent)，而该条件未发生，该方通常可以拒绝履行。

但是，如果受益于该条件的一方通过言语或行为表示不再要求该条件发生，这被称为弃权 (Waiver)。一旦弃权，该方不能再以条件未发生为由拒绝履行。

本案逻辑链分析

1 明确条件： 合同中有一个明示的先决条件：建筑师必须在6个月内戒酒 (Abstain from alcohol)。
2 条件未满足 (Non-occurrence)： 建筑师在两个月后开始饮酒。此时，开发商本有权终止合同或拒绝付款。
3 关键行为 (Conduct)： 开发商知情 (became aware) 后，仍然审查了初步方案，表示“印象深刻”，并鼓励建筑师继续工作 ("looked forward to seeing the final plans")。
4 法律后果： 开发商在知晓条件未满足的情况下，选择继续合同并接受建筑师的后续工作。这种行为构成了对“戒酒条件”的弃权 (Waiver)。
✅ 正确答案：选项 B
"The developer waived the condition of no alcohol use."

开发商的行为表明他选择忽略条件的失败，并允许合同继续进行。因此，他放弃了以饮酒为由拒绝付款的权利。

为什么其他选项是错的？

❌ 选项 A (Material Breach)： 这是一个常见的陷阱。明示条件 (Express Condition) 通常要求严格遵守 (Strict Compliance)。这与“承诺 (Promise)”不同，承诺只需要“实质性履行 (Substantial Performance)”。因为这是明确的条件，是否影响工作质量在法律上通常是不相关的（除非涉及极端的没收规则，但弃权是更直接的理由）。
❌ 选项 C (Penalty Clause)： 惩罚性条款通常指金额过高的违约金 (Liquidated Damages)。本案中的条款是履行的条件，而不是规定违约赔偿金额的条款，因此不适用惩罚性条款的分析。
❌ 选项 D (Interpretation)： 法院确实倾向于将模糊的条款解释为承诺而非条件（以避免权利丧失）。但本案中合同语言非常明确 ("conditioned on")，不存在模糊性，因此必须作为条件来执行（除非被弃权）。
💡 MBE 考试技巧
当题目中出现“先决条件 (Condition)”被违反，但受益方（Beneficiary）在知情后仍然允许对方继续工作或接受服务时，首先要寻找的答案就是“弃权 (Waiver)”或“选择 (Election)”。

记住：你不能在知晓违约后让对方把活干完，最后才跳出来说“啊哈，你两个月前就违约了，我不付钱！”

questions.question:
Under a written agreement, a pastry supplier promised to sell its entire output of baked buns at a specified unit price to a retailer, for one year. The retailer promised not to sell any other supplier's baked buns.
The parties' contract included a provision for termination by either party at any time upon reasonable notice. After six months of performance on both sides, the supplier, claiming that its old bun-baker had become uneconomical and that it could not afford a new one, dismantled the bun-baker and began using the space for making dog biscuits. The supplier's output of baked buns having ceased, the retailer sued for breach of contract. The retailer moves for summary judgment on liability, and the supplier moves for summary judgment dismissing the retailer's claim.
How should the court rule?

choices.a: Deny both motions, because the supplier may legally cease production of baked buns, but under the circumstances it must share with the retailer its profits from the manufacture of dog biscuits until the end of the first year.
choices.b: Deny both motions, because there are triable issues of fact as to whether the supplier gave reasonable notice of termination or whether its losses from continued production of baked buns were sufficiently substantial to justify cessation of production.
choices.c: Grant summary judgment for the retailer, because as a matter of law the supplier could not discontinue production of baked buns merely because it was losing money on that product.
choices.d: Grant summary judgment for the supplier, because its cessation of baked-bun production and the retailer's awareness thereof amounted as a matter of law to valid notice of termination as permitted by the contract.

data.questionStem:
Q81174

Under a written agreement, a pastry supplier promised to sell its entire output of baked buns at a specified unit price to a retailer, for one year. The retailer promised not to sell any other supplier's baked buns.

The parties' contract included a provision for termination by either party at any time upon reasonable notice. After six months of performance on both sides, the supplier, claiming that its old bun-baker had become uneconomical and that it could not afford a new one, dismantled the bun- baker and began using the space for making dog biscuits. The supplier's output of baked buns having ceased, the retailer sued for breach of contract. The retailer moves for summary judgment on liability, and the supplier moves for summary judgment dismissing the retailer's claim.

How should the court rule?

根据一份书面协议，一家糕点供应商承诺在一年内，以特定单价向一家零售商出售其生产的全部烤面包。零售商则承诺不销售任何其他供应商的烤面包。

双方的合同中包含一条款，规定任何一方在发出合理通知后，可随时终止合同。在双方履行合同六个月后，供应商声称其旧的面包烘烤设备已不经济，且无力购置新设备，因此拆除了该设备，并开始利用该空间制作狗饼干。由于供应商停止生产烤面包，零售商以违约为由提起诉讼。零售商动议就法律责任作出即决判决，而供应商则动议作出驳回零售商诉求的即决判决。

法院应如何裁决？
options:
A. Deny both motions, because the supplier may legally cease production of baked buns, but under the circumstances it must share with the retailer its profits from the manufacture of dog biscuits until the end of the first year.
驳回双方的动议，因为供应商可以合法地停止生产烤面包，但在当前情况下，其必须在第一年结束前，与零售商分享其从制造狗饼干中获得的利润。

B. Deny both motions, because there are triable issues of fact as to whether the supplier gave reasonable notice of termination or whether its losses from continued production of baked buns were sufficiently substantial to justify cessation of production.
驳回双方的动议，因为存在可审理的事实争议点，即供应商是否给出了合理的终止通知，或其因继续生产烤面包而遭受的损失是否足够重大，从而有理由停止生产。

C. Grant summary judgment for the retailer, because as a matter of law the supplier could not discontinue production of baked buns merely because it was losing money on that product.
支持零售商的即决判决动议，因为作为一个法律问题，供应商不能仅仅因为在该产品上亏损就停止生产烤面包。

D. Grant summary judgment for the supplier, because its cessation of baked-bun production and the retailer's awareness thereof amounted as a matter of law to valid notice of termination as permitted by the contract.
支持供应商的即决判决动议，因为其停止生产烤面包以及零售商对此知晓的事实，在法律上构成了合同所允许的有效终止通知。
data.explanation:
Ways to discharge contractual obligations
  • Full performance of contractual obligations
  • Impossibility, impracticability, or frustration of purpose
  • Release (in writing only)
  • Mutual rescission
  • Substituted contract
  • Contract or covenant not to sue
  • Accord & satisfaction
  • Novation


Mnemonic: FIRM SCAN

A motion for summary judgment is a request that the court enter judgment without a full trial because there is no genuine issue of material fact and the movant is entitled to judgment as a matter of law.

Analysis of Option B (Two Independent Defenses):
This option is correct because the supplier has two independent paths to avoid liability. Proving either path would be sufficient, but both involve disputed facts that require a trial:

1. Path 1: Contractual Compliance (Reasonable Notice). The contract allows termination upon "reasonable notice." Whether the supplier's cessation of production and the retailer's awareness thereof amounted to "reasonable" notice is a question of fact for the jury. It cannot be decided as a matter of law (Choice D).

2. Path 2: Statutory Justification (Good Faith / Impracticability). Even if the notice was insufficient, under UCC output contracts, a supplier may reduce output to zero if done in good faith. While a mere loss of profit is not enough, substantial losses that make performance impracticable or uneconomical may justify cessation. Determining whether the losses were "sufficiently substantial" to justify the action is a material question of fact (Choice C).

Since there are triable issues of fact regarding both notice and the magnitude of the losses, both motions for summary judgment should be denied.

(Choice A) Even if the supplier can legally cease production of baked buns, there is no indication that the contract entitles the retailer to a share of the supplier's profits from the manufacture of dog biscuits.

Educational objective: The defense of impracticability is available when (1) an unanticipated event makes performance impracticable, (2) nonoccurrence of the event was a basic assumption of the contract, and (3) the party seeking discharge is not at fault. Non-extraordinary increases in the cost of performance do not make performance impracticable.

选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 64%（正确选项），C选项 11%，D选项 22%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

解除合同义务的方式
  • Full performance of contractual obligations (全面履行合同义务)
  • Impossibility, impracticability, or frustration of purpose (不可能性、不现实性或目的落空)
  • Release (in writing only) (解除（仅限书面）)
  • Mutual rescission (双方合意解除)
  • Substituted contract (替代合同)
  • Contract or covenant not to sue (不起诉合同或契约)
  • Accord & satisfaction (和解与清偿)
  • Novation (债务更新)


助记词: FIRM SCAN

即决判决动议是请求法院在没有真实重大事实争议，且动议人有权获得作为法律问题的判决的情况下，不经正式审判而直接作出判决。如果一个事实争议点对案件的结果有重要影响，那么它就是重大的。

两条并行的解除合同的方法：
本题B选项之所以包含两个要素，是因为供应商有两条独立的路径来证明自己没有违约，只要满足其中任何一条即可。但这两条路径目前都存在事实争议，因此法院无法立即判决：

1. 路径一：合同程序（Reasonable Notice）。 供应商是否遵守了合同条款？如果供应商给出了“合理通知”并完成了通知期的义务，则合同合法终止。但“什么算合理通知”以及“供应商的行为是否构成通知”是事实问题，不能由法官直接判定（选项D错误）。

2. 路径二：法定抗辩（Sufficient Justification / Impracticability）。 即使通知不合理，供应商是否有正当理由停产？在产量合同中，如果继续生产会导致足够重大的损失（substantial losses），供应商可以基于“善意（Good Faith）”或“不现实性（Impracticability）”停止生产。但这需要证明损失不仅仅是“赚得少”，而是“亏得惨”或“无法继续”。损失是否达到这个程度也是一个事实问题，不能由法官直接判定（选项C错误）。

综上所述，由于这两条路径中的关键事实都需要陪审团审理，双方的即决判决动议均应被驳回。

（选项A）即使供应商可以合法停止生产烤面包，也没有迹象表明合同授权零售商分享供应商从制造狗饼干中获得的利润。

教学目标：不现实性抗辩在以下情况适用：（1）某一未预料到的事件使履行变得不现实；（2）该事件的不发生是合同的一项基本假设；以及（3）寻求解除义务的一方没有过错。履行成本的非同寻常的增加并不必然导致履行不现实。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 261 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (impracticability).

Fed. R. Civ. P. 56 (summary judgment).

MBE 考点解析

产量合同与即决判决标准

Output Contracts & Summary Judgment

核心考点：即决判决的标准
本题的程序性关键在于即决判决 (Summary Judgment)。

法院只有在以下情况才会批准即决判决：

不存在实质性的事实争议 (No genuine issue of material fact)，且动议方有权获得法律上的判决。

如果案件中存在需要陪审团（Fact Finder）去衡量、判断的事实细节，法官就必须驳回 (Deny) 即决判决动议，将案件送交审判。

法律分析：为何选 B？
本案涉及两个关键的法律/事实混合问题，任何一个都需要陪审团来裁决，因此不能直接判决。
争议点 1：通知是否合理？(Reasonable Notice)

合同允许“合理通知”后终止。供应商拆除机器并停产，且零售商知情。这是否构成了“通知”？如果是，是否“合理”？这是一个典型的事实问题 (Question of Fact)。

争议点 2：产量合同的善意减产 (UCC § 2-306)

在产量合同 (Output Contract) 中，供应商承诺出售其全部产量。根据 UCC，供应商可以减产甚至停产，但必须基于善意 (Good Faith)。

  • 仅仅因为利润降低通常不足以作为停产理由。
  • 如果是为了避免破产或重大损失，则可能被视为善意。

本案中，供应商称旧设备“不经济 (uneconomical)”。这种亏损是否严重到足以正当化停产？这也是一个事实问题。

干扰项排除
选项 C 错误 支持零售商： 过于绝对。虽然单纯的利润减少不能作为借口，但如果继续生产会导致毁灭性的损失，供应商是可以停产的。这需要审判来确定损失程度。
选项 D 错误 支持供应商： 同样过于绝对。拆除机器和对方知情并不自动等同于合同要求的“合理通知”。这需要陪审团判断是否符合商业惯例。
选项 A 错误 利润分享： 法律上没有依据要求违约方分享替代业务（狗饼干）的利润给非违约方。违约赔偿通常基于“预期利益 (Expectation Damages)”。
💡 备考小贴士
  1. 看到 "Summary Judgment"： 立即寻找题干中是否存在模糊不清、需要进一步证明的事实（如“合理性”、“善意”、“重大性”）。如果有，答案通常是“Deny”。
  2. 产量合同 (Output Contracts)： 记住 UCC § 2-306。关键词是 Good Faith。产量不能“不成比例地”偏离预估，减产至零需要非常正当的商业理由，而不仅仅是“赚得不够多”。
  3. 助记词 FIRM SCAN： 用于记忆合同解除的方式（如本题涉及的 Impracticability/Impossibility 属于 'I'）。

questions.question:
On May 1, a seller and a buyer entered into a written contract, signed by both parties, for the sale of a tract of land for $100,000. Delivery of the deed and payment of the purchase price were scheduled for July 1. On June 1, the buyer received a letter from the seller repudiating the contract. On June 5, the buyer bought a second tract of land at a higher price as a substitute for the first tract. On June 10, the seller communicated a retraction of the repudiation to the buyer.
The buyer did not tender the purchase price for the first tract on July 1 but subsequently sued the seller for breach of contract.
Will the buyer likely prevail?

choices.a: No, because the buyer's tender of the purchase price on July 1 was a constructive condition to the seller's duty to tender a conveyance.
choices.b: No, because the seller retracted the repudiation prior to the agreed time for performance.
choices.c: Yes, because the buyer bought the second tract as a substitute for the first tract prior to the seller's retraction.
choices.d: Yes, because the seller's repudiation was not retractable after it was communicated to the buyer.

data.questionStem:
Q81159

On May 1, a seller and a buyer entered into a written contract, signed by both parties, for the sale of a tract of land for $100,000. Delivery of the deed and payment of the purchase price were scheduled for July 1. On June 1, the buyer received a letter from the seller repudiating the contract. On June 5, the buyer bought a second tract of land at a higher price as a substitute for the first tract. On June 10, the seller communicated a retraction of the repudiation to the buyer.

The buyer did not tender the purchase price for the first tract on July 1 but subsequently sued the seller for breach of contract.

Will the buyer likely prevail?

5月1日，卖方和买方签订了一份双方签字的书面合同，内容为以100,000美元的价格出售一块土地。契据的交付和购买价款的支付定于7月1日进行。6月1日，买方收到了卖方拒绝履行合同的信函。6月5日，买方以更高的价格购买了第二块土地，作为第一块土地的替代品。6月10日，卖方向买方传达了撤回其拒绝履行合同的意思表示。

买方未在7月1日支付第一块土地的购买价款，但随后以违约为由起诉了卖方。

买方可能会胜诉吗？
options:
A. No, because the buyer's tender of the purchase price on July 1 was a constructive condition to the seller's duty to tender a conveyance.
不会，因为买方在7月1日支付购买价款是卖方交付转让契据义务的一个推定条件。

B. No, because the seller retracted the repudiation prior to the agreed time for performance.
不会，因为卖方在约定的履行时间之前撤回了其拒绝履行合同的意思表示。

C. Yes, because the buyer bought the second tract as a substitute for the first tract prior to the seller's retraction.
会，因为在卖方撤回其意思表示之前，买方已经购买了第二块土地作为第一块土地的替代品。

D. Yes, because the seller's repudiation was not retractable after it was communicated to the buyer.
会，因为卖方的拒绝履行合同的意思表示在传达给买方后就不可撤回。
data.explanation:
A party's failure to perform his/her contractual duties at the time performance is due constitutes a breach. A breach can also occur before the time for performance is due under the doctrine of anticipatory repudiation. This doctrine applies when a party clearly and unequivocally repudiates (ie, indicates an unwillingness to perform) a promise. A repudiation can be retracted if the nonrepudiating party receives notice of the retraction before:
  • canceling the contract
  • materially changing position in reliance on the repudiation or
  • indicating that he/she considers the repudiation to be final (Choice D).
But until the repudiation is retracted, the nonrepudiating party may (1) treat the repudiation as a breach or (2) ignore it and demand performance pursuant to the contract. The nonrepudiating party may also suspend its own performance if commercially reasonable.

Here, the seller anticipatorily repudiated the contract on June 1. The seller then attempted to retract the repudiation on June 10. However, the buyer had already materially changed position in reliance on the repudiation by purchasing a substitute tract of land on June 5 (Choice B). As a result, the seller's retraction was ineffective. And since the seller's unretracted repudiation is a breach of contract, the buyer is likely to prevail.

(Choice A) In a contract for real property, the tender of the purchase price and the conveyance of the deed generally must occur simultaneously. However, the seller's repudiation allowed the buyer to suspend payment.

Educational objective: A party who anticipatorily repudiates a contract may retract the repudiation if the nonrepudiating party is notified of the retraction before (1) canceling the contract, (2) materially changing position in reliance on the repudiation, or (3) indicating that he/she considers the repudiation to be final.



选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 10%，C选项 73%（正确选项），D选项 10%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

一方未在履行到期时履行其合同义务，即构成违约。根据预期违约 (anticipatory repudiation) 原则，违约也可能发生在履行到期之前。该原则适用于一方明确且毫不含糊地拒绝履行（即，表示不愿意履行）其承诺的情况。如果非违约方在以下情况发生之前收到撤回通知，则拒绝履行的意思表示可以被撤回：
  • 取消合同
  • 因信赖该拒绝履行而处境发生重大改变 或
  • 表示其认为该拒绝履行为最终决定(选项D)。
但是，在该拒绝履行被撤回之前，非违约方可以 (1) 将该拒绝履行视为违约，或 (2) 忽略它并要求对方根据合同履行。如果在商业上是合理的，非违约方也可以中止自己的履行。

在本案中，卖方在6月1日作出了预期违约。随后，卖方试图在6月10日撤回其拒绝履行合同的意思表示。然而，买方已因信赖该拒绝履行，于6月5日购买了一块替代土地，从而使其处境发生了重大改变(选项B)。因此，卖方的撤回是无效的。并且，由于卖方未被撤回的拒绝履行构成违约，买方很可能会胜诉。

(选项A) 在不动产合同中，支付购买价款和转让契据的交付通常必须同时发生。然而，卖方的拒绝履行允许买方中止支付。

教学目标： 作出预期违约的一方可以撤回其拒绝履行，条件是通知在非违约方 (1) 取消合同，(2) 因信赖该拒绝履行而处境发生重大改变，或 (3) 表示其认为该拒绝履行为最终决定之前送达非违约方。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 253 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (effect of an anticipatory repudiation).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 256 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (retraction of repudiation).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Anticipatory Repudiation
核心考点：预期违约的撤回

当一方明确表示拒绝履行合同（Anticipatory Repudiation）后，该方原则上可以撤回（Retract）该拒绝意思表示，除非非违约方已经：

  1. 取消了合同；
  2. 基于信赖发生了处境的重大改变 (Material Change of Position)；或
  3. 表示其认为该拒绝履行为最终决定。

📅 本案时间轴分析

6月1日
卖方发函拒绝履行合同。
[Anticipatory Repudiation]
6月5日
买方购买替代土地。
[Material Change of Position]
⚠️ 关键点：此时撤回权终止。
6月10日
卖方试图撤回拒绝意思表示。
（无效，因为买方已改变处境）
正确答案 C

买方会胜诉。

根据《合同法重述（第二版）》§ 256，一旦非违约方（买方）基于对违约方（卖方）拒绝履行的信赖，采取了行动并导致处境发生重大改变（例如购买了替代物），违约方就失去了撤回拒绝履行的权利。

在本案中，买方在卖方试图撤回（6月10日）之前，已经于6月5日购买了替代土地。这一行为锁定了卖方的违约状态，使得卖方随后的撤回无效。

🚫 陷阱排除

选项 A 错误

关于“推定条件” (Constructive Condition)：
虽然通常买方付款是卖方交房的条件，但卖方的预期违约免除了买方在履行日（7月1日）提出付款（Tender）的义务。买方可以直接起诉违约，无需先付款。

选项 B 错误

关于“撤回时间”：
虽然卖方确实在履行日（7月1日）之前试图撤回，但这并不够。关键在于撤回必须发生在买方改变处境之前。本案中买方已于6月5日改变处境，因此撤回太晚了。

选项 D 错误

关于“不可撤回性”：
法律并不规定预期违约一旦作出就永远不可撤回。它是可以撤回的，只要非违约方还没有采取行动（如取消合同或改变处境）。选项D说法过于绝对。

Reference: Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 253, § 256

On April 1, a buyer agreed to purchase an electric motor from a seller for $1,000, delivery to be made on the following June 1. Before signing the agreement, the parties orally agreed that the contract of sale would be effective only if the buyer should notify the seller in writing not later than May 2 that the buyer had arranged to resell the motor to a third party.
On April 15, the buyer entered into a contract with a third party to resell the motor to the third party at a profit. On April 16, the buyer notified the seller by phone of the buyer's resale agreement with the third party and explained that a written notice was unfeasible, because the buyer's secretary was ill. The seller replied, "That's okay. I'll get the motor to you on June 1, as we agreed." Having learned, however, that the motor had increased in value about 75% since April 1, the seller renounced the agreement on June 1.
If the buyer sues the seller on June 2 for breach of contract, which of the following concepts best supports the buyer's claim?

choices.a: Nonoccurrence of a condition subsequent.
choices.b: Novation of buyers.
choices.c: Substantial performance.
choices.d: Waiver of condition.

4月1日，一买方同意以1000美元的价格从一卖方处购买一台电动机，约定于同年6月1日交货。在签署协议前，双方口头约定，仅当买方在5月2日之前书面通知卖方其已安排将该电动机转售给第三方时，该销售合同才生效。

4月15日，买方与第三方签订合同，以盈利价格将该电动机转售给该第三方。4月16日，买方通过电话将与第三方的转售协议告知卖方，并解释说由于其秘书生病，无法提供书面通知。卖方回答说：“没关系。我会按照我们的约定，在6月1日将电动机交给您。”然而，在得知自4月1日以来该电动机的价值上涨了约75%后，卖方于6月1日拒绝履行该协议。

如果买方于6月2日以违约为由起诉卖方，以下哪个概念最能支持买方的主张？
options:
A. Nonoccurrence of a condition subsequent.
后决条件的未发生。

B. Novation of buyers.
买方的合同更新（Novation）。

C. Substantial performance.
实质性履行。

D. Waiver of condition.
条件的豁免。
data.explanation:
When nonoccurrence of a condition is excused


WaiverParty waives condition by words or conduct
Wrongful interferenceParty wrongfully prevents or interferes with condition's occurrence
EstoppelParty indicates condition will not be enforced AND Other party reasonably & detrimentally relies on belief that condition has been waived
Disproportionate forfeitureParty substantially performed & will be significantly harmed if condition is enforced
A party to a contract may avoid performance if a condition precedent - ie, an uncertain future event that must occur before performance becomes due - has not occurred, and the nonoccurrence is not excused. Nonoccurrence of a condition may be excused if the party who benefits from the condition waives it by words or conduct.†

Here, the parties orally agreed that their written contract would be effective only if the buyer gave the seller written notice by May 2 that the buyer had arranged to resell the electric motor (condition precedent). Although the buyer notified the seller about the resale agreement by phone on April 16 (nonoccurrence), the seller said that oral notice was "okay" and promised to deliver the motor on June 1 as agreed (waiver). Since the seller waived the condition, both parties were obligated to perform. As a result, waiver best supports the buyer's breach-of-contract claim.

†The waiving party may retract the waiver unless the other party has detrimentally relied on it.

(Choice A) The notice requirement was a condition precedent - not a condition subsequent, which discharges a party's duty to perform once the specified event occurs.

(Choice B) A novation is a substitute contract in which the parties agree to replace an original contracting party with a new party (not seen here).

(Choice C) Where an agreement makes performance contingent upon a condition precedent (eg, written notice of the resale), substantial performance is not sufficient to overcome the condition's nonoccurrence.

Educational objective: Nonoccurrence of a condition may be excused if the contracting party who benefits from the condition waives it by words or conduct.

选项正确率统计：A选项 8%，B选项 1%，C选项 9%，D选项 81%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

条件未发生可被豁免的情形


豁免 (Waiver)一方当事人通过言语或行为豁免条件
不当干涉 (Wrongful interference)一方当事人不当阻止或干涉条件的发生
禁止反言 (Estoppel)一方当事人表示将不强制执行条件，且另一方当事人合理地、有损害地信赖该条件已被豁免
不成比例的权利丧失 (Disproportionate forfeiture)一方当事人已实质性履行，且若强制执行条件将遭受重大损害
如果一个先决条件——即在履行义务到期前必须发生的不确定未来事件——没有发生，且其未发生不可被豁免，则合同一方当事人可以免于履行。条件的未发生可能被豁免，如果从该条件中受益的一方当事人通过言语或行为豁免了该条件。†

在本案中，双方口头约定，其书面合同生效的唯一条件是如果买方在5月2日前向卖方发出书面通知，告知其已安排转售该电动机（先决条件）。尽管买方在4月16日通过电话通知了卖方转售协议事宜（条件未发生），但卖方表示口头通知“没关系”，并承诺按约定于6月1日交付电动机（豁免）。由于卖方豁免了该条件，双方均有义务履行合同。因此，“豁免”最能支持买方提出的违约主张。

†豁免方可以撤回其豁免，除非另一方已对此产生有损害的信赖。

(选项A) 通知要求是一个先决条件——而非后决条件，后决条件是指在特定事件发生后免除一方当事人履行义务的条件。

(选项B) 合同更新（Novation）是指双方同意用一个新当事人替换原合同当事人的替代合同（本案未出现此种情况）。

(选项C) 当协议的履行取决于一个先决条件（例如，关于转售的书面通知）时，实质性履行不足以克服条件的未发生。

教学目标：如果从条件中受益的合同当事人通过言语或行为豁免了该条件，则该条件的未发生可被豁免。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 225 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (conditions and effect of nonoccurrence).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Conditions
核心法律概念：豁免 (Waiver)

本题的正确答案是 D。

豁免 (Waiver) 是指一方当事人自愿放弃其已知的权利。在合同法中，如果一方当事人（受益方）通过言语或行为表示不再要求对方满足某个先决条件 (Condition Precedent)，则该条件被视为已豁免。

一旦条件被豁免，受益方不得再以该条件未发生为由拒绝履行合同义务。

本案逻辑推演
1. 识别条件 (Identify the Condition):
合同生效的前提是买方必须在5月2日前发出“书面通知” (Written Notice)。这是一个典型的Condition Precedent。
2. 条件未发生 (Nonoccurrence):
买方仅进行了“电话通知” (Oral Notice)，未满足书面要求。技术上讲，条件未成就，卖方本可以以此为由主张合同未生效。
3. 卖方的行为 (The Waiver):
卖方明确表示：“没关系 (That's okay)。我会按照我们的约定...交货。”
4. 法律后果 (Legal Consequence):
卖方的这句话构成了对“书面形式”这一条件的豁免 (Waiver)。因此，卖方放弃了以“未收到书面通知”为由拒绝履行的权利。合同完全生效，卖方不交货构成违约。
为什么其他选项是错误的？
A. 后决条件 (Condition Subsequent)
错误。后决条件是指某事发生后解除已存在的义务。本案中的通知是合同生效的前提，属于先决条件 (Condition Precedent)。
B. 合同更新 (Novation)
错误。Novation 需要三方协议，用新当事人替换原当事人。本案虽然涉及转售给第三方，但原买卖合同的当事人（买方和卖方）并未改变。
C. 实质性履行 (Substantial Performance)
错误。实质性履行通常适用于建筑合同等涉及复杂履行的场景（推定条件）。对于明示条件 (Express Conditions)，如本案中的“必须书面通知”，通常要求严格遵守 (Strict Compliance)，实质性履行不足以满足明示条件，除非该条件被豁免。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

当你看到合同中包含“仅当...时生效 (only if...)”或“前提是 (provided that...)”的条款时，立即标记为明示条件 (Express Condition)。

如果随后一方未能满足该条件，但另一方说“没关系”或继续履行，考点几乎总是豁免 (Waiver)。

questions.question:
A wholesaler contracted in a signed writing to sell to a bakery 10,000 pounds of flour each week for 10 weeks, the flour to be delivered to the bakery on Mondays and payment to be made on Wednesdays of each week. The bakery did all of its weekly bread baking on Tuesdays.
On Monday morning of the first week, the wholesaler tendered delivery of 8,000 pounds of flour to the bakery, and the bakery accepted it on the wholesaler's assurance that the remaining 2,000 pounds would be delivered later that evening, which it was. The bakery paid for both deliveries on Wednesday.
On Monday of the second week, the wholesaler tendered delivery of 5,000 pounds of flour to the bakery and said that the remaining 5,000 pounds could not be delivered on Monday but would be delivered by Wednesday. The bakery rejected the tender.
Was the bakery legally justified in rejecting the tender of the 5,000 pounds of flour?

choices.a: No, because by accepting the first 8,000 pounds on Monday of the first week, the bakery had waived the condition of perfect tender and had not reinstated it.
choices.b: No, because the tender was not a substantial impairment of the entire contract, and the wholesaler had given assurance of a cure.
choices.c: Yes, because the bakery was legally entitled to reject any tender that did not conform perfectly to the contract.
choices.d: Yes, because the tender was a substantial impairment of that installment and could not be cured.

On Monday morning of the first week, the wholesaler tendered delivery of 8,000 pounds of flour to the bakery, and the bakery accepted it on the wholesaler's assurance that the remaining 2,000 pounds would be delivered later that evening, which it was. The bakery paid for both deliveries on Wednesday.

On Monday of the second week, the wholesaler tendered delivery of 5,000 pounds of flour to the bakery and said that the remaining 5,000 pounds could not be delivered on Monday but would be delivered by Wednesday. The bakery rejected the tender.

Was the bakery legally justified in rejecting the tender of the 5,000 pounds of flour?

一家批发商在一份签署的书面合同中，同意每周向一家面包店出售10,000磅面粉，为期10周，面粉于每周一交付至面包店，货款于每周三支付。该面包店每周二进行其所有的面包烘焙工作。

第一周的周一早上，批发商向面包店提出交付8,000磅面粉，面包店在批发商保证剩余的2,000磅将于当晚稍后送达后接受了这批货，而批发商也确实这么做了。面包店于周三支付了这两批货物的货款。

第二周的周一，批发商向面包店提出交付5,000磅面粉，并表示剩余的5,000磅无法在周一交付，但会在周三前送达。面包店拒绝了该交付。

面包店拒绝这5,000磅面粉的交付在法律上是否有正当理由？
options:
A. No, because by accepting the first 8,000 pounds on Monday of the first week, the bakery had waived the condition of perfect tender and had not reinstated it.
不，因为面包店在第一周的周一接受了首批8,000磅面粉，即已放弃了“完全履行”的条件，并且未曾恢复该条件。

B. No, because the tender was not a substantial impairment of the entire contract, and the wholesaler had given assurance of a cure.
不，因为该交付并未对整个合同构成实质性损害，且批发商已对补救做出了保证。

C. Yes, because the bakery was legally entitled to reject any tender that did not conform perfectly to the contract.
是，因为面包店在法律上有权拒绝任何未完全符合合同的交付。

D. Yes, because the tender was a substantial impairment of that installment and could not be cured.
是，因为该交付对该分期交付构成了实质性损害，且无法被补救。
data.explanation:
Installment contracts


DefinitionGoods delivered in multiple shipments that buyer separately accepts
Buyer may reject shipment only if nonconformity:
Nonconforming shipmentsubstantially impairs value of that shipment to buyer and cannot be cured
Canceling contractBuyer may cancel entire contract if nonconformity substantially impairs value of entire contract to buyer
Contracts for the sale of goods generally follow the UCC's perfect-tender rule , under which a seller must tender goods conforming to the warranty obligations in the contract. Substantial performance will not suffice. But this rule does not apply to installment contracts , which provide for the delivery of goods in multiple shipments, each to be separately accepted by the buyer (as seen here).

Instead, installment contracts follow the substantial-impairment rule. This rule allows the buyer to reject tender of nonconforming goods when the nonconformity substantially impairs the value of that shipment to the buyer and cannot be cured.

Here, during the second week, the wholesaler delivered only 5,000 pounds of flour instead of the 10,000 pounds promised in their installment contract. This nonconformity substantially impaired the value of that shipment and could not be cured since the remaining 5,000 pounds could not be delivered until Wednesday - one day after the bakery does its weekly bread baking. As a result, the bakery was justified in rejecting the nonconforming tender.

(Choices A & C) The perfect-tender rule does not apply to installment contracts (as seen here). Additionally, the bakery's acceptance of the nonconforming tender the previous week does not waive its right to reject the nonconforming tender during the second week. That is because each shipment in an installment contract must be separately accepted by the buyer.

(Choice B) The buyer may cancel an entire installment contract if a nonconforming shipment substantially impairs the value of the entire contract to the buyer. The nonconformance here likely did not do so, but it did substantially impair that shipment. And a buyer need only accept a nonconforming shipment if the seller makes adequate assurances that he/she can timely cure the nonconformity, which the wholesaler did not do here.

Educational objective: Installment contracts follow the substantial-impairment rule, which allows a buyer to reject tender of nonconforming goods when the nonconformity substantially impairs the value of that shipment and cannot be cured.

UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 13%，C选项 22%，D选项 61%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

分期交付合同


定义货物分批装运，买方分别接受
仅在不符约定的情况下，买方才可拒收货物：
不符约定的装运该批货物的价值对买方造成实质性损害且无法被补救
解除合同如果不符约定的情况对整个合同的价值对买方造成实质性损害，买方可以解除整个合同
货物销售合同通常遵循UCC的“完全履行规则”(perfect-tender rule)，根据该规则，卖方必须交付符合合同中担保义务的货物。实质性履行是不够的。但此规则不适用于分期交付合同，该类合同规定货物分批交付，每批货物由买方分别接受（如本案所示）。

相反，分期交付合同遵循“实质性损害规则”(substantial-impairment rule)。该规则允许买方在不符约定的情况对该批货物的价值对买方造成实质性损害且无法被补救时，拒收不符约定的货物。

在本案中，第二周时，批发商仅交付了5,000磅面粉，而不是其分期交付合同中承诺的10,000磅。这种不符约定的情况实质性地损害了该批货物的价值，并且无法得到补救，因为剩余的5,000磅直到周三才能交付——这时距离面包店每周的面包烘焙日已经过去了一天。因此，面包店有正当理由拒收这批不符约定的货物。

（选项A和C）“完全履行规则”不适用于分期交付合同（如本案所示）。此外，面包店在前一周接受不符约定的交付，并不意味着其放弃了在第二周拒绝不符约定交付的权利。这是因为在分期交付合同中，每批货物都必须由买方单独接受。

（选项B）如果一次不符约定的交付对整个合同的价值对买方造成实质性损害，买方可以解除整个分期交付合同。本案中的不符约定情况很可能没有达到这种程度，但它确实实质性地损害了该批货物的价值。并且，只有在卖方提供其能够及时补救不符约定之处的充分保证时，买方才有义务接受不符约定的货物，而本案中的批发商并未做到这一点。

教学目标：分期交付合同遵循“实质性损害规则”，该规则允许买方在不符约定的情况对该批货物的价值造成实质性损害且无法被补救时，拒收不符约定的货物。

UCC = 《美国统一商法典》(Uniform Commercial Code)

References

U.C.C. § 2-612 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (breach of installment contract).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

分期交付合同与拒收规则

核心考点：UCC § 2-612

本题考察的是分期交付合同 (Installment Contracts) 下买方的拒收权。这与普通货物买卖合同的“完全履行规则” (Perfect Tender Rule) 有本质区别。

普通合同 (Single Delivery)

适用 Perfect Tender Rule：只要货物有任何一点不符合合同，买方即可拒收。

分期交付合同 (Installment Contract)

适用 Substantial Impairment Rule：买方不能仅仅因为货物不完美而拒收。

拒收条件 (Rejection Criteria)：

  1. 不符点实质性地损害 (Substantially Impairs) 了该批货物的价值；且
  2. 该不符点无法被补救 (Cannot be Cured)。

案情关键时间线

合同约定：每周一交货，面包店周二烘焙。

周一 (Monday)
批发商只交付了 5,000 磅（缺 5,000 磅）。
周二 (Tuesday)
面包店烘焙日 (Baking Day)
此时缺货将导致无法生产。
周三 (Wednesday)
批发商承诺补足剩余面粉的时间。

结论： 批发商承诺的补救时间（周三）晚于面包店的使用时间（周二）。这种延迟使得该批面粉对面包店失去了价值。

✅ 正确答案：D

理由：

  • 实质性损害 (Substantial Impairment)： 缺货一半且无法在烘焙日（周二）前补足，严重影响了面包店的商业运营。
  • 无法补救 (Cannot be Cured)： 批发商明确表示周三才能送货，这对周二就要用的面包店来说，等同于无法及时补救。

因此，面包店有权根据 UCC § 2-612 拒收这批货物。

选项 A 错误 弃权 (Waiver)：第一周接受补救并不意味着放弃了未来所有“按时足额交货”的权利。且第一周是在当天（周一）补救的，不影响周二使用；第二周的情况完全不同。

选项 B 错误 补救保证 (Assurance of Cure)：虽然批发商承诺了补救，但该补救方案（周三送达）是不充分的 (Inadequate)，因为它错过了买方的关键使用时间。

选项 C 错误 完全履行 (Perfect Tender)：这是最大的干扰项。请记住，分期交付合同不适用完全履行规则。如果只是轻微瑕疵（例如缺了10磅），买方是不能拒收的。

MBE 考试技巧：
看到 "Installment Contract" 或分批交货的描述，
立即划掉 "Perfect Tender" 相关的选项。
寻找 "Substantial Impairment"！

questions.question:
A general contractor agreed to build a refrigerated storage facility for a company that transports perishable food. A subcontractor agreed with the general contractor to install the facility's refrigeration system. Their agreement included the express condition that all pipes for the refrigeration system were to be made of solid steel. However, the subcontractor completed the job using galvanized steel pipes that he had on hand. Unlike solid steel, the galvanized steel degrades quickly upon coming into contact with the type of refrigerant used in the refrigeration system.
The general contractor discovered the substitution after the job was completed. The subcontractor, who was fully engaged out-of-state on another company's job site, declined to replace the pipes. The general contractor subsequently refused to pay the subcontractor pursuant to the contract and hired another subcontractor to replace the pipes so that the facility could be made operational.
If the subcontractor sues the general contractor for breach of contract, how is the court likely to rule?

choices.a: The subcontractor can recover in quantum meruit despite his failure to comply with an express condition in the contract.
choices.b: The subcontractor cannot recover damages under the contract because he committed a material breach.
choices.c: The subcontractor is entitled to damages for services performed because the use of a different type of pipe was a minor breach.
choices.d: The subcontractor is entitled to the full contract price because he substantially performed.

questions.question:
On June 1, a general contractor and a subcontractor entered into a contract under which the subcontractor agreed to deliver all of the steel joists that the general contractor required in the construction of a hospital building. The contract provided that delivery of the steel joists would begin on September 1.
Although the general contractor had no reason to doubt the subcontractor's ability to perform, the general contractor wanted to be sure that the subcontractor was on track for delivery in September. He therefore wrote a letter on July 1 to the subcontractor demanding that the subcontractor provide assurance of its ability to meet the September 1 deadline. The subcontractor refused to provide such assurance.
The general contractor then immediately obtained the steel joists from another supplier.
If the subcontractor sues the general contractor for breach of contract, is the subcontractor likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the contract failed to specify a definite quantity.
choices.b: No, because the subcontractor anticipatorily repudiated the contract when it failed to provide adequate assurance.
choices.c: Yes, because a demand for assurance constitutes a breach of contract when the contract does not expressly authorize a party to demand assurance.
choices.d: Yes, because the subcontractor's failure to provide assurance was not a repudiation since there were no reasonable grounds for the general contractor's insecurity.

The contract provided that delivery of the steel joists would begin on September 1.

Although the general contractor had no reason to doubt the subcontractor's ability to perform, the general contractor wanted to be sure that the subcontractor was on track for delivery in September. He therefore wrote a letter on July 1 to the subcontractor demanding that the subcontractor provide assurance of its ability to meet the September 1 deadline. The subcontractor refused to provide such assurance.

The general contractor then immediately obtained the steel joists from another supplier.

If the subcontractor sues the general contractor for breach of contract, is the subcontractor likely to prevail?

6月1日，一家总承包商和一家分包商签订了一份合同，分包商同意交付总承包商在建造一座医院大楼时所需的所有钢托梁。合同规定，钢托梁的交付将于9月1日开始。

尽管总承包商没有理由怀疑分包商的履约能力，但总承包商希望确定分包商能够按时在9月份交货。因此，他于7月1日致函分包商，要求分包商为其满足9月1日截止日期的能力提供保证。分包商拒绝提供该等保证。

随后，总承包商立即从另一家供应商处获得了钢托梁。

如果分包商以违约为由起诉总承包商，分包商是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the contract failed to specify a definite quantity.
不会，因为合同未能明确规定确切的数量。

B. No, because the subcontractor anticipatorily repudiated the contract when it failed to provide adequate assurance.
不会，因为分包商在未能提供充分保证时，构成了预期毁约。

C. Yes, because a demand for assurance constitutes a breach of contract when the contract does not expressly authorize a party to demand assurance.
会，因为当合同没有明确授权一方当事人要求提供保证时，要求提供保证的行为本身构成违约。

D. Yes, because the subcontractor's failure to provide assurance was not a repudiation since there were no reasonable grounds for the general contractor's insecurity.
会，因为总承包商没有感到不安的合理理由，所以分包商未能提供保证的行为不构成毁约。
data.explanation:
The Uniform Commercial Code ( UCC ) governs contracts for the sale of goods (eg, steel joists). Under UCC § 2-609, a party with reasonable grounds for insecurity about the other party's performance has the right to make a written demand for assurances that the other party will perform the contract. Failure to provide such assurances within 30 days after a valid demand constitutes an anticipatory repudiation of the contract. The party that made the demand may then treat the repudiation as a breach of contract or ignore it and demand performance.

Here, the general contractor had no reason to doubt the subcontractor's ability to perform pursuant to the contract. As a result, the general contractor had no right to demand assurances, and the subcontractor's failure to provide assurance was not an anticipatory repudiation (Choice B). The general contractor then breached the contract by obtaining the steel joists from another supplier. Therefore, the subcontractor will likely prevail.

(Choice A) Contracts for the sale of goods must contain a quantity term. Here, the contract did not specify a definite quantity of steel joists. But the quantity could be made certain under this requirements contract because the subcontractor agreed to deliver all the steel joists that the general contractor required.

(Choice C) A demand for assurances does not constitute a breach of contract when the contract does not expressly authorize a party to demand assurances. That is because the UCC impliedly authorizes a party to demand assurances when reasonable grounds for insecurity exist (not seen here).

Educational objective: Under the UCC, a party with reasonable grounds for insecurity about the other party's performance has the right to make a written demand for assurances that the other party will perform the contract. Failure to provide such assurances within 30 days after a valid demand constitutes an anticipatory repudiation.



选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 6%，C选项 0%，D选项 92%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

《统一商法典》(UCC) 管辖货物买卖合同（例如，钢托梁）。根据 UCC § 2-609，一方当事人如有合理理由对另一方当事人的履约感到不安，则有权向对方提出书面要求，要求其为将来的履约提供保证。在收到有效要求后30天内未能提供此等保证，构成对合同的预期毁约。提出要求的一方当事人可将此毁约行为视为违约，或不予理会并要求对方履约。

在本案中，总承包商没有理由怀疑分包商根据合同履约的能力。因此，总承包商无权要求保证，而分包商未能提供保证的行为也不构成预期毁约（选项B）。随后，总承包商从另一家供应商处获得钢托梁的行为构成了违约。因此，分包商很可能胜诉。

（选项 A）货物买卖合同必须包含数量条款。在本案中，合同没有明确规定钢托梁的确切数量。但根据这份需求合同，该数量是可以被确定的，因为分包商同意交付总承包商所需的所有钢托梁。

（选项 C）当合同没有明确授权一方当事人要求提供保证时，要求提供保证的行为本身不构成违约。这是因为当存在合理的不安理由时，UCC默示授权一方当事人可以要求提供保证（本案情况并非如此）。

教学目标：根据 UCC，一方当事人如有合理理由对另一方当事人的履约感到不安，则有权提出书面要求，要求对方为将来的履约提供保证。在收到有效要求后30天内未能提供此等保证，构成预期毁约。

References

U.C.C. § 2-609 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (right to adequate assurance of performance).

U.C.C. § 2-610 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (anticipatory repudiation).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考题解析

Contracts / Sales (UCC Article 2)
正确答案：D

分包商会胜诉。因为总承包商没有感到不安的合理理由，所以分包商没有义务提供保证，其拒绝行为不构成毁约。

核心考点：UCC § 2-609
要求履约保证的权利 (Right to Adequate Assurance)

根据《统一商法典》(UCC)，一方当事人只有在拥有“对另一方履约感到不安的合理理由” (reasonable grounds for insecurity) 时，才有权书面要求对方提供履约保证。
逻辑推演步骤
  • 1
    事实认定：题目明确指出总承包商“没有理由怀疑分包商的履约能力” (had no reason to doubt)。他只是单纯想“确定”一下。
  • 2
    法律适用：由于缺乏合理的不安理由，总承包商发出的“保证要求函”在法律上是无效的。
  • 3
    分包商的权利：既然要求无效，分包商就没有义务回复或提供保证。因此，分包商的拒绝或沉默不构成预期毁约 (Anticipatory Repudiation)。
  • 4
    结论：总承包商在分包商未违约的情况下，擅自找第三方购买钢材，这构成了总承包商自己的违约。因此，分包商起诉将胜诉。
为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A (错误) 虽然合同没有写明具体数字，但需求合同 (Requirements Contract) 在 UCC 下是有效的。只要数量是基于买方的实际善意需求，合同就具有可执行性。
选项 B (错误) 这是最强的干扰项。如果总承包商有“合理理由”感到不安，那么分包商拒绝提供保证确实会构成预期毁约。但本题的关键在于没有合理理由。
选项 C (错误) 要求保证本身并不构成违约，它只是在没有合理理由时没有法律效力而已。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 在处理 UCC § 2-609 问题时，务必仔细寻找题目中关于“不安理由” (Grounds for Insecurity) 的描述。

如果题目说一方仅仅是“nervous”（紧张）或“wanted to be sure”（想确认），而没有具体的财务危机或履约瑕疵作为依据，那么他们通常无权要求保证。

questions.question:
A rental company contracted to lease a collapsible sports dome to a private tennis club. The dome would be used to cover the club's outdoor tennis courts so that the courts could be used for the club's Annual Winter Tennis Tournament beginning on November 16. The contract required the rental company to finish installing the dome no later than November 15.
On November 10, the installation crew arrived to lay out the anchoring system required for the dome. However, the crew did not have enough anchors to secure the dome. The club's owner overheard a crew member say that the rental company had forgotten to order the rest of the anchors and that he did not expect them to arrive for at least a month. That same day, the club owner canceled the contract and leased an indoor space near the club. The rental company has sued the tennis club for breach of contract.
Will the rental company likely prevail?

choices.a: No, because the crew member's November 10 statement was an anticipatory repudiation that gave the club owner the right to cancel the contract.
choices.b: No, because the rental company's failure to order the remaining anchors made it impossible to finish installing the dome by November 15.
choices.c: Yes, because the club owner failed to seasonably notify the rental company of his intention to cancel the contract before leasing the indoor space.
choices.d: Yes, because the club owner never demanded and did not obtain the rental company's assurance of due performance under the contract.

A rental company contracted to lease a collapsible sports dome to a private tennis club. The dome would be used to cover the club's outdoor tennis courts so that the courts could be used for the club's Annual Winter Tennis Tournament beginning on November 16. The contract required the rental company to finish installing the dome no later than November 15.

On November 10, the installation crew arrived to lay out the anchoring system required for the dome. However, the crew did not have enough anchors to secure the dome. The club's owner overheard a crew member say that the rental company had forgotten to order the rest of the anchors and that he did not expect them to arrive for at least a month. That same day, the club owner canceled the contract and leased an indoor space near the club. The rental company has sued the tennis club for breach of contract.

Will the rental company likely prevail?

一家租赁公司与一家私人网球俱乐部签订合同，向其出租一个可折叠式运动穹顶。该穹顶将用于覆盖俱乐部的室外网球场，以便这些球场能用于俱乐部于11月16日开始的年度冬季网球锦标赛。合同要求租赁公司不迟于11月15日完成穹顶的安装。

11月10日，安装团队到达现场，为穹顶布置所需的锚固系统。然而，团队没有足够的锚栓来固定穹顶。俱乐部所有者无意中听到一名团队成员说，租赁公司忘记订购剩余的锚栓，他预计这些锚栓至少一个月内不会到货。同一天，俱乐部所有者取消了合同，并在俱乐部附近租用了一个室内场地。租赁公司以违约为由起诉了该网球俱乐部。

租赁公司可能会胜诉吗？
options:
A. No, because the crew member's November 10 statement was an anticipatory repudiation that gave the club owner the right to cancel the contract.
不会，因为该团队成员11月10日的陈述构成了预期毁约，赋予了俱乐部所有者取消合同的权利。

B. No, because the rental company's failure to order the remaining anchors made it impossible to finish installing the dome by November 15.
不会，因为租赁公司未能订购剩余的锚栓，导致其不可能在11月15日前完成穹顶的安装。

C. Yes, because the club owner failed to seasonably notify the rental company of his intention to cancel the contract before leasing the indoor space.
会，因为俱乐部所有者在租赁室内场地之前，未能及时将其取消合同的意图通知租赁公司。

D. Yes, because the club owner never demanded and did not obtain the rental company's assurance of due performance under the contract.
会，因为俱乐部所有者从未要求也未能获得租赁公司根据合同作出的适当履行的保证。
data.explanation:
Anticipatory repudiation occurs when one party to a contract unequivocally communicates to the other party that it will not perform under the contract. This gives the other party the right to cancel the contract and sue for breach.† In contrast, prospective inability to perform involves words or conduct that create reasonable grounds for insecurity that a party will perform. This gives the other party the right to demand assurance of performance. Failure to provide adequate assurance within a reasonable time is an anticipatory repudiation.

Here, the club owner overheard the crew member say that he did not expect the remaining anchors to arrive for at least a month. This was not an unequivocal statement by the rental company that it would not perform (no anticipatory repudiation) (Choice A).

However, the statement gave the owner reasonable grounds for insecurity about the company's ability to install the dome by November 15 (prospective inability to perform). But since the owner never demanded and did not obtain the company's assurance, the owner's cancellation of the contract on November 10 was premature. Therefore, the company will likely prevail.

†Alternatively, the other party may ignore the repudiation and demand performance pursuant to the contract.

(Choice B) A repudiation can be communicated through words or through conduct that renders due performance impossible. Here, although the lack of anchors made it impossible to install the dome on November 10, the rental company still had five days to perform.

(Choice C) Had the rental company repudiated the contract, it could have retracted the repudiation by notifying the club owner of the retraction before he
  • cancelled the contract,
  • materially changed position in reliance on the repudiation, or
  • indicated that he considered the repudiation to be final.
But the club owner would not have been required to notify the rental company before doing any of those things.

Educational objective: A contracting party's prospective inability to perform entitles the other party to demand assurance of performance. Failure to provide such assurance within a reasonable time is an anticipatory repudiation that justifies canceling the contract.



选项正确率统计：A选项 7%，B选项 7%，C选项 3%，D选项 80%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

预期毁约 (Anticipatory repudiation) 是指合同一方明确地向另一方表示其将不履行合同。这赋予了另一方取消合同和以违约为由提起诉讼的权利。† 与此相对，预期不能履行 (prospective inability to perform) 是指一方的言语或行为造成了对其履约能力不安全的合理理由。这赋予了另一方要求履约保证的权利。在合理时间内未能提供充分的保证则构成预期毁约。

在本案中，俱乐部所有者无意中听到团队成员说，他预计剩余的锚栓至少一个月内不会到货。这并非租赁公司作出的其将不履行合同的明确声明（不构成预期毁约）（选项A）。

然而，该陈述给予了所有者对公司在11月15日前安装穹顶的能力产生了不安全的合理理由（预期不能履行）。但由于所有者从未要求也未能获得公司的保证，其在11月10日取消合同的行为为时过早。因此，该公司可能会胜诉。

†或者，另一方可以忽略该毁约，并要求对方根据合同履行。

（选项B）毁约可以通过言语或行为来传达，该言语或行为使得适当履行成为不可能。在本案中，尽管缺少锚栓使得在11月10日无法安装穹顶，但租赁公司仍有五天时间来履行合同。

（选项C）如果租赁公司已经毁约，它可以在俱乐部所有者做出以下行为前，通过通知其撤回毁约：
  • 取消合同，
  • 因信赖该毁约而使其处境发生重大改变，或
  • 表示他认为该毁约是最终的。
但俱乐部所有者在做出任何上述行为之前，并无义务通知租赁公司。

教学目标：合同一方的预期不能履行赋予另一方要求履约保证的权利。在合理时间内未能提供此等保证则构成预期毁约，为取消合同提供了正当理由。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 250 (Am. Law Inst. 2020) (repudiation).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 251 (Am. Law Inst. 2020) (failure to provide assurance as repudiation).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Performance & Breach
核心考点：预期毁约 vs. 履约保证

本题考察的是当一方表现出可能无法履约的迹象时，另一方应采取何种法律行动。

关键区别在于：

  • 预期毁约 (Anticipatory Repudiation)：必须是明确、毫不含糊的拒绝履行声明。
  • 预期不能履行 (Prospective Inability to Perform)：仅仅是有理由担心对方无法履行，此时有权要求履约保证 (Assurance of Performance)。
案情逻辑链条
1
事实触发点：
俱乐部老板无意中听到 (overheard) 员工说“忘了订锚栓，一个月内到不了”。
2
法律定性：
这不是租赁公司官方发出的“明确拒绝履行”的声明。这只是员工的闲谈，构成了老板对公司履约能力的合理担忧 (Reasonable grounds for insecurity)。
3
正确做法：
根据 Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 251，老板应该先向公司要求履约保证 (Demand Assurance)。
4
实际后果：
老板没有要求保证，直接取消合同。这种过早的取消行为本身构成了对合同的违约 (Breach)。
为什么选 D？

选项 D 正确：
"Yes, because the club owner never demanded and did not obtain the rental company's assurance..."

租赁公司会胜诉。因为老板在听到不利消息时，法律赋予他的权利是“暂停履行并要求保证”。只有当公司未能在合理时间内提供保证时，老板才能将其视为预期毁约并取消合同。老板跳过了这一步，直接取消，属于违约。

选项 A 错误 (Anticipatory Repudiation)：
预期毁约必须是“明确且毫不含糊”的 (Unequivocal)。无意中听到的员工抱怨不足以构成公司的正式毁约声明。
选项 B 错误 (Impossibility)：
虽然缺少锚栓，但离截止日期（11月15日）还有5天。法律上不能假定公司无法在市场上找到替代品或解决方案。只要时间未到且非绝对不可能，公司仍有权尝试履约。
选项 C 错误 (Notification)：
如果真的发生了预期毁约，受害方通常不需要通知违约方即可采取行动。本题的关键不在于通知，而在于毁约尚未成立。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧

在合同法题目中，当看到一方表现得“摇摇欲坠”或有传言说他们无法履约时，不要立即判定为“预期毁约”。

寻找关键词：

  • 如果是 "Unequivocal statement" (明确声明) ➡️ 预期毁约。
  • 如果是 "Reasonable grounds for insecurity" (不安全感的合理理由) ➡️ 必须先要求保证 (Demand Assurance)。

questions.question:
A producer contracted to pay an inexperienced performer a specified salary to act in a small role in a play the producer was taking on a six-week road tour. The contract was for the duration of the tour.
On the third day of the tour, the performer was hospitalized with a stomach disorder. The producer replaced her in the cast with an experienced actor. One week later, the performer recovered, but the producer refused to allow her to resume her original role for the remainder of the tour.
In an action by the performer against the producer for breach of contract, which of the following, if proved, would be the producer's best defense?

choices.a: Both the producer and the performer knew that a year earlier the performer had been incapacitated for a short period of time by the same kind of stomach disorder.
choices.b: The actor, by general acclaim, was much better in the role than the performer had been.
choices.c: The actor was the only replacement the producer could find, and the actor would accept nothing less than a contract for the remainder of the six-week tour.
choices.d: The producer offered to employ the performer as the actor's understudy for the remainder of the six-week tour at the performer's original salary, but the performer declined.

Q81177

A producer contracted to pay an inexperienced performer a specified salary to act in a small role in a play the producer was taking on a six-week road tour. The contract was for the duration of the tour.

On the third day of the tour, the performer was hospitalized with a stomach disorder. The producer replaced her in the cast with an experienced actor. One week later, the performer recovered, but the producer refused to allow her to resume her original role for the remainder of the tour.

In an action by the performer against the producer for breach of contract, which of the following, if proved, would be the producer's best defense?

一名制片人与一名缺乏经验的演员签订合同，约定支付其特定薪酬，让其在该制片人组织的一场为期六周的巡回演出戏剧中扮演一个小角色。合同期限为整个巡演期间。

巡演第三天，该演员因胃病住院。制片人用一名经验丰富的演员替换了她在剧组中的位置。一周后，该演员康复，但制片人拒绝让其在剩余的巡演期间恢复其原有角色。

在该演员以违约为由对制片人提起的诉讼中，以下哪项如果得到证实，将是制片人最好的抗辩理由？
options:
A. Both the producer and the performer knew that a year earlier the performer had been incapacitated for a short period of time by the same kind of stomach disorder.
制片人和演员双方都知道，一年前该演员曾因同类胃病而短暂丧失行为能力。

B. The actor, by general acclaim, was much better in the role than the performer had been.
根据普遍赞誉，新演员在该角色上的表现远胜于原演员。

C. The actor was the only replacement the producer could find, and the actor would accept nothing less than a contract for the remainder of the six-week tour.
该新演员是制片人能找到的唯一替代人选，并且该新演员只接受一份覆盖剩余六周巡演时间的合同。

D. The producer offered to employ the performer as the actor's understudy for the remainder of the six-week tour at the performer's original salary, but the performer declined.
制片人提出在剩余的六周巡演中，以原薪酬聘用原演员担任新演员的替补，但原演员拒绝了。
data.explanation:
Ways to discharge contractual obligations


Full performance of contractual obligations
Impossibility, impracticability, or frustration of purpose
Release (in writing only)
Mutual rescission
Substituted contract
Contract or covenant not to sue
Accord & satisfaction
Novation
Mnemonic: FIRM SCAN

A party's duty to perform under a contract can be dismissed by impracticability. The defense of impracticability is available when:
  • an unanticipated or extraordinary event makes it impracticable for the party to perform
  • the contract was formed under a basic assumption that the event would not occur and
  • the party seeking discharge was not at fault.


However, temporary impracticability merely suspends the party's duty to perform until the circumstances giving rise to the impracticability cease to exist - with one exception. If the delay makes performance materially more burdensome, the party's duty to perform is dismissed.

Here, the performer's illness suspended the producer's duty to employ the performer during the period that her illness prevented her from acting. The producer then replaced her with an experienced actor. If the actor was the only replacement the producer could find and would not take a contract for less than the remainder of the six-week tour, the producer's obligation to the performer would be dismissed. The reason is that it would be materially more burdensome for the producer to employ them both. Therefore, if proved, that is the producer's best defense.

(Choice A) If both the producer and the performer knew that a year earlier the performer had been incapacitated by the same kind of stomach disorder, the performer's illness would have been foreseeable. As a result, this fact would undermine the producer's impracticability defense.

(Choice B) The relative quality of the actor's performance is not a circumstance that would suspend or discharge the producer's contractual duty to the performer.

(Choice D) The producer's action in offering the performer a job as an understudy is irrelevant to the critical issue of whether the producer had the right to cancel the contract.

Educational objective: A period of temporary impracticability suspends a party's duty to perform until the circumstances giving rise to the impracticability pass. But if the delay caused by the impracticability makes performance materially more burdensome, then the party's duty to perform is discharged.

选项正确率统计：A选项 6%，B选项 0%，C选项 56%（正确选项），D选项 36%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

免除合同义务的方式


F全面履行合同义务 (Full performance)
I履行不能、履行不切实际或目的受挫 (Impossibility, impracticability, or frustration of purpose)
R书面免除 (Release)
M双方合意解除 (Mutual rescission)
S替代合同 (Substituted contract)
C不起诉合同或契约 (Contract or covenant not to sue)
A和解与清偿 (Accord & satisfaction)
N债务更新 (Novation)
助记词: FIRM SCAN

一方的合同履行义务可因履行不切实际 (impracticability) 而免除。在以下情况下，可以采用“履行不切实际”作为抗辩：
  • 某无法预料或异常的事件导致一方履行合同变得不切实际；
  • 合同订立时，双方的基本假定是该事件将不会发生；并且
  • 寻求免责的一方本身并无过错。


然而，暂时性履行不切实际仅中止一方的履行义务，直至导致不切实际的情形消失为止——但有一个例外。如果该延迟导致履行义务变得有实质性的更重负担，则该方的履行义务将被免除。

在本案中，演员的疾病中止了制片人在其因病无法表演期间的雇佣义务。制片人随后用一名经验丰富的演员替换了她。如果该新演员是制片人能找到的唯一替代人选，且其不接受短于剩余六周巡演时间的合同，那么制片人对原演员的义务将被免除。其原因是，同时雇佣两人对制片人来说将构成实质性的更重负担。因此，如果得以证实，这将是制片人最好的抗辩理由。

(选项 A) 如果制片人和演员双方都知道一年前该演员曾因同类胃病而丧失行为能力，那么该演员的疾病本应是可预见的。因此，这一事实将削弱制片人关于“履行不切实际”的抗辩。

(选项 B) 新演员表演的相对质量，并非可以中止或免除制片人对原演员合同义务的情形。

(选项 D) 制片人提出为原演员提供替补职位的行为，与制片人是否有权解除合同这一关键问题无关。

教学目标：暂时性履行不切实际会中止一方的履行义务，直至导致不切实际的情形消失。但如果因不切实际造成的延迟使履行义务变得有实质性的更重负担，那么该方的履行义务将被免除。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 261 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (discharge by supervening impracticability).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 269 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (temporary impracticability).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析
Performance, Breach & Discharge
Contracts Impracticability

核心考点：暂时性履行不能

本题考察的是合同法中关于履行不切实际/履行不能 (Impracticability/Impossibility) 的细微差别，特别是当这种不能仅是暂时性 (Temporary) 的时候。

法律规则 (The Rule):
根据《合同法重述（第二次）》§ 269 (Restatement (Second) of Contracts)，如果一方因不可预见的情况导致暂时无法履行合同：
  • 通常情况： 义务仅被中止 (Suspended)，而非免除。一旦障碍消除，必须恢复履行。
  • 例外情况： 如果延迟履行或中止履行会给对方造成实质性的更重负担 (Materially more burdensome)，则合同义务被完全免除 (Discharged)。

✅ 正确答案分析 (选项 C)

为什么选项 C 是制片人最好的抗辩？

逻辑推理：

  1. 触发事件： 演员生病住院，导致她暂时无法履行表演义务。这构成了暂时性的履行不能。
  2. 制片人的困境： 演出正在进行中（巡演），制片人必须维持演出继续，因此必须寻找替代者。
  3. 关键事实 (选项 C)： 替代演员是唯一能找到的人选，且该替代者坚持要求签下剩余全部巡演时间的合同。
  4. 法律后果： 如果法律强迫制片人在原演员康复后重新接纳她，制片人将不得不为同一个角色支付两份薪水（一份给签了死约的替代者，一份给原演员）。

这将导致制片人的履行负担实质性增加 (Materially more burdensome)。因此，原演员的暂时性疾病不仅仅是中止了合同，而是演变成了合同解除的正当理由。

❌ 干扰项排除

理解为什么其他选项不能作为“最好的抗辩”对于MBE提分至关重要。

选项 A (双方均知晓旧病史)：
这是一个陷阱。如果疾病是可预见的 (Foreseeable)，那么制片人在签约时就承担了风险。这不仅不是抗辩理由，反而会破坏制片人主张“履行不切实际”的基础，因为该抗辩要求事件是“不可预见”的。
选项 B (新演员演得更好)：
法律无关性。 合同法不关心谁的艺术造诣更高。仅仅因为找到了更好的替代者，并不能赋予一方违约的权利。这不能作为解除原合同的理由。
选项 D (提供替补职位)：
这表明制片人试图减轻损失 (Mitigate damages) 或达成和解，但这并不是一个法律上的抗辩理由。提供新职位并不证明制片人有权终止原合同。

🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理涉及生病/丧失能力 (Incapacity) 的个人服务合同 (Personal Services Contract) 题目时：

  • 如果是独一无二的服务（如著名画家），死亡或生病通常直接解除合同。
  • 如果是普通服务或暂时性生病，通常只是中止履行。
  • 破局点： 必须寻找事实细节，证明等待康复或恢复原职会彻底改变合同的性质或给雇主带来无法承受的负担（如本题中的“唯一替代者”+“必须签全约”）。

questions.question:
A broker needed a certain rare coin to complete a set that he had contracted to assemble and sell to a collector. On February 1, the broker obtained such a coin from a hoarder in exchange for $1,000 and a written promise to redeliver to the hoarder "no later than December 31 of this year" a comparable specimen of the same kind of coin. On February 2, the broker consummated the sale of the complete set to the collector.
On October 1, the market price of rare coins suddenly began a rapid, sustained rise. On October 15, the broker wrote the hoarder, "In view of the surprising market, it seems unfair that I should have to replace your coin within the next few weeks." On October 17, the hoarder responded in writing that she was treating the broker's repudiation as final and canceled the contract.
On November 15, the hoarder sued the broker for the market value of a comparable replacement-coin.
If the broker moves to dismiss the hoarder's complaint, which of the following is the broker's best argument in support of the motion?

choices.a: Even if the broker repudiated on October 15, the hoarder has no remedy because she failed to demand in writing that the broker retract his repudiation.
choices.b: Even if the broker repudiated on October 15, the hoarder's only action would be for specific performance because the coin is a unique chattel.
choices.c: The broker did not repudiate the contract on October 15 and may still perform no later than the contract deadline of December 31.
choices.d: Under the doctrine of impossibility, the broker is temporarily excused by the market conditions from timely performance of his coin-replacement obligation.

On February 2, the broker consummated the sale of the complete set to the collector.

On October 1, the market price of rare coins suddenly began a rapid, sustained rise. On October 15, the broker wrote the hoarder, "In view of the surprising market, it seems unfair that I should have to replace your coin within the next few weeks." On October 17, the hoarder responded in writing that she was treating the broker's repudiation as final and canceled the contract.

On November 15, the hoarder sued the broker for the market value of a comparable replacement-coin.

If the broker moves to dismiss the hoarder's complaint, which of the following is the broker's best argument in support of the motion?

一名经纪人需要一枚特定的稀有硬币来完成一套他已签约组合并出售给一位收藏家的藏品。2月1日，该经纪人从一名囤积者处获得这样一枚硬币，作为交换，他支付了1000美元，并书面承诺“不迟于今年12月31日”向该囤积者返还一枚同类的可比硬币。2月2日，该经纪人完成了将整套藏品出售给收藏家的交易。

10月1日，稀有硬币的市场价格突然开始快速、持续上涨。10月15日，经纪人致信囤积者称：“鉴于惊人的市场行情，我不得不在未来几周内替换您的硬币，这似乎不公平。”10月17日，囤积者书面回复称，她将经纪人的毁约行为视为最终决定，并解除了合同。

11月15日，囤积者起诉经纪人，要求其赔偿一枚可比替换硬币的市场价值。

如果经纪人提出动议要求驳回囤积者的诉状，以下哪项是支持该动议的最佳论据？
options:
A. Even if the broker repudiated on October 15, the hoarder has no remedy because she failed to demand in writing that the broker retract his repudiation.
即使经纪人在10月15日毁约，囤积者也无法获得救济，因为她未能书面要求经纪人撤回其毁约。

B. Even if the broker repudiated on October 15, the hoarder's only action would be for specific performance because the coin is a unique chattel.
即使经纪人在10月15日毁约，囤积者唯一的诉讼理由也只能是要求特定履行，因为该硬币是独特的动产。

C. The broker did not repudiate the contract on October 15 and may still perform no later than the contract deadline of December 31.
经纪人并未在10月15日毁约，并且仍可在不晚于12月31日的合同截止日期前履行合同。

D. Under the doctrine of impossibility, the broker is temporarily excused by the market conditions from timely performance of his coin-replacement obligation.
根据 doctrine of impossibility，经纪人因市场状况而暂时免于履行其按时替换硬币的义务。
data.explanation:
The doctrine of anticipatory repudiation is applicable when a contracting party indicates an unwillingness to perform a promise before the time for performance arises or elapses. The repudiation must be clear and unequivocal , and it may be by words or actions. Upon repudiation, the nonrepudiating party may either treat the repudiation as a breach or ignore it and demand performance pursuant to the contract.

Here, the broker wrote the hoarder that "it seems unfair that I should have to replace your coin within the next few weeks." This statement did not clearly and unequivocally demonstrate the broker's intention not to perform pursuant to their contract. As a result, the broker's best argument supporting dismissal of the hoarder's breach-of-contract claim is that he did not repudiate the contract and may still perform no later than the contract deadline.†

†The broker's statement presents reasonable grounds for insecurity about his willingness to perform, so the hoarder has the right to make a written demand for assurances. The broker's failure to provide such assurances within 30 days would result in an anticipatory repudiation.

(Choice A) A repudiation may be retracted unless the nonrepudiating party has:
  • canceled the contract,
  • materially changed position, or
  • indicated that he/she considers the repudiation final.
But there is no requirement that the nonrepudiating party demand in writing that the repudiating party issue a retraction.

(Choice B) Specific performance is an available remedy when monetary damages would be inadequate because the property or chattel at issue is unique. But monetary damages would be adequate here since the parties contracted for a comparable specimen of the same kind of coin - not the exact same coin.

(Choice D) The doctrine of impossibility discharges a party's contractual duties when an unexpected and extraordinary event beyond the parties' control makes performance impossible. However, a change in market conditions is neither unexpected nor extraordinary. And the broker is able to perform since he can still purchase the coin, albeit at a higher price.

Educational objective: The doctrine of anticipatory repudiation applies when a party clearly and unequivocally repudiates (ie, indicates an unwillingness to perform) a promise before the time for performance arises or elapses. The nonrepudiating party may treat the repudiation as a breach or ignore it and demand performance pursuant to the contract.



选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 5%，C选项 91%（正确选项），D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当合同一方在履行时间到来或届满之前表示不愿意履行承诺时，适用doctrine of anticipatory repudiation。毁约必须是明确且毫不含糊的，可以通过言语或行为来表示。一旦发生毁约，非毁约方既可以将该毁约行为视为违约，也可以忽略它并要求对方根据合同履行。

在本案中，经纪人致信囤积者称“我不得不在未来几周内替换您的硬币，这似乎不公平。”该声明并未明确且毫不含糊地表明经纪人根据合同不履行的意图。因此，经纪人支持驳回囤积者违约索赔的最佳论据是，他并未毁约，并且仍可在不晚于合同截止日期前履行。†

†经纪人的声明为其履约意愿提供了合理的不安理由，因此囤积者有权书面要求提供保证。若经纪人未能在30天内提供此类保证，将构成预期性毁约。

(选项A) 毁约可以被撤回，除非非毁约方已经：
  • 解除了合同，
  • 状况发生了重大改变，或
  • 表示其认为该毁约是最终的。
但是，法律并未要求非毁约方必须书面要求毁约方发出撤回声明。

(选项B) 当金钱赔偿不足以弥补损失时，例如涉案财产或动产是独特的，特定履行是一种可用的救济方式。但在本案中，金钱赔偿是足够的，因为双方在合同中约定的是一枚可比的同类硬币，而非完全相同的某一特定硬币。

(选项D) 当发生超出当事人控制的意外和非常事件，导致履行成为不可能时，doctrine of impossibility 可免除一方的合同义务。然而，市场状况的变化既非意外也非非常事件。而且经纪人仍有能力履行，因为他仍然可以购买硬币，尽管价格更高。

教学目标：当一方在履行时间到来或届满前，明确且毫不含糊地毁约（即表示不愿履行）一项承诺时，适用 doctrine of anticipatory repudiation。非毁约方既可以将该毁约行为视为违约，也可以忽略它并要求对方根据合同履行。

References

U.C.C. § 2-610 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (anticipatory repudiation).

MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Anticipatory Repudiation

正确答案：C 经纪人并未在10月15日毁约，并且仍可在不晚于12月31日的合同截止日期前履行合同。
核心考点：预期违约的标准

本题考察的是合同法中的 Anticipatory Repudiation（预期违约/期前毁约）。

根据普通法和 UCC（统一商法典），构成预期违约必须满足一个极其严格的条件：

“Clear and Unequivocal”
（明确且毫不含糊）

毁约方必须通过言语或行为，绝对地、无条件地表明其将不会履行合同。仅仅是表达困难、不满或对市场价格的抱怨，不足以构成毁约。

案情分析
2月1日 合同成立
截止日12/31
10月15日 经纪人发信
抱怨价格
12月31日 履行
截止日期

经纪人的原话：
"In view of the surprising market, it seems unfair that I should have to replace your coin..."
（鉴于惊人的市场行情，我不得不替换您的硬币，这似乎不公平。）

法律判定：
这句话是在“发牢骚”或表达不满，但没有明确说“我不会履行”。这属于模棱两可的陈述（Ambiguous Statement）。

因此，囤积者（Hoarder）过早地将其视为毁约并提起诉讼是错误的。经纪人仍有时间（直到12月31日）去购买硬币并交付。

考生必知：囤积者本该怎么做？

面对这种模棱两可的态度，囤积者不应直接起诉，而应根据 UCC § 2-609 行使权利：

  1. 书面要求对方提供履约保证 (Demand for Assurances)。
  2. 如果经纪人在30天内未能提供保证，此时才视为预期违约。
为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A (Retraction): 错误。法律并未规定非违约方必须书面要求对方“撤回毁约”。一旦对方真的毁约，非违约方可以直接起诉。
选项 B (Specific Performance): 错误。特定履行通常用于“独一无二”的物品（如土地、艺术孤品）。本题中合同标的是“同类可比硬币” (comparable specimen)，并非特定那一枚，因此金钱赔偿（Money Damages）是足够的救济手段。
选项 D (Impossibility): 错误。市场价格上涨属于商业风险，不构成 Impossibility（履行不能）或 Impracticability（履行极其困难）。除非涨价极其离谱且不可预见（通常需要战争、禁运等极端情况），否则单纯变贵不能免除合同义务。

A seller and a buyer entered into a written agreement providing that the seller was to deliver 1,000 cases of candy bars to the buyer during the months of May and June. Under the agreement, the buyer was obligated to make a selection by March 1 of the quantities of the various candy bars to be delivered under the contract. The buyer did not make the selection by March 1, and on March 2 the seller notified the buyer that because of the buyer's failure to select, the seller would not deliver the candy bars. The seller had all the necessary candy bars on hand on March 1 and made no additional sales or purchases on March 1 or March 2. On March 2, after receiving the seller's notice that it would not perform, the buyer notified the seller of its selection and insisted that the seller perform. The seller refused.
If the buyer sues the seller for breach of contract, is the buyer likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because a contract did not exist until the buyer selected the specific candy bars, and the seller withdrew its offer before selection.
choices.b: No, because the buyer's selection of the candy bars by March 1 was an express condition to the seller's duty to perform.
choices.c: Yes, because the delay of one day in making the selection did not have a material effect on the seller.
choices.d: Yes, because upon the buyer's failure to make a selection by March 1, the seller had a duty to make a reasonable selection.

Under the agreement, the buyer was obligated to make a selection by March 1 of the quantities of the various candy bars to be delivered under the contract. The seller had all the necessary candy bars on hand on March 1 and made no additional sales or purchases on March 1 or March 2. On March 2, after receiving the seller's notice that it would not perform, the buyer notified the seller of its selection and insisted that the seller perform. The seller refused.

If the buyer sues the seller for breach of contract, is the buyer likely to prevail?

卖方和买方签订了一份书面协议，规定卖方在五月和六月期间向买方交付1000箱糖果棒。根据该协议，买方有义务在3月1日之前选定合同项下将要交付的各种糖果棒的数量。买方未能在3月1日前做出选择，于是在3月2日，卖方通知买方，由于买方未能选择，卖方将不交付糖果棒。卖方在3月1日备有所有必需的糖果棒，并且在3月1日或3月2日没有进行任何额外的销售或采购。3月2日，在收到卖方将不履约的通知后，买方向卖方通知了其选择，并坚持要求卖方履约。卖方拒绝了。

如果买方以违约为由起诉卖方，买方是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because a contract did not exist until the buyer selected the specific candy bars, and the seller withdrew its offer before selection.
不会，因为在买方选定具体的糖果棒之前合同并不存在，而卖方在选择前撤回了其要约。

B. No, because the buyer's selection of the candy bars by March 1 was an express condition to the seller's duty to perform.
不会，因为买方在3月1日之前选择糖果棒是卖方履行义务的一个明示条件。

C. Yes, because the delay of one day in making the selection did not have a material effect on the seller.
会，因为延迟一天做出选择对卖方没有产生重大影响。

D. Yes, because upon the buyer's failure to make a selection by March 1, the seller had a duty to make a reasonable selection.
会，因为在买方未能在3月1日前做出选择时，卖方有义务做出合理的选择。
data.explanation:
Contracts for the sale of goods (eg, candy bars) are governed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC). When a sale-of-goods contract fails to specify the assortment of goods to be delivered (eg, the quantities of various candy bars), the UCC imposes a duty on the buyer to select the assortment of goods.† If the buyer fails to timely do so AND the delay materially impacts the seller's performance, then the seller can:
  • proceed in any reasonable manner (eg, choose a reasonable assortment of goods)
  • treat the buyer's non-selection as a breach (Choice D).


Here, the parties agreed that the buyer would select an assortment of candy bars by March 1. Although the buyer made the selection on March 2, the delay did not materially impact the seller's performance. That is because the seller had all the necessary candy bars on hand and had entered into no new contracts at that time. As a result, the seller unjustifiably refused to accept the buyer's selection, and the buyer will likely prevail.

†In contrast, arrangements relating to shipping are the seller's duty to specify.

(Choice A) The UCC rejects the idea that a contract must specify the assortment of goods to be valid. Here, the contract stated the buyer could select the assortment later.

(Choice B) Absent language requiring strict compliance, the buyer's selection of the candy bars was a constructive or implied condition to the seller's duty to perform, which could be satisfied by substantially complying (eg, selecting a day late).

Educational objective: If the buyer fails to timely select the assortment of goods for delivery and the delay materially impacts the seller's performance, then the seller can
  • (1) proceed in any reasonable manner
  • (2) treat the failure as a breach.




选项正确率统计：A选项 3%，B选项 40%，C选项 48%（正确选项），D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

货物（例如糖果棒）销售合同受《Uniform Commercial Code》(UCC) 第二条管辖。当一项货物销售合同未能明确规定将要交付的货物的种类规格（例如，各种糖果棒的数量）时，UCC 规定买方有义务选择货物的种类规格。† 如果买方未能及时这样做，并且该延迟对卖方的履约产生了重大影响，那么卖方可以：
  • 以任何合理的方式行事（例如，选择一个合理的货物种类规格）
  • 将买方的不选择行为视为违约（选项D）。


在此案中，双方同意买方将在3月1日之前选择糖果棒的种类规格。尽管买方在3月2日做出了选择，但该延迟并未对卖方的履约产生重大影响。这是因为卖方当时备有所有必需的糖果棒，且并未签订任何新合同。因此，卖方无正当理由地拒绝接受买方的选择，买方很可能会胜诉。

†相比之下，与运输相关的安排是卖方的明确规定义务。

（选项A） UCC 驳斥了合同必须明确规定货物种类规格才有效的观点。在此案中，合同规定了买方可以稍后选择种类规格。

（选项B） 在没有要求严格遵守的语言的情况下，买方选择糖果棒是卖方履行义务的一个推定或默示条件，该条件可以通过实质性遵守来满足（例如，延迟一天选择）。

教学目标：如果买方未能及时为待交付货物选择种类规格，且该延迟对卖方的履约产生了重大影响，那么卖方可以
  • （1）以任何合理的方式行事
  • （2）将该不履行行为视为违约。


References

UCC § 2-311 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (options and cooperation respecting performance).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / UCC Article 2
核心法律规则：UCC § 2-311

在货物买卖合同中，如果合同未规定具体的货物规格（如糖果种类），买方有义务进行选择。

如果买方未能及时选择，卖方只有在该延迟对卖方的履约造成重大影响 (Material Effect) 时，才能将此视为违约并取消合同。

📊 案情逻辑链分析

1. 合同性质：货物买卖 (Sale of Goods)，适用 UCC。

2. 义务：买方需在 3月1日 前选定糖果种类。

3. 违约事实：买方迟延 1天（3月2日才选）。

4. 关键事实：题目明确指出卖方库存充足，且未进行其他交易。这意味着延迟没有对卖方造成实质性损害。

5. 结论：卖方无权取消合同，卖方的拒绝履行构成了违约。

✅ 正确答案解析
选项 C 正确。因为延迟一天做出选择对卖方没有产生重大影响。

根据 UCC § 2-311(3)，一方未配合（如未选择规格）并不自动导致合同终止。只有当这种失败 "materially affects"（重大影响）另一方的履约时，受影响方才能将其视为违约。本案中，延迟仅一天且无经济损失，因此卖方取消合同是不合理的。
❌ 错误陷阱排除
选项 A 错误。UCC 允许合同存在未决条款 (Open Terms)。只要双方有订立合同的意图且有合理的计算赔偿依据，即使未选定具体规格，合同依然成立。
选项 B 错误。除非合同明确规定“时间是关键要素” (Time is of the essence)，否则轻微的延迟通常不被视为未能满足“明示条件” (Express Condition)，而只是轻微违约，不足以免除卖方的履约义务。
选项 D 错误。虽然 UCC 允许卖方在买方违约时自己做出合理的选择 (make a reasonable selection)，但这只是卖方的权利而非义务。更重要的是，卖方不能在没有“重大影响”的情况下直接取消合同。
💡 MBE 拿分技巧

在处理 UCC 下的“合作与选择” (Cooperation and Options) 问题时，请寻找关键词 "Materially Affects" (重大影响)。

UCC 旨在促进商业交易的达成，不喜欢因为技术性的小失误（如晚了一天通知规格）而撕毁合同。如果题目特意强调“卖方库存充足，无其他损失”，这通常是在暗示你：没有重大影响，合同应当继续。

questions.question:
On July 1, a man and a developer contracted in writing for the sale and purchase of the man's farm, and to close the transaction on December 1.
On September 1, the developer unequivocally repudiated the contract. On September 15, the man urged the developer to change her mind and proceed with the scheduled closing on December 1. On October 1, having heard nothing further from the developer, the man sold and conveyed his farm to a farmer without notifying the developer. On December 1, the developer attempted to close under the July 1 contract by tendering the full purchase price to the man. The man rejected the tender.
The developer sued the man for breach of contract.
Will the developer likely prevail?

choices.a: No, because acceptance of the purchase price by the man was a concurrent condition to the man's obligation to convey the farm to the developer on December 1.
choices.b: No, because the developer did not retract her repudiation before the man materially changed his position in reliance thereon by selling the farm to the farmer.
choices.c: Yes, because the man failed seasonably to notify the developer of any pending sale to the farmer.
choices.d: Yes, because the man waived the developer's September 1 repudiation by urging her to retract it on September 15.

data.questionStem:
Q81186

On July 1, a man and a developer contracted in writing for the sale and purchase of the man's farm, and to close the transaction on December 1.

On September 1, the developer unequivocally repudiated the contract. On September 15, the man urged the developer to change her mind and proceed with the scheduled closing on December 1. On October 1, having heard nothing further from the developer, the man sold and conveyed his farm to a farmer without notifying the developer. On December 1, the developer attempted to close under the July 1 contract by tendering the full purchase price to the man. The man rejected the tender.

The developer sued the man for breach of contract.

Will the developer likely prevail?

7月1日，一名男子和一名开发商就买卖该男子的农场签订了书面合同，并约定于12月1日完成交易。

9月1日，开发商明确地拒绝履行该合同。9月15日，该男子催促开发商改变主意，并按计划于12月1日完成交易。10月1日，在没有收到开发商的任何进一步消息后，该男子将他的农场出售并转让给了一位农民，且未通知开发商。12月1日，开发商试图通过向该男子支付全部购买价款的方式来完成7月1日的合同。该男子拒绝了该支付。

开发商以违约为由起诉该男子。

开发商是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because acceptance of the purchase price by the man was a concurrent condition to the man's obligation to convey the farm to the developer on December 1.
不会，因为该男子接受购买价款，是其在12月1日向开发商转让农场义务的一项同期履行条件。

B. No, because the developer did not retract her repudiation before the man materially changed his position in reliance thereon by selling the farm to the farmer.
不会，因为在该男子因信赖开发商的拒绝履行表示而将农场出售给农民，从而实质性地改变其处境之前，开发商并未撤回其拒绝履行的表示。

C. Yes, because the man failed seasonably to notify the developer of any pending sale to the farmer.
会，因为该男子未在适当时间内将任何待进行的向农民出售农场的事宜通知开发商。

D. Yes, because the man waived the developer's September 1 repudiation by urging her to retract it on September 15.
会，因为该男子在9月15日催促开发商撤回其拒绝履行的表示，从而放弃了追究开发商在9月1日拒绝履行合同的权利。
data.explanation:
The doctrine of anticipatory repudiation applies when a contracting party clearly and unequivocally repudiates (ie, indicates an unwillingness to perform ) a promise before the time for performance arises or elapses. A repudiation can be retracted if the nonrepudiating party receives notice of the retraction before :
  • canceling the contract
  • materially changing position in reliance on the repudiation or
  • indicating that he/she considers the repudiation to be final.
If the repudiation is not retracted, the nonrepudiating party may (1) treat the repudiation as a breach or (2) ignore it and demand performance pursuant to the contract.

Here, the developer unequivocally repudiated the contract for the sale of the farm on September 1. One month later, the man sold and conveyed the farm to the farmer because the man had heard nothing from the developer. Since the developer did not retract her repudiation before the man materially changed his position in reliance thereon, the developer has no recourse for breach of contract. Therefore, the developer likely will not prevail.

(Choice A) The fact that the man did not accept the purchase price when the developer tendered it on December 1 is not the reason the developer will lose. Instead, the developer will lose because she repudiated the contract on September 1 and the man materially changed his position in reliance thereon by selling the farm to someone else.

(Choice C) The nonrepudiating party need not notify the repudiating party that the nonrepudiating party materially changed his/her position in reliance on the repudiation.

(Choice D) The fact that the man urged the developer to retract her repudiation did not waive the repudiation because only the developer can retract it.

Educational objective: A party who anticipatorily repudiates a contract may retract the repudiation if the nonrepudiating party is notified of the retraction before (1) canceling the contract, (2) materially changing position in reliance on the repudiation, or (3) indicating that he/she considers the repudiation final.



选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 96%（正确选项），C选项 1%，D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当合同一方在履行时间到来或经过之前，明确且毫不含糊地表示拒绝履行（即，表明不愿履行）其承诺时，适用预期拒绝履行 (anticipatory repudiation) 原则。如果未拒绝履行的一方在以下情况发生之前收到撤回通知，则拒绝履行的表示可以被撤回：
  • 解除合同
  • 因信赖该拒绝履行的表示而处境发生实质性改变，或
  • 表明其认为该拒绝履行的表示是最终的。
如果拒绝履行的表示未被撤回，未拒绝履行的一方可以 (1) 将该拒绝履行的表示视为违约，或 (2) 不予理会并要求对方根据合同履行。

在本案中，开发商在9月1日明确地拒绝履行农场买卖合同。一个月后，由于没有收到开发商的任何消息，该男子将农场出售并转让给了农民。由于在该男子因信赖其表示而处境发生实质性改变之前，开发商并未撤回其拒绝履行的表示，因此开发商无权就违约寻求救济。所以，开发商很可能不会胜诉。

(选项A) 12月1日当开发商支付购买价款时，该男子未接受，这并非开发商败诉的原因。开发商败诉的原因是，她在9月1日拒绝履行合同，而该男子因信赖其表示，将农场出售给他人，从而使其处境发生了实质性改变。

(选项C) 未拒绝履行的一方无需通知拒绝履行的一方，其已因信赖该拒绝履行的表示而处境发生了实质性改变。

(选项D) 该男子催促开发商撤回其拒绝履行的表示，这一事实并不构成对该拒绝履行行为的权利放弃，因为只有开发商自己才能撤回其表示。

教学目标：预期拒绝履行合同的一方可以撤回其拒绝履行的表示，条件是未拒绝履行的一方在 (1) 解除合同，(2) 因信赖该拒绝履行的表示而处境发生实质性改变，或 (3) 表明其认为该拒绝履行的表示是最终的之前，收到了撤回通知。

References

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 253 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (effect of an anticipatory repudiation).

Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 256 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (retraction of repudiation).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：预期拒绝履行

本题考察的核心法律原则是合同法中的 预期拒绝履行 (Anticipatory Repudiation) 及其 撤回 (Retraction) 的限制。

正确答案：B
开发商败诉，因为在其试图撤回拒绝履行的意思表示之前，卖方（男子）已经基于信赖该拒绝行为，实质性地改变了自己的处境（卖给了第三方）。

核心法律逻辑拆解

根据《合同法重述（第二次）》(Restatement (Second) of Contracts) § 253 和 § 256：

  1. 明确的拒绝 (Unequivocal Repudiation):
    9月1日，开发商明确表示不履行合同。这构成了预期违约。此时，非违约方（男子）有两个选择：
    • 立即起诉违约；或者
    • 等待履行日，并催促对方履行。
  2. 催促履行不构成弃权 (Urging Performance is not Waiver):
    男子在9月15日催促开发商改变主意。这并不意味着男子放弃了追究开发商违约的权利。法律允许受害方给违约方一个“改过自新”的机会。
  3. 撤回的权利与截止点 (Power of Retraction):
    违约方（开发商）原则上可以撤回其拒绝履行的声明，但是，这一权利在以下任一情况发生时终止：
    • 受害方已通知解除合同；
    • 受害方已表明将该拒绝视为最终决定；或者
    • 受害方已基于信赖该拒绝而实质性改变了处境 (Material Change of Position)。

本案时间线分析

7月1日
双方签订土地买卖合同。
9月1日
开发商明确拒绝履行 (Repudiation)。
9月15日
男子催促开发商履约（这不构成弃权）。
10月1日
关键转折点：男子将农场卖给第三方。
法律后果：男子实质性改变了处境，开发商撤回违约的权利在此刻终止。
12月1日
开发商试图付款（Retraction/Cure）。
结果：太晚了。

为什么其他选项是错误的？

选项 A (同期履行条件):
虽然一手交钱一手交货通常是同期条件，但前提是合同仍然有效。本案中，由于开发商先前的拒绝履行导致男子卖掉了土地，合同实际上已经因男子的信赖行为而终止，因此不存在12月1日的履行义务。
选项 C (通知义务):
这是一个常见的干扰项。非违约方（男子）在基于信赖采取行动（卖给别人）之前，不需要通知违约方。只要该行动发生了，就切断了违约方撤回的权利。
选项 D (弃权 Waiver):
这是MBE常考的陷阱。考生常误以为“催促对方履行”等于“原谅了对方的违约”。法律明确规定：催促对方撤回拒绝履行，并不放弃将该拒绝视为违约的权利。

考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理 Anticipatory Repudiation 的题目时，请寻找“不可逆点” (Point of No Return)。一旦非违约方基于信赖采取了行动（如签订新合同、购买原材料等），违约方就失去了回头的机会，无论他们后来多么想履行合同。
