questions.question:
In a signed writing, a man contracted to purchase a 25-foot travel trailer from a dealership for $15,000, cash on delivery, no later than June 1. The man arrived at the dealership's sales lot on Sunday, May 31, but he refused to pay for and take delivery of the trailer as contracted when he discovered that the spare tire was missing. The dealership offered to install a spare tire on Monday when its service department would open, but the man replied that he did not want the trailer and would purchase another one elsewhere.
Which of the following is accurate?

choices.a: The man had a right to reject the trailer and terminate the contract under the perfect-tender rule.
choices.b: The man had a right to reject the trailer, but the dealership was entitled to a reasonable opportunity to cure the defect.
choices.c: The man was required to accept the trailer, because the defect could be readily cured.
choices.d: The man was required to accept the trailer, because the defect did not substantially impair its value.

data.questionStem:
Q81138

In a signed writing, a man contracted to purchase a 25-foot travel trailer from a dealership for $15,000, cash on delivery, no later than June 1. The man arrived at the dealership's sales lot on Sunday, May 31, but he refused to pay for and take delivery of the trailer as contracted when he discovered that the spare tire was missing. The dealership offered to install a spare tire on Monday when its service department would open, but the man replied that he did not want the trailer and would purchase another one elsewhere.

Which of the following is accurate?

一名男子以书面形式签订合同，以15,000美元的价格从一家经销商处购买一辆25英尺的旅行拖车，约定货到付款，交付时间不迟于6月1日。该男子于5月31日（星期日）到达经销商的销售场地，但在发现拖车缺少一个备用轮胎时，他拒绝按照合同约定支付款项并接收拖车。经销商主动提出在周一其维修部门开门时安装一个备用轮胎，但该男子回答说他不要这辆拖车，并将在别处购买另一辆。

以下哪项陈述是准确的？
options:
A. The man had a right to reject the trailer and terminate the contract under the perfect-tender rule.
根据完全履行规则，该男子有权拒绝接收该拖车并终止合同。

B. The man had a right to reject the trailer, but the dealership was entitled to a reasonable opportunity to cure the defect.
该男子有权拒绝接收该拖车，但经销商有权获得一个合理的机会来补救该瑕疵。

C. The man was required to accept the trailer, because the defect could be readily cured.
该男子必须接收该拖车，因为该瑕疵可以被轻易补救。

D. The man was required to accept the trailer, because the defect did not substantially impair its value.
该男子必须接收该拖车，因为该瑕疵并未实质性地损害其价值。
data.explanation:
Seller's right to cure (UCC § 2-508)


Within time for performanceSeller has right to cure by:
  • giving reasonable notice to buyer of intention to cure AND
  • making conforming delivery within time for performance
After time for performanceIf seller had reasonable grounds to believe goods were acceptable at delivery, seller has right to cure by:
  • giving reasonable notice to buyer of intention to cure AND
  • making conforming delivery within reasonable time
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code

Contracts for the sale of goods are governed by Article 2 of the Uniform Commercial Code (UCC). Under the UCC perfect-tender rule, a buyer may reject goods in a single-delivery contract - ie, a one-time bargained-for exchange - that fail to conform to the contract in any way. But if the time for performance has not yet expired, a seller may cure (ie, remedy) a defect by:
  • giving reasonable notice to the buyer of its intention to cure and
  • making a conforming delivery within the time for performance under the contract.


Here, the man contracted to purchase a 25-foot travel trailer from a dealership (single-delivery contract). The trailer was missing a spare tire (nonconforming good) when the man attempted to take delivery on May 31, so he had a right to reject the trailer. But since delivery was to occur no later than June 1, the dealership had a right to cure the defect by notifying the man of its intention to cure and then delivering a conforming trailer by June 1 (Choices A & C).

(Choice D) To reject nonconforming goods under an installment contract, the nonconformity must
  • (1) substantially impair the value of the goods and
  • (2) be incurable.
But under a single-delivery contract, a buyer may reject goods that fail to conform to the contract in any way.

Educational objective: In a single-delivery contract, the buyer may reject nonconforming goods. But if there is still time to perform under the contract, the seller has the right to cure the defect by
  • (1) giving the buyer reasonable notice of its intention to cure and
  • (2) making a conforming delivery within the time for performance under the contract.


选项正确率统计：A选项 7%，B选项 64%（正确选项），C选项 22%，D选项 5%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

卖方的补救权 (UCC § 2-508)


在履行期限内卖方有权通过以下方式进行补救：
  • 向买方发出其补救意图的合理通知，并且
  • 在履行期限内作出符合合同规定的交付
在履行期限届满后如果卖方有合理理由相信在交付时货物是可接受的，卖方有权通过以下方式进行补救：
  • 向买方发出其补救意图的合理通知，并且
  • 在合理时间内作出符合合同规定的交付
UCC = Uniform Commercial Code (《美国统一商法典》)

货物买卖合同受《美国统一商法典》(UCC) 第二篇管辖。根据UCC的完全履行规则，在单次交付合同（即一次性的协议交换）中，如果货物与合同存在任何不符之处，买方可以拒绝接收。但是，如果履行期限尚未届满，卖方可以通过以下方式补救（即纠正）瑕疵：
  • 向买方发出其补救意图的合理通知，并且
  • 在合同规定的履行期限内作出符合合同规定的交付。


在本案中，该男子签订合同从经销商处购买一辆25英尺的旅行拖车（单次交付合同）。当该男子于5月31日试图接收拖车时，拖车缺少一个备用轮胎（不符合同规定的货物），因此他有权拒绝接收该拖车。但由于交付时间不应迟于6月1日，经销商有权通过通知该男子其补救意图，并在6月1日前交付一辆符合合同规定的拖车来补救该瑕疵（选项 A 和 C）。

（选项 D）在分批交货合同下，要拒绝接收不符合同规定的货物，该不符合同之处必须
  • (1) 实质性地损害货物价值，并且
  • (2) 无法补救。
但在单次交付合同下，买方可以拒绝接收与合同存在任何不符之处的货物。

教学目标：在单次交付合同中，买方可以拒绝接收不符合同规定的货物。但是，如果合同尚有履行时间，卖方有权通过以下方式补救瑕疵：
  • (1) 向买方发出其补救意图的合理通知，以及
  • (2) 在合同规定的履行期限内作出符合合同规定的交付。


References

U.C.C. § 2-508 (Am. Law Inst. & Unif. Law Comm'n 2020) (seller's right to cure).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts / Sales (UCC Art. 2)

核心考点：完全履行与补救权 本题考察的是 UCC Article 2 下的两个相互制衡的规则：
  • 完全履行规则 (Perfect Tender Rule)
  • 卖方的补救权 (Seller's Right to Cure)
法律规则 (UCC § 2-508)：
虽然买方有权拒绝任何不符合同的货物（哪怕只是少了一个备胎），但卖方拥有补救 (Cure) 的权利，具体分为两种情况：
  1. 履行期届满前 (Time for performance has not expired)：
    如果卖方在合同截止日期前交付，且被拒绝，卖方有绝对权利进行补救，只要他通知买方并能在截止日期前完成修复。
  2. 履行期届满后：
    仅当卖方有“合理理由相信”货物会被接受时，才会有额外的合理时间进行补救。
本案逻辑推演
1
合同截止日：6月1日。
实际交付日：5月31日（星期日）。
2
违约情况：缺少备胎。根据 Perfect Tender Rule，货物不符，买方有权拒绝 (Reject)。
3
关键转折：因为今天是5月31日，距离合同截止日（6月1日）还有时间。经销商提出在周一（即6月1日）安装备胎。
4
结论：经销商是在履行期限内提出补救。因此，经销商有权补救，买方不能直接终止合同，必须给经销商这个机会。
易混淆陷阱解析

❌ 选项 A (终止合同)：
虽然买方可以拒绝接收 (Reject)，但他不能立即终止合同 (Terminate)，因为卖方的履行时间还没用完。

❌ 选项 D (实质性损害)：
这是一个常见的 MBE 陷阱！
Substantial Impairment (实质性损害) 标准不适用于单次交付合同 (Single Delivery Contract) 的初始拒绝。
它只适用于：

  • 分批交货合同 (Installment Contracts)；或者
  • 撤销接受 (Revocation of Acceptance)。
本题是单次交付且买方尚未接受，所以适用严格的“完全履行规则”，只要有一点瑕疵就可以拒绝，不需要证明损害了核心价值。但必须给卖方补救机会。

💡 MBE 拿分技巧：
看到买方因为小瑕疵拒绝货物时，首先检查日期！
如果卖方提早交货或准时交货但合同期限未过，卖方几乎总是拥有 Right to Cure。不要被“买方有权拒绝”这一半真理迷惑，要看完整的法律后果。

questions.question:
The manager of a state fair contracted with a renowned hog breeder to exhibit the breeder's only world-champion hog for the three weeks of the annual fair. At the conclusion of the fair the breeder would receive $300. Two days before the opening of the fair, the hog became sick with a communicable disease among swine and, under the applicable state quarantine law, could not be exhibited for at least a month.
Upon learning this, which of the following courses of action can the manager legally pursue with respect to his contract with the breeder?

choices.a: Suspend his own performance and recover damages from the breeder for breach of contract unless the breeder at once supplies a healthy hog of exhibition quality as a substitute for the world-champion hog.
choices.b: Suspend his own performance, demand assurances from the breeder, and treat a failure by the breeder to produce the hog as an actionable repudiation.
choices.c: Terminate his own performance and treat the hog's illness as discharging all remaining duties under the contract.
choices.d: Terminate the contract, but only if the manager promptly seeks to obtain for the exhibit a suitable substitute for the world-champion hog from another hog owner.

data.questionStem:
Q81155

The manager of a state fair contracted with a renowned hog breeder to exhibit the breeder's only world-champion hog for the three weeks of the annual fair. At the conclusion of the fair the breeder would receive $300. Two days before the opening of the fair, the hog became sick with a communicable disease among swine and, under the applicable state quarantine law, could not be exhibited for at least a month.

Upon learning this, which of the following courses of action can the manager legally pursue with respect to his contract with the breeder?

一家州博览会的经理与一位著名的养猪人订立合同，以展出该养猪人唯一的世界冠军猪，展期为年度博览会的三周。博览会结束时，养猪人将获得300美元。博览会开幕前两天，该猪患上了猪类传染病，根据适用的州检疫法，至少一个月内不得展出。

得知此事后，关于其与养猪人的合同，经理可以合法采取下列哪项行动？
options:
A. Suspend his own performance and recover damages from the breeder for breach of contract unless the breeder at once supplies a healthy hog of exhibition quality as a substitute for the world-champion hog.
中止自己的履行，并以违约为由向养猪人索赔损害赔偿，除非养猪人立即提供一头具有展出质量的健康猪作为世界冠军猪的替代品。

B. Suspend his own performance, demand assurances from the breeder, and treat a failure by the breeder to produce the hog as an actionable repudiation.
中止自己的履行，要求养猪人提供保证，并将养猪人未能提供该猪的行为视为可诉的预期违约。

C. Terminate his own performance and treat the hog's illness as discharging all remaining duties under the contract.
终止自己的履行，并将猪的疾病视为解除了合同项下所有剩余的义务。

D. Terminate the contract, but only if the manager promptly seeks to obtain for the exhibit a suitable substitute for the world-champion hog from another hog owner.
终止合同，但前提是经理须立即从另一位养猪人处，为该展览寻求获得世界冠军猪的合适替代品。
data.explanation:
When an unanticipated event makes a party's contractual duties impracticable to perform, those duties will be discharged if:
  • nonoccurrence of the event was a basic assumption of the contract and
  • the party seeking discharge is not at fault.


Here, the manager contracted to exhibit the breeder's only world-champion hog at the annual state fair. Two days before the fair opened, the hog became sick. That unanticipated event rendered performance impracticable since the hog could not be exhibited for at least a month under state law. And since the hog's ability to be exhibited was a basic assumption of the contract and the manager was not at fault, the manager can terminate his own performance and treat the hog's illness as discharging all remaining duties under the contract.

(Choice A) If possible, a party must render a reasonable substitute performance in place of the impracticable part. But a healthy hog of exhibition quality is not a reasonable substitute for the breeder's only world-champion hog.

(Choice B) If reasonable grounds arise to believe that a party will not perform because of impracticability, the other party cannot demand assurances of performance and treat a failure to give them as a repudiation. That is because the prospective nonperformance would not be a breach.

(Choice D) The manager's right to terminate his performance under the contract does not depend on whether he first seeks to obtain a suitable substitute for the world-champion hog from another hog owner.

Educational objective: When an unanticipated event makes a party's contractual duties impracticable to perform, those duties will be discharged if (1) nonoccurrence of the event was a basic assumption of the contract and (2) the party seeking discharge is not at fault.



选项正确率统计：A选项 6%，B选项 8%，C选项 83%（正确选项），D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当一个未预料到的事件导致一方履行其合同义务变得不切实际 (impracticable) 时，这些义务将被免除，前提是：
  • 该事件的不发生是合同的一项基本假定 (basic assumption) 并且
  • 寻求免除义务的一方没有过错。


在本案中，经理签约在年度州博览会上展出该养猪人唯一的世界冠军猪。博览会开幕前两天，这头猪生病了。这一未预料到的事件使得履行变得不切实际，因为根据州法律，这头猪至少一个月内不能展出。并且，由于猪能够被展出是合同的一项基本假定，且经理没有过错，经理可以终止自己的履行，并将猪的疾病视为解除了合同项下的所有剩余义务。

(选项 A) 如果可能，一方必须提供合理的替代履行来代替不切实际的部分。但是，一头具有展出质量的健康猪并不是该养猪人唯一的世界冠军猪的合理替代品。

(选项 B) 如果出现合理理由相信一方将因履行不切实际而无法履行合同，另一方不能要求履行保证，也不能将其未能提供保证的行为视为预期违约。这是因为预期的不履行不构成违约。

(选项 D) 经理终止其合同履行的权利，并不取决于他是否首先从另一位养猪人处寻求为世界冠军猪获得合适的替代品。

教学目标：当一个未预料到的事件导致一方履行其合同义务变得不切实际时，这些义务将被免除，前提是 (1) 该事件的不发生是合同的一项基本假定，以及 (2) 寻求免除义务的一方没有过错。

References

  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 261 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (impracticability).
  • Restatement (Second) of Contracts § 278 (Am. Law Inst. 1981) (substituted performance).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Contracts: Performance & Discharge
C 正确答案

经理可以终止自己的履行，并将猪的疾病视为解除了合同项下所有剩余的义务。

⚖️ 核心考点：履行不切实际

本题考察的是合同法中的 Impracticability（履行不切实际）或 Impossibility（履行不能）原则。

根据《合同法重述（第二次）》§ 263：

  • 如果合同的履行依赖于特定的人或物 (Specific person or thing) 的存在；
  • 且该人或物在无过错的情况下死亡、毁灭或丧失能力；
  • 导致履行变得不切实际；

那么，双方的合同义务将被解除 (Discharged)。

🔍 案情逻辑分析
1
特定标的物 (Specific Subject Matter)：
合同明确指定是养猪人“唯一的”世界冠军猪 (the breeder's only world-champion hog)。这不是随便一头猪，而是合同履行的基础。
2
不可预见的事件 (Unanticipated Event)：
猪在博览会前两天生病并被法律强制隔离。这是一个不可预见的事件。
3
无过错 (No Fault)：
题目未暗示养猪人对猪的生病有过错。
4
结论 (Conclusion)：
由于特定标的物不可用，养猪人提供该猪的义务被免除 (Excused)。相应地，经理支付报酬的义务也随之解除。双方互不亏欠，合同终止。
❌ 干扰项解析
选项 A 错误： 养猪人的不履行是被法律免责的 (Excused)，因此不构成违约 (Breach)。既然没有违约，经理就不能索赔损害赔偿。此外，对于“特定物”合同，不能强行要求用普通猪替代冠军猪。
选项 B 错误： 要求保证 (Demand Assurances) 适用于一方有理由担心另一方可能违约的情况。但在这里，履行已经因为客观原因变得不可能，这属于法律上的免责事由，而非预期违约 (Anticipated Repudiation)。
选项 D 错误： 经理终止合同的权利是自动产生的（基于合同目的落空/履行不能），并不以他是否去寻找替代品 (Substitute) 为前提条件。减损义务 (Duty to Mitigate) 通常发生在违约索赔时，而本案中合同已解除。
💡 MBE 提分技巧

区分“通用物”与“特定物”：

  • 如果合同只是买卖“50头猪”（通用物），其中几头病了，卖家必须去市场上买别的猪来交货，不能免责。
  • 如果合同是“这头特定的冠军猪”（特定物），猪病了或死了，合同直接解除。

看到 "unique", "only", "specific" 等词汇时，要立即联想到 Impossibility/Impracticability 的抗辩。
